TurtleGraphics is a platform with a Pythonic language for learning and practicing CPU and GPU programming on mobile devices.
 TurtleGraphics began as a reimplementation of the classic Turtle Graphics environment for Android using a simple language. Over time, that language, Lilo , evolved into a platform featuring a heterogeneous Python-inspired language that allows targeting both the CPU and GPU within the same program, influenced by Python, Mojo, and CUDA.

izzyondroid:com.github.frimtec.android.s.name: S2MSP
izzyondroid:com.github.frimtec.android.s.summary: SMS communication for apps restricted on phone numbers
izzyondroid:com.github.frimtec.android.s.description:
As Google strongly restricts the use of SMS permissions for applications in the Play-Store, S2MSP provides an API for third party applications to send and receive SMS to specific phone numbers via a secure SMS proxy.
 S2MSP acts like a local firewall for SMS communication.
 Each application that wants to send/receive SMS to a phone number can register itself on S2MSP. S2MSP asks the user for permission, whether the requesting application is allowed to send/receive SMS from and to the requested phone numbers or not.
 All SMS exchanged with third party applications are strongly encrypted.
 S2SMP itself requires SMS permissions ( SEND_SMS and RECEIVE_SMS ) from the Android system and will request these permissions upon startup. S2MSP does not need any other permissions. This ensures the integrity and security of S2MSP.
 The API to integrate a third party application with S2MSP is available in Maven-Central.

izzyondroid:de.tuberlin.mcc.simra.app.name: SimRa
izzyondroid:de.tuberlin.mcc.simra.app.description:
Comparable to other major cities worldwide, Berlin aims to reduce traffic emissions. Foremost mechanism for this is to increase the share of bicycle traffic. However, polls show that a lack of safety and fear of accidents keeps people from using their bikes more frequently. Furthermore, it also quite hard from a city planning perspective to get a good overview of location, time, frequency, and kind of hazards in bicycle traffic since official accident statistics only cover crashes but do not provide information on near crashes.
 In this project, we collect – with a strong focus on data protection and privacy – data on such near crashes to identify when and where bicyclists are especially at risk. We also aim to identify the main routes of bicycle traffic in Berlin. To obtain such data, we have developed the SimRa app that uses GPS information to track routes of bicyclists and the built-in acceleration sensors to pre-categorize near crashes. After their trip, users are asked to annotate and upload the collected data in a fully anonymous way.
 The collected data offers detailed insights into bicycle traffic in Berlin (and other cities) and hazardous situations to public administrators and other interested entities so that the number of near crashes (and hence also crashes) can be reduced. The data can also be used to optimize traffic flows to make bicycle traffic more attractive. For the evaluation of data, we plan to cooperate with interdisciplinary partners such as city planning, interested citizens, but also the Berlin Senate Department for the Environment, Transport and Climate Protection.

fdroid:com.networkscanner.app.summary: Who's on my WiFi? Find every device, its IP address & open ports. No ads.
fdroid:com.networkscanner.app.description:
Network Scanner is a fast WiFi and IP scanner that finds every device on your local network and shows its IP address, hostname, open ports, and device type. No ads, no tracking, no root required.
See who's on your WiFi, spot unknown devices, find the IP address of a printer, camera, or smart home device, and check your router and LAN for open ports. Everything runs offline on your phone, and the app is fully open source (GPL-3.0).
 Features 
• Network scanner: ping sweep with TCP fallback, ARP, mDNS / Bonjour, SSDP / UPnP, and NetBIOS discovery
• Port scanner: scan common ports with service and version detection, or all 65,535 ports
• Device identification: hostname, vendor, model, OS fingerprint, and device type (phone, laptop, TV, router, printer, NAS)
• MAC address and vendor lookup from a bundled offline database, with optional Shizuku or root access to show MAC addresses on Android 10 and later
• Rename devices and assign custom icons
• Long press to copy any detail, or tap a web port to open it in your browser
• Scan over WiFi, Ethernet, or VPN, with customizable ports
 Permissions 
• Nearby WiFi devices : required on Android 16 and later to reach devices on your LAN
• Location (optional) : only to show your WiFi network name (SSID), never for tracking
• Shizuku or root (optional) : off by default; used only if you turn on MAC address access in Settings, to read the network's ARP table

fdroid:de.froehlichmedia.adaptkey.name: AdaptKey
fdroid:de.froehlichmedia.adaptkey.summary: Privacy-first Android keyboard that learns your typing style. Fully offline.
fdroid:de.froehlichmedia.adaptkey.description:
AdaptKey is an adaptive Android keyboard (IME) that learns how you type - built for privacy first.
Provably offline. No phoning home.
AdaptKey has no internet permission at all. This is not a promise you have to take on faith - it is enforced by Android and verifiable by anyone: there is no INTERNET permission in the app manifest, so the operating system makes it impossible for the app to open a network connection. No telemetry, no analytics, no "anonymous usage statistics", no ads, no cloud sync.
* No internet permission - kernel-enforced, not a checkbox you trust.
* No storage permission - the optional local AI model is imported through the system file picker, which grants access to just that one file.
* Everything runs on-device. Dictionaries, autocorrect, language detection and the optional mini-LLM all execute locally.
* Free software, licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later - audit every line yourself.
Features
* Gboard-style QWERTZ/QWERTY layout with freely configurable key proportions (space bar, comma, full stop, backspace), a persistent number row, and per-key long-press secondary symbols.
* Learns your touch pattern. A per-key personal offset model adapts hit detection to how you actually tap; an optional calibration step seeds it.
* Smart suggestions and autocorrect from a personal on-device dictionary, with a stabilised suggestion bar, a "keep as typed" escape hatch, and one-tap post-commit undo.
* Real multilingual dictionaries as optional downloadable language packs (German, English and Greek bundled to start with, more to follow), with on-device language detection that switches the whole lexicon per language.
* Greek input with its own layout and accent long-press.
* German capitalisation done right: sentence starts, nouns vs. proper nouns, hyphen segments, the e-mail-salutation comma rule, abbreviations, and a configurable shift-grace window.
* Retroactive fixes: missed-space word split and spurious-space merge, driven by touch ambiguity.
* Gestures: swipe to delete a whole word, swipe down to dismiss, drag a suggestion to trash to blacklist it, word-end shift for casing/camelCase.
* Emoji panel with recents and a live keyword search (English and German).
* Optional on-device mini-LLM (opt-in, work in progress): when the on-device dictionary is uncertain, a small local language model can improve predictions. It is never bundled or downloaded by the app - you import it yourself via the system file picker, and it stays fully offline afterwards.
* Backup and restore your personal learned words, settings and blacklist as a single file.
AdaptKey is under active development. Feedback and bug reports are welcome on the source repository.

SimpleDay is free software, licensed under the GNU GPLv3.

fdroid:dev.bikram.obtainx.name: ObtainX
fdroid:dev.bikram.obtainx.summary: A supercharged Obtainium: get Android app updates straight from the source.
fdroid:dev.bikram.obtainx.description:
ObtainX is a modern, supercharged fork of Obtainium. Re-engineered with a stunning Material 3 Expressive UI and power-user utilities that make managing your apps effortless. Get updates straight from the source: GitHub, GitLab, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, APKMirror, APKPure, and more. No central repository, no account, no tracking. 🚀
 ━━ ✨ UNIQUE FEATURES (not in Obtainium) ━━ 
• Build Verification — cryptographic checks (F-Droid/Izzy reproducible builds and GitHub Release Attestations) flag manipulated binaries before install. ObtainX's own updates carry GitHub attestations too.
• Third-Party Installer Support — hand off updates to installers like InstallerX or App Manager to review APK metadata the stock installer hides. Essential under Advanced Protection.
• Bulk Import from Device — select apps already on your phone and ObtainX finds their sources automatically — no URL hunting.
• Dynamic Folders — named folders, manual or rule-based (by name, author, package ID, category, or source); each keeps its own layout.
• On-Demand Only mode — hide rarely-updated apps from the main list and skip them in global scans; check them only when you want.
• Configurable swipe gestures — independent left/right actions per row: Update, Install, Pin, Edit, Delete, and more.
• Custom app icons — set your own icon for any app, from your gallery or the web.
• Undo after delete — swipe- and bulk-delete show a 5-second Undo snackbar.
• Verified "also available on" links — each app shows other stores where it's confirmed present.
• RegEx Assist — a built-in helper walks you through building version and APK filters — no regex knowledge required.
• Know the update size beforehand — see the exact download size before updating.
• Skip Version — pass on a release without marking the app "updated."
• Stop download — cancel any ongoing download from the app, notification, or queue.
• Save assets — save downloaded APKs to a folder of your choice during the update.
 ━━ 🔧 ENHANCED FEATURES ━━ 
• APKMirror updates — enabled (disabled upstream), opening the specific release page.
• Smarter version status — six distinct states instead of a binary update / up-to-date.
• Add App — three paths, one screen — URL, Search, and From Device under one segmented control, results inline.
• Editable package ID for track-only sources — restores correct install detection and updates.
• Active filter chips — a dismissible chip per active filter; tap to clear it.
• Category customization — any color, rename, and bulk assign.
 ━━ 🎨 UI & UX ━━ 
• Adaptive tablet, foldable & landscape layout — on large screens a navigation rail replaces the bottom bar and your app list sits side-by-side with the detail page, opening apps in place. Adding and bulk-importing go two-pane too, and adapt in landscape — so big phones and foldables benefit, not just tablets.
• Material 3 Expressive across every screen — cards, fluid animations, expressive controls.
• A full theme engine — system/light/dark/AMOLED themes, Material You or any hex color, 9 palette algorithms, shading, gradients, progressive blur, corner roundness, and UI scale.
• Per-app color theming derived from each app's own icon.
• Customizable app rows — app type, source, and category at a glance, as text badges or minimal color strips.
• Hero icon transitions, inline collapsible search, inline edit on the detail page, source favicon badges, and auto-hiding action bars.
 ━━ 🔄 BRING YOUR DATA FROM OBTAINIUM ━━ 
In Obtainium, export your app list to a .json file (Import/Export → Export). In ObtainX, open the Backup tab and Import it — your tracked apps populate instantly.
 ━━ 🛡️ FREE & OPEN SOURCE ━━ 
Free and open-source software (GPLv3). Runs entirely on-device — no accounts, no telemetry, no proprietary services.

fdroid:jp.nonbili.meron.summary: Email with a unified inbox, kanban boards, chat views and an RSS feed reader.
fdroid:jp.nonbili.meron.description:
Bring your email accounts together in Meron Mail. Read messages in a unified inbox, organize email on kanban boards, and follow conversations in a chat view. An RSS feed reader keeps blogs and news alongside your mail.
ONE INBOX FOR YOUR ACCOUNTS
Read mail from multiple accounts in one place or switch to an individual mailbox. Connect IMAP/SMTP accounts with OAuth sign-in where supported or automatic mailbox discovery.
ORGANIZE EMAIL ON A KANBAN BOARD

READ AND REPLY LIKE A CONVERSATION
Choose chat or traditional conversation layouts. Keep replies together in threaded conversations, write with rich-text formatting, and browse attachments in media galleries.
FOLLOW RSS AND ATOM FEEDS

fdroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.stable.name: InviZible Pro: Tor & Firewall, DNSCrypt & I2P
fdroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.stable.summary: Combine the strengths of Tor, DNSCrypt and I2P for security and anonymity
fdroid:pan.alexander.tordnscrypt.stable.description:
Preserves privacy, prevents tracking, and provides access to restricted and hidden online content. 
 InviZible Pro combines the strengths of Tor, DNSCrypt, and Purple I2P to provide a comprehensive solution for online privacy, security, and anonymity.
 Tor is responsible for privacy and anonymity. It acts like an unlimited free VPN proxy, but does so in the most secure way possible. Tor uses military-grade encryption and routes your internet traffic through a network of volunteer-run proxy servers. This helps protect your identity and location by hiding your IP address. It allows you to browse the internet anonymously, access websites that are otherwise restricted, and communicate privately. Tor also allows access to websites hosted on the Tor network, known as "onion services" or dark web, which are not accessible through regular browsers.
 DNSCrypt is responsible for security. Every phone uses DNS (Domain Name System) when visiting online resources. But this traffic is usually not encrypted and can be intercepted and spoofed by third parties. DNSCrypt ensures that your DNS traffic is encrypted and secure. It prevents unauthorized access and tampering of your DNS queries, providing an additional layer of protection against surveillance and data interception.
 I2P (Invisible Internet Project) provides secure and anonymous access to internal I2P websites, chat forums and other services that are not available through regular browsers. You may know it as the deep web. It works by routing your internet traffic through a network of volunteer-run proxy servers, allowing you to hide your identity and location. I2P provides a secure and private online environment, making it a great option for those who value anonymity and privacy.
 Firewall is a security feature that helps protect your device from unauthorized access and potential threats. It acts as a filter for incoming and outgoing network traffic, allowing you to control which apps can access the internet. By setting up firewall rules, you can choose to block or allow internet connection for individual apps. This helps enhance your privacy and security by preventing unauthorized communication and protecting your data while using your phone.
InviZible Pro can utilize root access, if available on your device, or use a local VPN to deliver internet traffic directly to the Tor, DNSCrypt, and I2P networks.
 Core Features: 
✔ Tor Network - Achieve full anonymity, bypass censorship, and access .onion sites securely
✔ DNSCrypt - Encrypt DNS queries to prevent ISP monitoring and manipulation
✔ I2P (Invisible Internet Project) - Secure and private decentralized networking
✔ Advanced Firewall - Restrict internet access per app and block unauthorized connections
✔ No Root Access Required - Works seamlessly on all devices without modifications
✔ Maintain complete privacy without a paid VPN - Stay anonymous for free
✔ Stealth Mode - Evade Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) and regional restrictions
✔ Free & Open Source - No ads, no tracking, no compromises

apple-macos:6783243597.name: HushBook: Audiobook Read Along
apple-macos:6783243597.description:
Your mind wanders, and the narrator keeps going. HushBook turns audiobooks and ebooks into word-by-word karaoke. Read while listening, and never lose your place.
Add an audiobook you own and HushBook transcribes it on your iPhone or iPad. That part is free, for every book. Have the ebook too? Add it, and the page follows the narrator.
Your audio never goes to a cloud service, and there's no account to make.
READ ALONG, WORD BY WORD
• Each word lights up as it's spoken, at any speed from 0.5x to 3x
• Press and hold any line to play from there
• A calm cover view for listening, and a full reading page when you want the text
• Hold your iPad sideways for a two-page spread, like an open book
• Text a beat off from the voice? Nudge it one word at a time with Align narration
• Not in English? The Universal engine transcribes books in many other languages
AUDIOBOOK AND EBOOK, IN SYNC
• Read the real ebook text, lit word by word as the narrator reads
• EPUB, PDF, MOBI and TXT. Sync works with English ebooks
• Search inside the ebook
• Your first ebook is free. More ebooks need HushBook Pro
HIGHLIGHTS, NOTES AND QUOTES
• Highlight a line or save a quote while the book keeps playing
• Add a note to anything you mark
• Quotes & notes keeps them by book. Tap one to go back to that exact moment
• Share a quote as an image card
YOUR BOOKS, YOUR FILES
• Import from Files: MP3, M4B, M4A, AAC, FLAC, WAV, OGG, Opus and more
• Connect your Audiobookshelf server and download your books
• Search by title, author or narrator, and swipe to mark a book finished
• Home shows the book you're on, your streak and the words you read today
FREE CLASSICS
Thousands of public-domain audiobooks from LibriVox and the Internet Archive, free to download and play offline. Browse themed rows and genres, or filter by language and length. Hear a 30-second sample before you download.
BUILT FOR HOW YOU READ
Pick a reading profile and HushBook sets the app up around it.
• Dyslexia & ADHD: OpenDyslexic, a colored reading overlay and adjustable text size
• Low Vision: Atkinson Hyperlegible, extra-large captions, stronger contrast and bold text
• Focused Reader: a calm serif reading page and a quick focus check-in after you listen
Eight reading fonts in all, including Lexend, Andika and Comic Neue.
A LITTLE COMPANY
• Pick a hand-drawn companion from 14 animals. It greets you on Home and lives in your Profile's reading nook
• Map who's who: hand-drawn faces for the characters, and the ties between them
THE SMALL THINGS
• Rest days: earn one for every 7 days in a row, so a missed day doesn't break your streak
• Smart Rewind backs up 3 to 20 seconds when you press play, depending on how long you were away
• Sleep timer by minutes or at the end of a chapter. In its last minute the screen warms and dims
• ±30 s skips from the Lock Screen, Control Center and AirPods
• Home Screen quick actions, and Light, Dark or Auto appearance
FREE AND PRO
Free: transcription and read-along for every book, highlights, notes and quotes, Discover, Audiobookshelf downloads, the character map, companions, streaks with rest days, milestone badges and your first ebook.
HushBook Pro (subscription or one-time purchase) adds:
• Analytics across This week, Habits and Books: a reading engagement score, finish-by forecasts, personal records, goals, a listening calendar, and month and year in review
• Per-book Insights: your pace, sessions and check-in journal
• Unlimited ebooks
• Audiobookshelf progress sync
• An English dictionary for the words you don't know
• Extra cover designs and four alternate app icons
• HushBook Desktop: transcribe on your computer, and move a book with its transcript and ebook as a .hushbook file

apple-macos:6811511316.name: FodWise: FODMAP Food Tracker
apple-macos:6811511316.description:
FodWise is a low-FODMAP diary built around how much you eat and what you combine it with, not a yes-or-no food list.
Log meals and symptoms in a few taps. FodWise looks for patterns before harder days, one FODMAP group at a time, and tells you when there isn't enough data yet. A pattern is not a cause.
Move the portion slider to see where a group becomes worth watching and where it becomes notable. Build a meal to see when modest portions of the same group add up, and which ingredient to cut back.
Plan reintroduction challenges one group at a time. Log each day's portion and follow the trend in your entries. Skipped days stay skipped.
Scan ingredient labels offline to flag inulin, chicory root, polyols and the many names for onion. The optional barcode lookup sends only the barcode and can be switched off.
Explore 60 food swaps, each with an explanation of why it works, and 16 original articles on topics including portions, stacking, label reading and eating out.
Your data stays on your device. There is no account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics and no server. You can export or delete everything.
FodWise is educational only, not medical advice or a diagnosis. Work with a doctor or dietitian when following a low-FODMAP diet. Food figures are illustrative examples, labeled as sample data in the app. FodWise is not affiliated with Monash University.

 Cross-platform: Available on Linux, Windows, and Android, so you can access your lists from
 anywhere.
 Open source: Adventure List is open source, so you can contribute to its development or customize
 it to your liking.
 Adventure List is ready to help you get things done. Download it today and start your adventure!

flathub:com.github.robertsanseries.ciano.description:
The easiest way to convert your multimedia files to the most popular formats.
 Characteristics:
 Conversion of multiple files at the same time
 Possibility of changing the output folder
 Notification support
 Close the application at any time with Ctrl + Q
 Supports the conversion of:
 Video - MP4, MPG, AVI, WMV, FLV, MKV, 3GP, MOV, VOB, OGV, WEBM

flathub:com.github.wwmm.pulseeffects.name: PulseEffects
flathub:com.github.wwmm.pulseeffects.description:
PulseEffects is an advanced audio manipulation tools. It includes an
 equalizer, limiter, compressor and a reverberation tool, just to mention
 a few. To complement this there is also a built in spectrum analyzer.
 Because PulseEffects uses the default PulseAudio sound server it will
 work with most, if not all, applications you use. All supported
 applications are presented in the main window, where each can be enabled
 individually.
 Besides manipulating sound output, PulseEffects is able to apply effects
 to an input device, such as a microphone. This is, for example, useful in
 audio recording, but it also works well during voice conversations.
 When PulseEffects is launched it will conveniently remember the
 configuration used in the last session. It is also possible to save
 all the current settings as profiles.

flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indidatabase.name: indiDatabase
flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indidatabase.summary: Build your own database — no programming required
flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indidatabase.description:
indiDatabase is a desktop database for people who are not programmers, in the tradition of FileMaker
 Pro and Lotus Approach. Design tables, draw forms, save finds, and print reports — everything lives
 in one file on your own computer, and the whole office can work in it together over your own network
 with no server product and no cloud.
 Features include:
 Tables designed point-and-click, with nine field types including exact decimal amounts for
 money
 Forms drawn for each table, with find-by-filling-in-the-form, related-record panels, and
 buttons that run the day's routine
 Six kinds of reports: grouped lists, certificates, Avery label sheets, form letters, crosstabs,
 and charts — with questions asked when a report runs
 Saved finds with found-set counts, and a Summarise mode that groups and totals without a
 formula
 Calculated fields, summary fields over related records, validation rules, starting values,
 and relationships on one field pair or several
 Conditional formatting and named styles, stored in the file so every desk draws the same
 warnings
 A Home dashboard of pinned reports and worksheets, the same on every desk
 Multi-user sharing on your own network: pairing codes, TLS with pinned fingerprints, live
 updates, record locking by name, and a field-by-field merge when two people collide
 Users, roles, record-level and field-level security, and an audit trail stamped by the engine
 Import from CSV and legacy dBase files (including FoxPro-era memo files); export the found
 set to CSV
 Automatic backups with restore points, taken safely while the file is in use
 indiDatabase respects your privacy and works entirely offline. Your database is a single SQLite-backed
 file on your own computer and never leaves your machine.

flathub:com.microsoft.Edge.name: Microsoft Edge
flathub:com.microsoft.Edge.summary: Introducing the new Microsoft Edge web browser. It’s time to expect more. More privacy. More control. More productivity. More value.

Browse the web anywhere with one seamless experience from your phone to your computer and other
 signed-in devices.
 Microsoft Edge gives you the tools to protect your privacy online with features like tracking
 prevention, AdBlock Plus, InPrivate browsing and InPrivate search in Microsoft Bing.
 Organize the web in a way that cuts through the clutter, making it easier to find, view, and
 manage your content on the go.
 With world class compatibility, performance, and new features, Microsoft Edge is the only web
 browser you’ll ever need.

flathub:com.xnview.XnViewMP.description:
XnView MP is a versatile and powerful photo viewer, image management, image resizer. XnView
 is one of the most stable, easy-to-use, and comprehensive photo editors. All common picture and
 graphics formats are supported (JPEG, TIFF, PNG, GIF, WEBP, PSD, JPEG2000, OpenEXR, camera RAW,
 HEIC, PDF, DNG, CR2).

flathub:fi.skyjake.Lagrange.name: Lagrange
flathub:fi.skyjake.Lagrange.description:
Lagrange is a versatile client for browsing Geminispace. It offers modern conveniences familiar
 from web browsers, such as smooth scrolling, inline image viewing, multiple tabs, visual themes,
 Unicode fonts, bookmarks, history, and page outlines.
 Lagrange is designed to be platform-independent. It relies on a small number of essential libraries
 for complex features like text rendering and cryptography, but otherwise it is written in straightforward
 C11. It uses SDL for hardware-accelerated graphics and OpenSSL for secure communications.

flathub:io.github.diegopvlk.Dosage.description:
Easily manage and track treatments with Dosage: notifications, history, multiple doses, flexible frequency, customization, stock monitoring, and duration control
 Features:
 Notifications — Get reminders at the right time
 History — See which medications you took, skipped or missed
 Dosage management — Multiple doses with different times
 Frequency modes — Every day, specific days, cycle or just when necessary
 Color and icon — Give a shape for your treatment
 Inventory tracking — Monitor your stock and get reminded when it's low
 Duration — Define the start and end dates

flathub:io.github.electronstudio.WeylusC.name: Weylus Community Edition
flathub:io.github.electronstudio.WeylusC.summary: Use your tablet as graphic tablet/touch screen on your computer
flathub:io.github.electronstudio.WeylusC.description:
Weylus turns your tablet or smart phone into a graphic tablet/touch screen for your computer!
 Control your mouse with your tablet
 Mirror your screen to your tablet
 Send keyboard input using physical keyboards

 Support for a stylus/pen (supports pressure and tilt)

flathub:io.github.lxndr.gswatcher.description:

flathub:org.freedesktop.fwupd.name: fwupd
flathub:org.freedesktop.fwupd.description:
This project aims to make updating firmware on Linux automatic, safe and reliable. You can either
 use a GUI software manager like GNOME Software to view and apply updates, the command-line tool
 or the D-Bus interface directly.
 The fwupd process is a system daemon to allow session software to update device firmware on
 your local machine. It is designed for desktops, but this project is also usable on phones, tablets
 and on headless servers.

flathub:org.gottcode.Simsu.name: Simsu
flathub:org.gottcode.Simsu.summary: Fill in numbers to solve puzzles
flathub:org.gottcode.Simsu.description: Simsu is a basic Sudoku game. You can switch between filling in notes (pencil mode), or filling in answers (pen mode). To make it easier to see where to place numbers, you can highlight all instances of a number. You can also check your answers for correctness while playing. The game stores your current notes and answers, so that you can pick up where you left off the next time you play.

flathub:sa.sy.bluerecorder.name: Blue Recorder
flathub:sa.sy.bluerecorder.summary: A simple screen recorder for Linux desktop. Supports Wayland & Xorg
flathub:sa.sy.bluerecorder.description: A simple desktop recorder for Linux systems. Built using Rust, GTK+ 4 and ffmpeg. It supports recording audio and video on almost all Linux interfaces with support for Wayland display server on GNOME session. The following formats are currently supported: mkv, avi, mp4, wmv, gif and nut (And only WebM for Wayland's GNOME session). You can stop the recording process easily by right-clicking the icon and choosing "Stop Record". Or middle-clicking the recording icon in the notifications area (but doesn't work on all interfaces). You can choose the audio input source you want from the list. You can also set the default values you want by simply changing them in the interface, and the program will save them for you for the next time you open it. Based on GREEN RECORDER but rewritten in RUST

The "Georgian-Italian Dictionary" and "Georgian Prayers" were printed in Rome, 1629, by Stephano Paolini and Nikiphore Irbach (Irubakhidze-Cholokashvili). fedora-packages:golang-github-patrickmn-.description: Go-cache is an in-memory key:value store/cache similar to memcached that is suitable for applications running on a single machine. Its major advantage is that, being essentially a thread-safe map[string]interface{} with expiration times, it doesn't need to serialize or transmit its contents over the network. Any object can be stored, for a given duration or forever, and the cache can be safely used by multiple goroutines. Although Go-cache isn't meant to be used as a persistent datastore, the entire cache can be saved to and loaded from a file (using c.Items() to retrieve the items map to serialize, and NewFrom() to create a cache from a deserialized one) to recover from downtime quickly. (See the docs for NewFrom() for caveats.) This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/patrickmn/go-cache

firefox-addons:2802834.description:
Over the past decade, it's become clear that open source software has won. Sharing code freely has made it drastically cheaper and faster to build software – and tech innovation has accelerated as a result. But security has often been an afterthought.
We are a team of open source maintainers with over 1 billion monthly downloads to our names. Working on the frontlines of open source, we've witnessed firsthand how supply chain attacks have swept across our communities and damaged trust in open source.
The entire security industry is obsessed with identifying known vulnerabilities. There are hundreds of variations of CVE scanners, but they all miss the point. Looking for known vulnerabilities is reactive. Vulnerabilities take weeks or months to be discovered. In today's culture of fast development, a malicious dependency can be updated, merged, and running in production in days or even hours.
Unlike other tools, Socket detects and blocks supply chain attacks before they strike, mitigating the worst consequences. Socket uses deep package inspection to peel back the layers of a dependency to characterize its actual behavior.
Want to defend your entire organization against open-source attacks? Install the Socket Security GitHub app and get protected today!

firefox-addons:2725513.name: Google Translate Engine
firefox-addons:2725513.summary: OpenSearch engine for Google Translate including suggestions aka autocompletion.
firefox-addons:2725513.description:
A Google Translate search engine integrated with Google's autocomplete API via x-suggestions. Like other good OpenSearch engines for Firefox, it will guess what you're trying to type and offer common completions to display in the search/url bar results. Since search engines can only pass a single user-defined parameter, the query, the other parameters are predefined. This means the source language and target language are both always set to auto.
So you begin typing a given query that you want to translate such as "trad" and Google will guess that the input language is Spanish, and then will guess that you want to type something like "traductor" or "traducir" and will offer these as autocomplete suggestions. If you click one of them, it will navigate to Google Translate with the chosen query typed into the input box.
Google Translate will then guess the target language (the language into which you're trying to translate the query) based on your previous behavior on Google Translate, or perhaps if you have a Google account it will choose whatever Google's big brother identity tracking system has deduced to be your primary language. If you usually use English or if English was the most recent target language you manually selected on translate.google.com , it will translate "traductor" into English and you'll get "translator" as your result.
This extension also includes a custom icon with context properties so it can be made to look good with both light and dark themes.

• Simple and easy UI/UX

• Multiple unique level

Koala Wallet is your all-in-one app for exploring Web3 with ease, security, and style. Perfect for beginners and experts alike, Koala Wallet makes managing your crypto and DeFi assets a breeze—all with zero fees.

- Fast & Easy Transactions: Send and receive assets instantly across multiple chains, including Ethereum, Polygon, Base, and Solana.
- A Beautiful Home for NFTs: Store, manage, and showcase your NFTs in a stunning visual display.
- Discover dApps and Ecosystems: Access the latest dApps and explore Web3 ecosystems with ease using WalletConnect.

- Biometric Security: Unlock your wallet with face or fingerprint ID for added peace of mind.
Everything You Need in One App
- No Hidden Fees: Koala Wallet is 100% free to use, with no surprise fees for transactions.
- Real-Time Alerts: Get instant updates on your transactions and wallet activity.
- Support for 15+ Languages: Koala Wallet speaks your language, no matter where you are.
Ready to dive into Web3? Download Koala Wallet and take control of your crypto journey today!

Unlock the Secrets Hidden in Your Face with Face DNA: AI Ethnicity Test!
Ever wondered about your roots? Curious where your facial features truly come from? Face DNA harnesses the power of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) to analyze y
bluejetty:00153199:ios.description:
Unlock the Secrets Hidden in Your Face with Face DNA: AI Ethnicity Test!
Ever wondered about your roots? Curious where your facial features truly come from? Face DNA harnesses the power of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) to analyze your photo and deliver a fascinating estimation of your heritage, ethnicity, traits, and even connections to ancient civilizations! Forget waiting weeks for DNA kits – get insightful ancestry reports right from your phone in minutes.
Discover Your Origins Instantly
Simply upload a selfie or any clear photo of a face, and let our cutting-edge AI face scanner get to work. Our sophisticated algorithms compare facial features against a vast database encompassing millions of faces from diverse populations worldwide. Get ready to embark on a unique journey of self-discovery!
Why Choose Face DNA for Your Ancestry Exploration?
• Advanced AI Face Analysis: Our powerful AI engine performs a detailed facial feature analysis, identifying subtle clues linked to different population groups and potential heritage origins. This is your AI-powered ethnicity analyzer!
• Comprehensive Heritage Reports: Go beyond simple percentages! Receive a personalized report detailing:
 • Estimated Modern Population Matches (Explore potential connections across the globe)
 • Key Facial Feature Insights (Understand how specific features contribute)
 • Unique Trait Analysis (Discover links between facial structure and heritage)
 • Extrapolated Ancient Civilization Matches: (Our standout feature! Explore fascinating potential links to ancient groups based on extrapolated data – where might your deep roots lie?)
• Instant Results, No DNA Kit Needed: Get your ancestry estimation fast! All you need is a photo – no swabs, no labs, no waiting. Perfect for quick insights and satisfying curiosity.
• Easy & Fun to Use: Our intuitive interface makes exploring your heritage simple and engaging. See a sample report, then scan your own face!
• Explore and Share: Discover surprising connections and share your fascinating results with friends and family. Spark conversations about heritage and diversity!
How Face DNA Works:
1. Upload Your Photo: Choose a clear, front-facing photo from your gallery or take a new one.
2. AI Scan & Analysis: Our AI gets to work, analyzing dozens of facial points and comparing them to our extensive database.
3. Receive Your Report: Get your detailed heritage estimation report, including modern populations, traits, and unique ancient civilization connections, delivered directly in the app.
Your Face Tells a Story. What Will Yours Reveal?
From Mediterranean influences to echoes of ancient empires, Face DNA offers a unique, AI-driven perspective on your possible lineage. It's a fun, engaging way to connect with your potential past and explore the rich tapestry of human history reflected in your own features.
Ready to start your AI ancestry journey?
Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you at info@facedna.app.
Download Face DNA now and uncover the fascinating origins hinted at in your face!
---
Disclaimer:
Face DNA utilizes advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning algorithms to provide an estimation of ancestry and heritage based on facial feature analysis. Our AI compares uploaded photos to patterns learned from a large dataset. The results are intended for entertainment, personal exploration, and informational purposes only. This is not a scientific DNA test and should not be considered a definitive or biologically accurate determination of genetic ancestry, ethnicity, or nationality. Results do not provide the same level of precision or scientific validation as genetic DNA testing. Enjoy Face DNA as a fun tool to explore potential heritage connections suggested by facial characteristics.

bluejetty:00065974:ios.description:
Track every Magic: The Gathering card you own — and check what they're worth, every day, automatically.

bluejetty:00119754:ios.description:
West Side Transport now has the technology to turn your smart phone or tablet into a device that will make your life easier out on the open road. No more stopping to find a truck stop scanner when you have this app. Instead of having to locate a scanner at a truck stop you now can take a picture of the documents you need to scan and send into payroll for easier processing. Helps get your Trip Documents in on time and get you paid. Receive and send HR Documents, Breakdown reports, Accident and OS&D reports all through the app.
How nice would it be to be able to communicate with dispatch or your driver manager without having to be in the actual truck? Now you can send and receive messages from dispatch, send and receive loads, preplans and confirm with dispatch. Also put in arrival and departure times and pickup activity. View each stop along the route on the map with fuel stops within each load. Show current location weather and forecast. Videos from safety training, dispatch or company updates. Also take advantage of West Side Transport driver referral program by referring other drivers.

bluejetty:00073901:ios.name: Even Longer
bluejetty:00073901:ios.summary:
Even Longer is a professional long-exposure camera for iPhone and iPad — and the first long-exposure app on the App Store to shoot 48 MP and Apple ProRAW.
You set the exposure — a duration or a frame count. The camera captures a continuous
bluejetty:00073901:ios.description:
Even Longer is a professional long-exposure camera for iPhone and iPad — and the first long-exposure app on the App Store to shoot 48 MP and Apple ProRAW.
You set the exposure — a duration or a frame count. The camera captures a continuous frame sequence to that target and merges it live on the GPU, under full manual control. Thirty seconds or three hours is a number you enter, not a shutter you hold. What lands in your library is a real RAW.
iPHONE 18 PRO VARIABLE APERTURE
Supported from day one: an aperture button and ruler on the camera screen, every stop the lens offers, and the f-number in your files. On iPhones with a fixed iris the control simply stays hidden.
48 MP AND APPLE PRORAW
Long exposures at the sensor's full 48-megapixel readout, and merged results written as Apple ProRAW. Maximum resolution works in frame averaging with ProRAW, TIFF, HEIC or JPEG on iPhones with a 48 MP sensor; ProRAW needs a ProRAW-capable iPhone.
RAW OUTPUT, AND SHADOWIQ
Merged results save as RAW (DNG), Apple ProRAW, TIFF, HEIC or JPEG — with a fallback order you control. When a lens or mode can't produce the format you picked, the camera saves the next one it can and tells you why, without ever changing your choice. The RAW is worth the wait: dramatically more detail in the shadows and cleaner blacks than any earlier version, and ShadowIQ goes further still: shadow detail with even less noise, and no need to bracket exposures any more.
WHAT YOU CAN SHOOT
• Frame averaging — silky water, cleaner night shots, crowds that fade away (a computed ND filter)
• Light Trails — traffic, light painting, fireworks
• Star Trails — with a celestial overlay that projects the pole, constellations and the expected trails onto your viewfinder before you commit
FULL MANUAL CONTROL
ISO, shutter, focus, white balance, EV and aperture — with live histogram, grid and spirit level overlays, tap-to-focus and a loupe. Per-lens focal length, sensor size and crop factor are measured on your hardware, so your metadata is right.
PLAN AND AUTOMATE
Schedule a capture for sunset or astronomical night on the built-in sun-altitude timeline, run the intervalometer for sequences, and let interim saves protect long exposures against interruptions.
REMOTE CONTROL AND APPLE WATCH
Pair the Even Longer Remote app (iPhone, iPad or Mac) and control the camera from a distance: live viewfinder, full manual control, live progress, and finished files delivered to the controller. Pairing is TLS-secured on your local network; an off-grid hotspot mode works in the field without any router. The Apple Watch app — live viewfinder, shutter, progress — comes with the app.
THE APP, AND PRO — READ BEFORE BUYING
Even Longer is a paid app: one purchase, no ads, no data collection, nothing sold on. It gets you the whole camera — every accumulation mode, JPEG and HEIC output including 48 MP, variable aperture, histogram, grid and spirit level, the Apple Watch app and the iPad layout.
PRO is an optional in-app purchase that upgrades this app — monthly, yearly, or once and forever. The subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel them. These features are NOT included without PRO: RAW (DNG), Apple ProRAW and TIFF output, ShadowIQ, the celestial overlay, remote control, scheduled capture, the intervalometer, interim saves and anamorphic desqueeze. They are marked PRO in the app. Entitlements are checked on device, so PRO keeps working where there is no signal.
TWO APPS, ONE CAMERA
• Even Longer — this app: the camera, paid, with the optional PRO upgrade.
• Even Longer Remote — the controller for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It needs an Even Longer camera with remote control (PRO) switched on.
Built for photographers who plan the shot — and want the file to be worth the wait.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.even-longer.cam/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.even-longer.cam/privacy

bluejetty:00032578:ios.description:
Get the latest Maryland lottery numbers within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Powerball Xs & Os
- Multi-Match
- Bonus Match 5
- Pick 3 (Midday and Evening)
- Pick 4 (Midday and Evening)
- Pick 5 (Midday and Evening)
Powerball, Mega Millions, Powerball Xs & Os and Multi-Match also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level. 
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.
Disclaimer
----------------------------
This app is not associated or connected to the Maryland Lottery and Gaming Control Agency.

bluejetty:00179770:ios.description:
Yukon Solitaire & Russian Solitaire: Classic Card Game Fun!
How to Play Yukon Solitaire:
1. Arrange the 4 foundations from Ace to King.
2. Stack the 7 tableau piles in descending order (from high to low) and alternating colors. For example, a Jack of Spades can be placed on a Queen of Hearts.
3. Build up in the foundations, from Ace to King, using the same suit.
4. Complete each suit (hearts, diamonds, spades, and clubs) from A -> K to win!
How to Play Russian Solitaire:
1. Arrange the 4 foundations from Ace to King.
2. Stack the 7 tableau piles in descending order (from high to low) and with the same suit. For instance, a Jack of Spades can be placed on a Queen of Spades.
3. Build up in the foundations, from Ace to King, using the same suit.

Key Differences from Classic Solitaire:
1. No draw pile.
2. You can move entire card stacks, even if they aren’t in a perfect sequence. Just ensure the top card of your moving stack matches the sequence with the last card in your end stack.
Features:

3. Build up in the foundations, from Ace to King, using the same suit.
4. Complete each suit (hearts, diamonds, spades, and clubs) from A -> K to win!

1. Arrange the 4 foundations from Ace to King.
2. Stack the 7 tableau piles in descending order (from high to low) and with the same suit. For instance, a Jack of Spades can be placed on a Queen of Spades.
3. Build up in the foundations, from Ace to King, using the same suit.
4. Complete each suit (hearts, diamonds, spades, and clubs) from A -> K to win!

Key Differences from Classic Solitaire:
1. No draw pile.

bluejetty:00160610:ios.description:
Stōkt is the app for spray wall climbing — at the gym or on your own wall. Browse community problems, set your own, log sends, and track your training.
There are more than 2000 walls on Stōkt, and we're always adding more. If you don't see yours, send us a message and we'll get in touch with your gym.
HOW IT WORKS 
Select your gym wall and get started. Climb problems from your community, or put your setting to the test and create new ones. To set a problem, select the holds, hit publish, and it's ready for others. Check the accuracy of your grading against the setter and the crowd. We support Hueco, Font, and DanKyu.
Or add your own wall: take a photo, Stōkt scans the holds, and you can start setting and climbing for free.
HOME WALLS 
Stōkt is built for training at home too. Set up your wall in minutes with automatic wall scan — take a photo and Stōkt detects the holds. Edit, move, or add holds whenever you want. Invite friends to set problems for you and keep sessions interesting. You can start free and upgrade when you need more.
COMMUNITY 
Connect with friends and climbers from your gym and see who can send your problems. Search for and follow other climbers to grow your network. Add comments to share beta, tips, or just cheer people on. Get notified when someone likes or comments on your problem.
PERFORMANCE & TRAINING 
Log climbs and attempts to see how you're progressing. Take on fresh problems to push your climbing. Use detailed charts and stats to get a clear view of your training.
MORE FEATURES 
Follow climbers and see activity from your gym in the feed. Create public or private lists — warm-ups, projects, or a style you want to work on. Tag problems (crimpy, slopey, pinchy) and filter by style to find the next climb.
STŌKT PRO 
Stōkt Pro is the gym subscription that enhances your experience:
Create official gym lists and add up to 4 extra admin accounts.
Benchmarking: Create benchmarks or tag existing climbs so climbers have clear goals. 
Gym analytics: See how your wall is used — climbs created, sends, active climbers, and trends over time. 
Competitions: Run competitions from gym lists.
Adjustable walls: Support for adjustable-angle walls (coming soon).
LEDS 
Light up any spray wall with the Stōkt LED kit. The kit works on home walls and gym walls. We supply LED strips, available now in the EU and UK, and coming soon elsewhere. 
If you have questions, feedback, or ideas, email us at team@getstokt.com
Subscription Restore & Renewal Info: Monthly subscriptions are billed via Apple's subscription service.

Study for the DMV written test in Spanish. Real exam questions for your state, every answer explained, and it all works offline.
This app is entirely in Spanish, made for Spanish speakers in the United States. Pick your state and the app uses that state's real exam format: number of questions, passing score and time limit. All 50 states and Washington D.C.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Practice tests by state, with the correct answer and why.
• Exam simulator in your state's exact format, with a timer.
• Daily practice with spaced repetition and a streak.
• Your mistakes, saved and repeated until you get them right.
• Weak topics: see what you struggle with and drill only that.
• Marathon: every question of your state, resumable.
• 400+ road signs explained in Spanish and English, with a quiz.
• A short handbook of the rules that show up on the test, including REAL ID.
• A one-screen cheat sheet of your state's key numbers.
• Spanish–English driving terms with pronunciation and flashcards.
• Phrases for the DMV counter and the road test, with audio.
• A what-to-bring checklist for your DMV visit.
• Progress: readiness in percent, attempt history and what to do today.
WORKS OFFLINE
All content ships with the app. No signal needed.
PREMIUM (optional)
Daily practice, marathon, topics, signs, handbook, terms and phrases are free. Premium unlocks all practice tests, unlimited simulators, the full mistakes bank, the full cheat sheet and removes ads. Monthly, yearly, or one-time forever.
Subscriptions are charged to your Apple account at confirmation and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your account settings.

bluejetty:00139650:ios.description:
Step into a realm of self-exploration and personal growth with DreamsBook, your comprehensive guide to dream interpretation and analysis. Dive beneath the surface of your everyday thoughts to unearth the meanings behind your dreams, which can offer you a deeper understanding of your psyche, assist you in identifying your life patterns, aid in self-discovery, and even help improve your sleep quality.
Do you often dream about death, pregnancy, falling, or being chased? Or perhaps you experience dreams about losing teeth or infidelity? The DreamsBook application is here to help you decode these symbols and uncover the hidden messages your subconscious is trying to communicate.
Key Features:
1. Dream Interpretation & Analysis: Ever been baffled by what your dreams are attempting to convey? Utilize our dream interpretation tool to shed light on your life events and decipher the hidden meanings in your dreams. Whether it's dreams of death signifying transformation, dreams about being pregnant indicating new beginnings, or dreams about falling suggesting feelings of insecurity, DreamsBook can help you navigate your subconscious.
2. Personalized Dream Therapy: With our personalized dream therapy, connect with our professional dream interpreters for a detailed analysis. They can help you decipher dreams about being chased, suggesting you might be avoiding something in your waking life, or dreams of losing teeth, which can often symbolize anxiety or significant life changes.
3. Dream Journal: Keep track of your nightly adventures with our Dream Journal. Note down dreams about cheating, possibly indicating feelings of guilt or insecurity, and spot patterns over time to get a deeper understanding of your subconscious mind.
4. Unique Artwork: Transform your dreams into tangible art with our unique artwork feature. Express your subconscious musings and bring to life your dreams, whether they're joyful, terrifying, or downright strange.
DreamsBook doesn't merely help you understand what your dreams mean. By analyzing dream patterns and themes, it can provide valuable insights into your emotional state, relationships, career path, and more. It empowers you to confront your fears, explore your desires, and understand yourself better, thus fostering personal growth and self-awareness.
As you sleep tonight, remember that each dream is a step towards understanding yourself better. Wake up to a world filled with self-discovery, personal growth, and subconscious exploration with DreamsBook. Download now and embark on your enlightening journey of dream analysis!
DreamsBook - Decode your dreams, unlock your mind.
Privacy Policy: https://dreamsbookapp.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://dreamsbookapp.com/terms/

bluejetty:00173619:ios.description:
App description:
MBODY is a health and fitness app with programs designed to help you increase strength, build muscle, and become more confident and consistent with your workouts to finally achieve your goals - without spending hours in the gym. Take the guesswork out of your training and join a supportive and engaging community of hundreds of women with this easy to follow, effective weekly workout programming. Whether you are working out in the gym, at home, or on the go, there’s a program to meet your needs.
App Features:
 1. Programs designed for YOU - no matter where you are in your fitness journey, there’s a program here to meet your needs 
 2. New workouts uploaded each month 
 3. Log workouts, track weights and reps, and see weight history 
 4. Video demos and detailed instructions for every exercise 
 5. Built in rest timer 
 6. Nutrition tips and recipes 
 7. One on one nutrition guidance to create an all encompassing plan specifically for you and your goals
 8. A private community where you’ll connect with hundreds of like minded women also on their health and fitness journey. Gone are the days of feeling alone on your journey - we’re all in this together! 
 9. Receive direct access to me for questions and support!
 10. Integrates with Apple Health to display your daily health metrics on the profile to help track your progress.
Learn more about our 3 core programs below:
Begin to MOVE: 
* 8 week beginner progressive strength program 
* 3 day split (upper, lower, total body)
* Home and gym plan available 
* Designed for anyone who is new to strength training or those returning after taking some time off 
* Goal is to help you build a solid foundation of strength so you feel strong and confident to join us in the ongoing MOVE monthly progressive programming
MOVE More:
* 8 week intermediate progressive strength program
* 4 day split (2 upper, 2 lower) but can be condensed to 2-3 days 
* Minimal equipment needed - DB / bands only 
* Quick and effective workouts designed to be completed in 40-45 minutes 
* Throughout the 8 weeks, you'll be working the same muscle groups with slightly different variations
MOVE Monthly:
* Most popular program within the Made to Move app
* 4 days split (upper, lower) with optional 5th day - total body 
* Gym and home plan (home plan requires db/bands only)
* Hypertrophy based program designed to build lean muscle and improve overall body composition 
This is so much more than just a fitness app - it’s the support and guidance you need to build mental and physical strength to develop lifelong sustainable habits and behaviors to look and feel your best.
Are you ready to MOVE with us? Start today! 
——————
Learn more about our terms of service at https://api.ongo.app/tos or privacy policy at https://api.ongo.app/privacy

bluejetty:00069190:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00069190:ios.description:
"Drambo changes the face of iOS music apps." Cult of Mac
Drambo is your all-in-one sound laboratory that adapts to your workflow: build beats as a groovebox, design synths, or transform audio with effects, standalone or inside your favorite DAW.
At the core of Drambo is a fresh approach to modular design that makes creating with modules easy, fun, and accessible. Connections happen automatically as you add or move modules, so there are no messy cables to slow you down. The interface adapts to your workflow, generating modulation controls when you need them, and even lets modules contain other modules for perfect organization. You’re always free to override the automatic connections, but most of the time, you can just dive in, experiment, and shape sounds without getting tangled in wires.
Use a deep and innovative sequencer to compose patterns and whole tracks, for production or live performance. Go beyond simple looping sequences with parameter locking, conditional step components, parameters automation and powerful scene morphing. Drambo works equally well as a self-contained standalone app or audio unit plugin with audio and MIDI connectivity as an AUV3 instrument, audio effect and MIDI effect. 
You can use Drambo as
• A Complete Studio: Produce entire tracks and perform live in a self-contained, multitrack environment.
• An Endless modular playground, that allows you to build, modify and store custom instruments and effects. For instance: build a custom synth, sample and resample, build a Theremin using a gyroscope module, or turn your table into a playable surface, by processing microphone input with physical modelling modules. 
• An Advanced MIDI Sequencer: Control hardware or AUv3 instruments. Generate custom MIDI CC messages or send modulation signals to physical modular synths via DC-coupled interfaces.
• The Ultimate AUv3 Plugin: Load Drambo inside other DAWs as an instrument, audio effect, or MIDI processor. Replace dozens of standard plugins by building your own complex modular delays, reverbs, decimators, or modulators in seconds.
• A Unified Audio-Visual Studio (Drambo Visual IAP): Arts united. Step into another realm of modular visual synthesis to build complex generative video art, or seamlessly patch your audio and visual engines together for deeply integrated performances.
Features:
• Polyphonic, stereo processing and audio-rate modulation. All signals are equal. Up to 16 voices per modular instrument rack.
• Unique modular concept: cable-less, drag'n'drop, color coding dynamic interface, automatic connections, and customizable compact, rack views.
• Directional flow makes Drambo routing and patching straightforward. Signal flows only left to right, so there are no instant feedback routings in Drambo. Delayed feedback is possible using certain modules.
• Simple and clean interface, that scales to every size and device orientation
• Over 140 modules available, such as: oscillators, samplers, physical modelling modules, LFOs, envelope generators, filters, audio effects, mixers, MIDI processors, sequencers and math functions. (Includes a macro oscillator based on the famous Eurorack Plaits module, with 24 synth engines)
• Custom modular racks that can be nested, with presets at the track, rack, and module level.
• Clip launcher / song arrager. 
• 16-tracks, polyphonic sequencer with parameter locks, automation and step components. 8 dedicated step sequence editor types, piano-roll, powerful automation designer with drawing modes and cubic Bezier curves.
• Audio Units hosting ( standalone app only )
• Morph groups: you can morph many parameters using a single slider.
• Available as a standalone app, AUv3 instrument, effect and MIDI effect.
• MIDI and Ableton Link support
Drambo is all about control. Control things that other apps don’t even give you access to.
Visit the BeepStreet page for help and tutorials, and Patchstorage for community content.

bluejetty:00127405:ios.description:
Universal TV Remote is a virtual remote that allows you to control your Smart TV from your iPhone.
works with Fire Stick, Sharp, Insigni, Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, Panasonic,TCL Roku, Roku sticks, Hitachi, Telefunken, Grundig, Continental Edison TV and more...
To use this remote control, your iPhone must be on the same Wi-fi network as your TV.
Detection of your TV will be automatic and depending on the model of your TV, you will have to accept the message that will appear on your TV screen.
The app works through WIFI, so you do not have to be close to the TV to make it works.
With a realistic design, you can use all the functions of the original remote control very easily.
This app supports the most famous TV brands like Amazon Fire TV, Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart Tv and LG Web OS, Sony Bravia, Philips, Panasonic viera, Telefunken, Grundig, Hitachi and Continental Edison.

-Change the volume
-Change the channel number
-Use navigation pad
-Video control (Play/Pause/Stop...)
-Menu, Options, Info, Tools
-Power off
If you have any suggestions, feel free to contact us.

Looking for a one-stop fashion destination? You’ve found it! REDTAG offers everything you need to express your unique style under one digital roof. Whether you’re updating your wardrobe or refreshing your home, REDTAG is designed to help you do it effortlessly. Step into a world of fashion and lifestyle essentials tailored just for you!
REDTAG Online Shopping App
Shop for fashion and lifestyle essentials on the go with the REDTAG app! With a diverse collection and simple, convenient features, our app makes finding what you need faster and easier. Discover the latest trends for Women, Men, Girls, Boys, and Home at the click of a button.
REDTAG App Features
The REDTAG app is designed to make your shopping experience as enjoyable and efficient as possible. Our key features include:
1. User-Friendly Interface: Browse effortlessly through well-organised categories and collections for a smooth online shopping experience.
2. Personalised Recommendations: Get tailored suggestions that make it easier to find styles you’ll love.
3. Wishlist: Save your favourite items and shop them when you’re ready.
4. Size Guide: Never worry about fit with comprehensive size charts available for all products.
5. Feedback Feature: We value your input! Use our in-app feedback option to help us continuously improve.
6. Exclusive Seasonal Offers: Access festive promotions, including phone-exclusive deals and app-only sales.
7. First-Time Buyer Discount: Use the code APP15 and get 15% off on your first order!
8. Instalment Plans: Enjoy the freedom to spread your payments over time! Shop now and pay later with flexible instalment options through Tamara and Tabby. 
9. Multilingual Assistance: Switch between Arabic and English and shop specifically for your region.
10. In-App Support: Need help? Get assistance anytime, right within the app.
REDTAG Online Shopping Collections
Discover an extensive range of shopping categories to suit all tastes and needs.
• Women’s Fashion: Find a world of style with dresses, tops, skirts, jumpsuits, outerwear, and more. Designed for every occasion, our women’s collection brings you fashion-forward pieces.
• Men’s Fashion: From formal wear to casual essentials, explore shirts, trousers, suits, and accessories. Our men’s collection offers versatile styles for every occasion, ensuring a perfect look.
• Boys & Girls: Dress your children in the latest styles with our Boys’ and Girls’ collections. Choose from durable, comfortable clothes, shoes, and accessories, all crafted to keep up with their active lifestyles.
• Homeware: Elevate your living space with an exclusive range of home essentials, from bedding to stylish décor items.
Benefits of Using the REDTAG App
Shopping with the REDTAG app means more than just convenience. 
• Loyalty Program: Earn points on every purchase, redeemable for exciting rewards and discounts.
• Data Protection: We prioritise your data privacy and ensure safe, encrypted transactions.
• Quality & Warranty: Our products come with quality assurance and warranty support.
• Easy Exchanges: Exchange your items anytime, anywhere, with ease.
• Convenient Delivery Options: Choose between home delivery or pick up from a nearby REDTAG store.
• Flexible Payment Options: You can pay on delivery or use your credit/debit card.
Offers & Discounts
With REDTAG, enjoy amazing deals like Buy 2, Get 2 Free and exclusive seasonal promotions! From Singles' Day specials to the Ramadan Bonanza, each season brings incredible savings.
Contact Us
Need help? Reach out to our support team directly at no-reply@
redtag-stores.com. We’re here to ensure your shopping experience is as satisfying as possible.

bluejetty:00164662:ios.description:
Watchful turns your iPhone, iPad, or Mac into a security camera. Your footage is securely stored on your device or in your private iCloud storage, allowing you to view it remotely on your other devices. No account setup is necessary if you already use iCloud.
In addition to recording videos and taking snapshots at an adjustable interval, Watchful makes time-lapse videos to give you a convenient overview. There's also a live video feed that you can access from your other devices via iCloud.
With motion detection, you can choose to record videos only when movement is detected and receive notifications on your other devices.
You can configure how long you want to keep your security camera footage, according to your needs and available storage. You'll see an estimate of the storage you need so that you can stay within your limits or increase your available storage.
Whether you want to use your devices as a home security camera, a nanny cam, a baby monitor, or a pet monitor, Watchful can cover all your surveillance needs.
Key features
- Live video feed
- Video or snapshot mode
- Time-lapse videos
- Motion detection with notifications
- Adjustable storage duration
- Videos and photos securely saved in your private iCloud storage
---
Privacy policy: watchful.cam/privacy
Terms of use: apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00127098:ios.description:
Ever desire to play the most realistic racing motorcycle simulator? 
Based on Unreal Engine Four --the most powerful and advanced 3D engine, Speed Moto Dash will bring you an experience of ultimate and amazing real racing, and awesome graphics.
Along with Speed Moto Dash, we're ready to surprise you with loads of cool realistic motorcycles. Now you can drive, drift and customize a racing sports motorcycle just in your device ! Here is a life-like vehicle simulator game for you！No Matter whoever you are, you can enjoy the fun of driving a motorcycle!To give an inappropriate example, it's like being in an F1 car, or riding in a PUBG jungle.
Get behind the wheel and start your lessons in the most realistic driving simulator around! This is a game that will not only test your skills in controlling the motorcycle but also demand full attention to traffic rules. After all, it is not only the long asphalt highway waiting for you, but also the buses, trucks, and cars as well as bikes that travel with you!
Real and intelligent road driving simulation:cars, trucks, buses are all driving on the road, they can change lanes, slow down, or make way for you. Use your throttle and brakes to overtake or make an emergency stop at the right time! The highway is not your parking lot—— Stand up wherever you crash or fall and continue your driving!
With its advanced realistic physics engine, this ultimate motorcycle game Speed Moto Dash is going to provide you with addictive gameplay, and endless fun of driving simulation!Multiple game modes are waiting for you to challenge: endless mode, barricade bowling mode, only nitrogen mode.
The tutorial will teach you all the rules on how to drive and race your customized motorcycles on challenging maps, challenge various traffic conditions and finish multiple missions!
Use materials rewarded by completing game missions or achieving career goals to enhance and upgrade your motor. With better motorcycle, you will able to challenge more complex roads and increasingly difficult missions!
KEY FEATURES
▶ Beautiful 3D modern graphics.
▶The ultimate speed experience comparable to formula racing and rally racing.
▶ 100% Free to play 
▶ Controls: Buttons, Wheel, Tilt & MFi Game Controller Support
▶ First person camera
▶ Various racing scenarios, weather system, and racing tracks to choose from.
▶ Realistic driving simulator system, accurate simulation of real motorcycle driving experience.
▶ Authentic motorcycle accident, and motorcycle damage physics effects.
▶ Unlimited customization: Customize your motorcycles with paint,decal，tires, rims.
▶You can enjoy the game without network service! You can play without WIFI!
▶ The Coolest motorcycle collection.
Become a motorcycle racer,ride your own classic, modern or luxury motorcycle, drive in cockpit view through the endless traffic and realistic environment. Become a furious racer, hurtle on the asphalt road in the city, country road, desert highway ,wherever you want! Overtake traffics to earn coins as much as possible, and unlock more brand new fancy motorcycles!
Get your motorcycle ready and start your engine! With the amazing real-like racing motorcycle simulator, feel free to immerse yourself in the pleasant of speeding!
Download Speed Moto Dash for FREE to show off your driving skill now! Need for speed ?Trample the accelerator and speed up!

On February 25, 2022, Bald Head Island Transportation, Inc. (BHIT) provided initial public notification as required by law of a change in checked-baggage policies ordered by the North Carolina Utilities Commission (NCUC). However, please note that well in advance of formal implementation of the new baggage policies and prior to strict enforcement, BHIT will communicate any process changes affecting passengers. BHIT will initially focus on internal processes before expanding to baggage and passenger delivery operations, tram reservation integration, and electronic ticketing. bluejetty:00042524:ios.description:
FB Mobile Banking by FirstBank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FB Mobile Banking:
• Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks
• Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
• Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
• Transfer money between your accounts
• Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
• Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
• View and save your monthly statements
• Find branches and ATMs near you
• Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices
To use the FB Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a FB Mobile Banking digital banking user. If you currently use our Online Banking, simply download the FB Mobile Banking app and use your Online Banking credentials to login.

Four adventurers have set on a journey to restore the
bluejetty:00116082:ios.description:
A long time has passed since the White City was washed from the face of Gaia – and the once magnificent Kingdom of Arcadia was shattered into hundreds of islands of the Uncharted Sea. 
Four adventurers have set on a journey to restore the world to its former glory. Following rumors and prophecies, they have found a way into a mythical underground complex, Chronos Dungeon.
Deep down, hidden somewhere, lies the Paradigm Hourglass, an object powerful enough to alter history. Will you find the route to the bottom floor, and what challenges await you inside Chronos Dungeon?
A DUNGEON CRAWLER FOR ALL AGES
Oceanhorn: Chronos Dungeon is a dungeon crawler featuring four players couch co-op, inspired by 16-bit arcade classics. Fight side by side with your friends, or control all four heroes by yourself – will you make it to the bottom of Chronos Dungeon?
If this is your first game in the genre, don’t worry – Oceanhorn: Chronos Dungeon is easy to pick up even for newcomers and will keep you and your companions entertained for hours!
A NEW DUNGEON EVERY TIME
Randomized modifiers make each level unique, and each run unexpected. Heroes start every game with different stats, depending on the zodiac sign they’re bound to, and each of the four adventurers, Knight, Huntress, Grandmaster, and Mage, feels and plays differently. If less than four local players are available, the idle adventurers can be selected on the fly by any player.
FEATURES
- Couch co-op multiplayer for up to four players
- 16-bit feeling, music, and sounds, updated to 2020
- Four classes to choose from or switch to on the fly, each with a different playstyle
- Infinite replayability: the dungeon reconfigures itself with new modifiers at each floor
- Massive boss battles
- Plenty of items to try out for maximum dungeon mayhem

bluejetty:00200088:ios.name: Bevnap: Cocktail Recipes
bluejetty:00200088:ios.summary:
Your personal cocktail companion. Discover, create, and perfect your favorite drinks with Bevnap - the complete recipe management app for home bartenders and cocktail enthusiasts, designed for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo.
DISCOVER RECIPES
bluejetty:00200088:ios.description:
Your personal cocktail companion. Discover, create, and perfect your favorite drinks with Bevnap - the complete recipe management app for home bartenders and cocktail enthusiasts, designed for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo.
DISCOVER RECIPES
Browse beautifully designed cocktail recipes with detailed ingredients, step-by-step directions, and stunning photos. Find the perfect drink by searching by name, ingredient, spirit, or category. Whether you're looking for a classic Old Fashioned or exploring modern craft cocktails, every recipe is at your fingertips.
INGREDIENT LOOKUP
Wondering what to make with that bottle of Campari? Tap any ingredient to instantly see every cocktail in your library that uses it. A simple way to discover new drinks and get the most out of what you have.
CREATE YOUR OWN
Build and save your own signature cocktails. Add custom ingredients, write detailed directions, and capture beautiful photos of your creations. Organize recipes into personal collections for easy access.
PROFESSIONAL CALCULATORS
 - Batch Calculator - Scale any recipe for parties and events
 - Syrup Calculator - Make professional-quality syrups at home
 - Slushy Calculator - Perfect frozen drinks every time
 - Carbonation Calculator - Calculate CO₂ pressure for sparkling cocktails, sodas, and draft dispense — built with Crossroads Consulting and Jeffrey Morgenthaler
 - What Can I Make? - Discover cocktails you can make with what you have
 - Recipe Costing - Calculate pour costs and set profitable menu prices
 - ABV Calculator - Track alcohol content and dilution
RECIPE COLLECTIONS
Download curated recipe packs from Jeffrey Morgenthaler. Explore themed collections like Jeffrey Morgenthaler's Signature Cocktails, Modern Classics, Bourbon/Rye Cocktails and more. New collections added regularly.
SHARE WITH FRIENDS
Connect with friends to share recipes and collections directly in the app. Export beautiful recipe cards as PDFs. Create shareable menus for your home bar or next party.
SYNC EVERYWHERE
Your recipes, ingredients, and collections sync automatically via iCloud. Start on your iPhone, continue on your iPad or iPhone Duo — Bevnap’s multi-column layouts fill the inner display. Everything stays perfectly in sync.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE
 - Multiple beautiful themes (Ocean, Sunset, Light, Dark)
 - Flexible measurement units (oz, ml, cl, and more)
 - Bartender-standard unit conversions
 - Keep screen on while mixing
 - Full search across all your content
Whether you're a professional bartender, managing a bar/restaurant, hosting a cocktail party, learning mixology fundamentals, or perfecting your craft, Bevnap gives you everything you need to mix with confidence.
Download now and discover your next favorite cocktail.
