The Note Lifetime keeps your notebook fresh and reflective of the present moment. When a note goes unedited for a duration you choose in settings, you’ll be gently notified. This is an opportunity to review the note, act on it, or let it go. 
COLLABORATIVE WRITING
Share notes with friends, family, and teammates. With a gentle design, writing remains focused and tranquil, even as thoughts merge and ideas multiply. Everyone receives changes as notes evolve, and multiple people can make edits at the same time without conflict.
FOCUSED + SPACIOUS DESIGN
Minimal is designed so only one element is ever in focus. We love the beauty of a blank page – abundant empty space allows for an ease of creative expression. 
PUBLISH AS WEBSITE
Transform notes into beautifully-formatted websites in microseconds.
TODO LISTS
Todo lists are an effective way to organize projects and complete tasks. Sync with the Calendar app, get things done, and check everything off.
BEAUTIFUL FORMATTING 
Minimal combines Markdown-style formatting with elegant typography. The result is simple, expressive notes that make it easy to think and write.
SYNC EVERYWHERE
Bring focus to your favorite devices. Minimal is designed for Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Cloud Sync is fast, reliable, and invisible. 
SHARE, EXPORT, IMPORT
You’re in control of your notes. Share directly in iMessage, export as PDF or HTML, and use the system share mechanism to take notes anywhere. Importing links + prose into Minimal is just as easy. 
CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING
The best notebook is personal. We made everything in Minimal customizable, from fonts + themes to sorting notes + note actions. You can also build custom workflows using the Shortcuts app. 
A LITTLE GIFT
Wow, thanks for reading. As a little gift for tuning in, these are our favorite musicians -> Somi, Snarky Puppy, and London Grammar. They’re jazzy and introspective, just how we like it. Enjoy.

Whether at home, online, or on the move, our comprehensive family safety features bring peace of mind to your loved ones AND help safeguard your personal belongings. Experience location safety features that surpass ordinary GPS tracking apps. More than just a GPS location tracker, with Life360, finding friends and family has never been easier.
In addition to focusing on safety, Life360 allows you to effortlessly keep tabs on your pets, keys, wallet, phone, and other essentials using Tile Bluetooth trackers and the NEW Life360 Pet GPS. These trackers integrate with your Life360 map, ensuring you can easily locate everything and everyone that matters most from a single, convenient platform.
Life360 memberships include essential safety features like:
- SOS Alerts: Send silent alerts with your precise location to friends, family members, emergency contacts, and responders.
- 24/7 Emergency Dispatch: We're here for your loved ones, always ready to respond, even when you can't make the call.
- Identity Theft Protection: Safeguard sensitive digital information for each family member, backed by a white-glove restoration service.
- Roadside Assistance: Free towing, jumpstarts, tire changes, lockout assistance, refueling and more.
Download the free app now to access Advanced Location Sharing, Location History, Crash Detection, and Place Alerts. Keep tabs on your family members as they come and go from key locations like home, school and work.
Take your safety to the next level by upgrading to one of our premium Life360 memberships. Choose the plan that suits your friend's and family's unique needs and enjoy a 7-day free trial.
Life360 Silver - Simplify your safety with features such as:
- 2 Places with unlimited Alerts
- 2 days of Location History
- Crash Detection
- Family Driving Summary
- Data Breach Alerts
- SOS Help Alerts During Emergencies
Life360 Gold* - Keep your family secure on the go with all the features of Life360 Silver, plus: 
- 30 days of Location History
- Unlimited Place Alerts
- Individual Driver Reports
- Crash Detection with emergency dispatch and live agent support
- 24/7 Roadside Assistance
- $250 in Stolen Phone Protection
- ID Theft Protection and Data Breach Alerts
- $25,000 in Stolen Fund Reimbursement
Life360 Platinum* - Prepare for anything, anywhere, with all the features of Life360 Gold, plus:
- $1 million in Stolen Fund Reimbursement
- 50 miles of Free towing
- $500 in Stolen Phone Protection
- Travel Support with Disaster Assistance
- Medical Support

bluejetty:00094234:ios.summary: Heart Rate Monitor is one app for the numbers your doctor asks about: pulse, blood pressure, blood sugar and weight. Measure your heart rate with the iPhone camera, log readings from your cuff or glucose meter, and export a PDF report for y
bluejetty:00094234:ios.description:
Heart Rate Monitor is one app for the numbers your doctor asks about: pulse, blood pressure, blood sugar and weight. Measure your heart rate with the iPhone camera, log readings from your cuff or glucose meter, and export a PDF report for your next appointment.
HEART RATE & HRV
- Measure your pulse in seconds: place a fingertip on the camera, no smartwatch needed
- Track heart rate variability (HRV) and stress level based on your heart rhythm
- Keep a history of your measurements and see your progress over time
BLOOD PRESSURE LOG
- Log systolic, diastolic and pulse from any blood pressure monitor
- Every reading is color-coded from low to high, with your hypertension grade
- Daily, weekly and monthly charts with min, max and average
- Reminders and streaks help you log morning and evening readings
BLOOD SUGAR LOG
- Record glucose readings in mg/dL or mmol/L
- See your initial, current and average level and your trend on one chart
- Know where each reading sits for your profile
WEIGHT & BMI
- Track your weight, set a target and follow your progress
- Body mass index is calculated automatically
HEALTH REPORT FOR YOUR DOCTOR
- Export heart rate, blood pressure, blood sugar and weight for any date range as a PDF
- Share it with your doctor or keep it for your records
ALSO INSIDE
- Heart health and heart risk assessments
- Expert-backed tips, guides and lectures on heart health, stress and healthy habits
HOW TO MEASURE YOUR HEART RATE
- Make sure your fingers are warm and clean
- Cover the camera lens completely with your fingertip
- Hold steady and press lightly for the best result
SUBSCRIPTION
- Subscribe for full access to all features and content
- Weekly and yearly plans; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings
Privacy Policy: https://horizon-apps.io/heart-rate-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.horizon-apps.io/terms-of-use
IMPORTANT
Heart Rate Monitor is intended for general wellness use only. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or replace professional medical advice. Blood pressure and blood sugar values are entered manually from your own devices. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider about any health concerns.

bluejetty:00069294:ios.description:
Speed Dial with Contact Widget
Speed Dial Plus helps you connect with your favorite contacts faster using home screen widgets and smart speed dial. Call, message, email, FaceTime, or start a WhatsApp chat with one tap—right from your home screen or Today View.
Designed for speed and convenience, Speed Dial Plus lets you create custom contact widgets with multiple styles and themes, so staying connected is quick and effortless.

Add your most-used contacts as favorites and reach them instantly. Choose different actions for each contact, such as call, message, FaceTime, WhatsApp chat, or email.
Widgets That Save Time
• Home Screen Contact Widgets for quick access
• Today View Speed Dial Widget to reach contacts without opening the app
• Assign custom actions per contact for single tap or long press
Smart Dialer & Contact Management
• Built-in T9 smart dialer to search contacts by name or number
• Clean contact book with photos for favourite contacts
• Call log for quick reference
Customise Your Experience
Personalize your widgets and app appearance with 300+ themes and gradient styles. Create a look that matches your home screen and preferences.
Key Features
• One-tap speed dial for calls, messages, FaceTime, WhatsApp, and email
• Favourite contact widgets for home screen and Today View
• Smart T9 dialer for fast contact search
• Custom actions for single tap and long press
• Stylish widgets with multiple themes
• Simple, fast, and user-friendly design
Speed Dial Plus is built for users who want a faster, smarter way to connect with the people they contact most—right from their home screen.

bluejetty:00094201:android.description:
Dark Aura Panel FF is your ultimate gaming companion app designed to enhance your mobile gaming experience. Whether you're a casual player or a competitive gamer, our comprehensive toolkit provides everything you need to optimize your gameplay.
🎯 CROSSHAIR OVERLAY
- Customizable crosshair styles for better aim visualization
- Adjustable size, rotation, and opacity settings
- Multiple color options to match your preference
- Drag-and-drop positioning anywhere on screen
🔧 SENSITIVITY CALCULATOR
- Calculate optimal sensitivity settings for mobile and emulator
- Weapon-specific sensitivity suggestions
- Custom DPI configuration options
- Easy-to-use slider controls for fine-tuning
📊 PERFORMANCE MONITORING
- Real-time FPS display overlay
- Battery temperature monitoring
- RAM usage tracker
- Storage usage indicator
- Network ping measurement
- Screen refresh rate display
🚀 DEVICE OPTIMIZATION
- Notification management during gameplay
- Game launcher for quick access to your favorite games
🎨 AIMING BALL TOOL
- Floating practice ball with multiple styles
- Customizable colors and sizes
- Adjustable opacity and position
- Lock feature to prevent accidental movement
📐 CUSTOM HUD LAYOUTS
- Pre-designed HUD configurations
- 2-finger, 3-finger, and 4-finger layouts
- Visual guides for optimal button placement
🔒 PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED
- Overlay permission: Required to display crosshair and tools over games
- Storage: For saving your preferences and settings
- Network: For ping measurement and app updates
DISCLAIMER:
Dark Aura Panel FF is a standalone utility app that works with any game. It does not modify game files or provide unfair advantages - all features are visual overlays and optimization tools that enhance your gaming experience without violating any game policies.

Key Feature
bluejetty:00042475:ios.description:
Welcome to the Archer Review Nursing School App, your ultimate resource for mastering nursing school! Whether you’re just starting your nursing journey or prepping for the NCLEX, our app provides everything you need to succeed.
Key Features:
 • 20+ in-depth courses covering all key nursing topics
 • 1000+ on-demand lectures for self-paced learning
 • 5100+ Next-Gen NCLEX-style practice questions
 • 200+ nursing cheat sheets, including tips, tricks, charts, and mnemonics
 • Seamless integration with NCLEX preparation
Courses and Lectures:
Gain access to over 20 comprehensive courses, including subjects such as Anatomy & Physiology, Pharmacology, Adult Health, Geriatrics, and more. With over 1000+ on-demand lectures designed by experienced nursing educators, we break down complex concepts into manageable chunks. Filter lectures by content and quickly find what you need to study.
Comprehensive Question Bank:
Sharpen your nursing skills and prepare for your exams with over 5100+ NCLEX-style practice questions. Each question comes with detailed rationales for both correct and incorrect answers, ensuring that you grasp the essential concepts.
Nursing Cheat Sheets:
Need quick reference material? Archer Review has you covered with over 200+ nursing cheat sheets packed with essential tips, mnemonics, and charts to help you study smarter. These concise sheets summarize the most important topics, from dosage calculations to lab values, ensuring you never miss a key point.
Study Resources:
Our app includes various tools to enhance your study experience. With medical illustrations, professional tables, and expert insights, you’ll be well-prepared for any exam.

bluejetty:00089515:ios.description:
Discover a comprehensive wellness companion with HealthPal. Empowers you to take control of your health with ease and convenience.
1. Heart Rate Monitor
Instantly measure your heart rate using your smartphone's camera. Gain insights into your cardiovascular health.
2.Blood Sugar Log
Record your blood sugar levels. Our app helps you manage and analyze your data for better diabetes control.
3.Blood Pressure App
Record your blood pressure. Get a clear picture of your cardiovascular health with our intuitive interface.
4.Blood Oxygen Log
You can record your blood oxygen levels to help understand the health of your body.
5.Daily Data Insights
Receive daily, weekly, and monthly data analysis that helps you understand trends and make informed decisions. Visualize your progress with charts and easily identify patterns that matter to your health.
6.Health Tips and Dietary Advice
Get the latest daily health tips and dietary advice to guide you on your health journey.
Download now and start your journey to a healthier lifestyle today！
Privacy Policy：https://health-monitor-8ef14.web.app/privacy.txt
Terms of Conditions：https://health-monitor-8ef14.web.app/terms.txt
Support Notes：https://health-monitor-8ef14.web.app/support.txt
Technical Statement:Our app uses photoplethysmography (PPG) to monitor heart rate through your smartphone's camera and flashlight. Users place their finger on the camera, which detects blood flow variations. By analyzing these changes, the app calculates your heart rate.
Disclaimer: seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. All data and analyses provided by the app are for reference only and should not be used as a basis for medical diagnosis and treatment. We are not responsible for any consequences arising from the use of this app, including but not limited to health issues or inaccurate measurements.

Whether you're looking to lose weight, maintain it, or simply build h
bluejetty:00153446:ios.description:
SnapCal is your all-in-one weight management companion — powered by smart calorie tracking and personalized meal planning. Just snap, log, and reach your goals with ease.
Whether you're looking to lose weight, maintain it, or simply build healthier habits, SnapCal guides you every step of the way. Using science-backed calorie tracking, AI-powered food recognition, and intuitive tools, SnapCal makes wellness simple — and sustainable.
Why SnapCal:
- Snap & Track Meals in Seconds
 Just take a photo to log your meal — it's that simple. No more tedious input!
- Personalized Calorie Goals
Enter your info and goal weight — we'll calculate a daily calorie budget tailored just for you.
- Smarter Food Logging
Track meals by photo, barcode, or search — powered by AI for fast, accurate results.
- Beyond Calories: Track What Matters
Monitor your macros, water, sugar, body measurements, and more — all in one place.
- Visual Weight Progress Tracker
See your transformation unfold with clear, motivating charts.
- Healthy Plans for Every Stage
Whether you're a beginner or experienced, customize your plan and pace — SnapCal adapts to you.
- Daily Reminders & Friendly Nudges
Stay consistent and motivated with smart, timely encouragement.
Built on Balance, Backed by Science
SnapCal promotes realistic, effective weight loss through a combination of smart calorie tracking, balanced eating, and moderate activity. We don't do crash diets — we help you build habits that last.
App Features at a Glance:
- Snap It Photo Meal Logging – Just tap the camera icon for food tracking and calorie counting in a snap
- Barcode Scanning & AI Food Recognition – Fast, easy, accurate food entry
- Custom Calorie Recommendations – Based on your body and weight goals
- Track Nutrition & More – Macros, water, carbs, sugar, body stats
- Weight Progress Tracker – Visualize your results
- Healthy Weight Plans – Personalized routines for every user
- Apple Health Integration – Sync your activity automatically
Please Note:
Healthy weight loss requires a balanced diet and physical activity. For best results, consult your doctor before beginning any new fitness program. Individual outcomes may vary.
Subscription Info:
Should you choose to purchase a Premium or Boost subscription, subscription purchase will be charged to your iTunes account. The yearly subscription will automatically renew unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the period subscription ends. Your premium subscription auto-renew can be turned off or managed in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of the free trial is forfeited after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://snapcal.co/terms
Privacy policy: https://snapcal.co/privacy
If you have any questions or suggestions, email us at: snapcal.service@proton.me

bluejetty:00159893:ios.name: Money Wise Game: Life Sim
bluejetty:00159893:ios.summary:
Welcome to Money Wise Game: a real life simulation, money simulator, fun, and creative financial game, that helps you manage your money while participating in choices based adventure game.
Get ready to make tough financial decisions and re
bluejetty:00159893:ios.description:
Welcome to Money Wise Game: a real life simulation, money simulator, fun, and creative financial game, that helps you manage your money while participating in choices based adventure game.
Get ready to make tough financial decisions and real life choices with lasting consequences! Survive senior year of high school in this life simulator and maybe you’ll even learn a thing or two about managing your money and your life in the real world.
In Money Wise Game , Will you manage to avoid scams and fake text messages? Will you go broke from getting that cash advance and payday loan? Will your credit and money habits affect your life and your happiness? It’s all up to you... But whatever you choose, you’ll have to live with the consequences!
The Money Wise Game is a story-based life simulation game to learn financial literacy and consumer skills. Never get ripped off by targeted fake deals, predatory loans, or tricky fine print again, and start growing healthy money habits.
It’s an adventure worth playing! Get savvy, get happy, and more in your own story!
Do you love a good interactive story? Do you think you’re good at money management? This is the casual offline game for you! Money Wise Game is a slice of life simulation game where your choices change the story, your character, and the city!
WELCOME TO MONEY WISE GAME a real life simulator: Play as Ali, a high school senior, in this interactive high school story game. More interactive than a visual novel, the role playing game will take you through a story adventure where you will experience the life of a high school senior juggling a part-time job, school, and your favorite hobby soccer. Money management will be most important as a life simulation choices throw themselves at Ali, such as scams, fake text messages, and fake sales, and you will have to make choices to progress in this story game.
In this real life simulator YOUR CHOICES MATTER In this decision based game, your choices are key to the progress of your interactive story. You will experience many episodes that will require difficult choices to be made. If you love casual but deep stories, this is the offline adventure game for you! Learning about money management and being a helpful neighbor to other characters will really make this life story simulation worthwhile.
BUILD YOUR CITY
Your city will grow with you! Help your neighbors and neighborhood through their interactive stories and make good choices for them to build your city. Build and manage your city through progressing in the story – the ultimate interactive experience!
MANAGE YOUR LIFE CHOICES
Everything in the real life simulator game comes down to decisions and choices. The main character Ali’s path in high school and his story after high school is all up to you.
It's a Job Simulator
It's a job simulator, your choices in each of the jobs you are going to take are going to affect your next level on the same job, or in a new job in the future. You will experience many situations that will get you to make some very difficult choices.
KEY FEATURES
 - Help other characters 
- Improve your city and neighborhood 
- No ads, 100% FREE - Offline casual game
- More stories and episodes to come!
Due to child protection and privacy reasons, users under the age of 13 are not advised to play this game without supervision.

bluejetty:00178032:ios.name: Photo Scan Plus
bluejetty:00178032:ios.summary:
Preserve the moments that matter most by turning printed photos, slides, negatives, and treasured keepsakes into a digital library your family can revisit and share for generations.
Using advanced AI technology, Photomyne brings old photos
bluejetty:00178032:ios.description:
Preserve the moments that matter most by turning printed photos, slides, negatives, and treasured keepsakes into a digital library your family can revisit and share for generations.
Using advanced AI technology, Photomyne brings old photos into the digital age, making it quick and simple to scan, restore, enhance, and organize your family’s memories.
Photo Scan Plus is the paid one-time purchase version of Photomyne. It includes the complete experience on your device: unlimited scanning, editing, saving, sharing, and organization on your iPhone or iPad. Add a Photomyne Membership anytime for secure cloud backup, web access, and syncing across your devices.
In addition to Photo Scan Plus, we also offer *Photo Scan by Photomyne*. It's free to download and is first to include our newest features, improvements, and innovations. Choose the app that you feel fits you best.
SCAN FASTER - PHOTOMYNE DOES THE REST
• Scan multiple printed photos in a single shot
• Digitize entire photo albums in minutes
• Scan photos, slides, negatives, scrapbook pages, kids' artwork, documents, and more
• Automatic edge detection, cropping, rotation, and color correction
• Capture scans with a tap or Voice Control
ORGANIZE YOUR MEMORIES
• Create beautiful digital albums
• Add names, dates, locations, and stories
• Add audio recording
• Scan the back of your photos and keep it attached
• Easily search for photos and rediscover your memories
RESTORE & BRING MEMORIES BACK TO LIFE
Preserve your original scan while creating beautifully enhanced versions using Photomyne's editing tools. For more advanced restorations, optional AI-powered tools are available.
• Sharpen blurry faces in photos
• Colorize black & white photos
• Auto restore faded colors
• Manually edit with color filters
• Remove scratches, tears, glare, shadows, and reflections using optional AI restoration tools (available with AI credits)
AI-POWERED MAGIC
In addition to its core features, Photomyne hosts handpicked external AI tools from trusted platforms to further restore and enhance your memories. These *optional* features include powerful AI enhancements like photo damage repair, subtle motion animations, and more. These advanced AI features use external AI technology and are available separately using AI credits, so you can enjoy even more photo-enhancing magic, all in one place.
BACK UP & SHARE WITH PHOTOMYNE MEMBERSHIP
Access your memories anytime, anywhere with a Photomyne Membership
 • Automatically back up your photos to the secure Photomyne Cloud
 • Access your memories from all your devices and on the web
 • Keep your entire library synced across your devices
 • Save photos to your device or computer in high resolution and print quality
 • Share individual photos, albums, or entire collections with family and friends using simple web links
OPTIONAL IN-APP UPGRADE
A Photomyne Membership includes:
• Automatic cloud backup to the secure Photomyne Cloud
• Access to your memories from all your devices and on the web
• Synced library across all your devices
Memberships are available as monthly, yearly, and one-time plans.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

• View and edit your goals 
• View your transaction history 
• Transfer funds 
• Create new goals 
• Set up reoccurring deposits 
SmartyPig accounts are offered through Sallie Mae Bank, Member FDIC.

bluejetty:00187904:ios.name: ClickMobile Touch
bluejetty:00187904:ios.summary:
ClickSoftware’s ClickMobile Touch is a mobile application for the field service sector. It is used by the field resources to communicate with their back office and with their peers using the Field Service Edge system.
ClickSoftware’s ente
bluejetty:00187904:ios.description:
ClickSoftware’s ClickMobile Touch is a mobile application for the field service sector. It is used by the field resources to communicate with their back office and with their peers using the Field Service Edge system.
ClickSoftware’s enterprise solution uses innovative and collaborative mobile tools, improving field workforce productivity and efficiency, enhancing customer experience, and meeting compliance and regulation requirements. The solution enables field supervisors and back office staff to have visibility and control, helping them make real-time decisions continuously throughout the day of service. ClickMobile Touch empowers field service professionals with all the information they need to complete the job the first time. Work is executed with maximum productivity, safety and compliance, and focuses on customer satisfaction.
The application includes the following capabilities:
* Task management – Manage the entire task execution process, view the customer’s information, 
 report the status of the task as it progresses
* Time and attendance management – Report and track the time and attendance of a field resource 
 or a crew, including the ability to view and manage your shifts
* Inventory management – Manage your inventory, scan barcodes and requests parts from the field
* Power map – View your tasks and schedule on a map to help visualize your day
* Dynamic forms – Forms can include file attachments and signature capturing
* Internal messaging system – Share knowledge with peers using instant messaging and file sharing
* Dynamic location services – Allows Street Level Routing to avoid traffic congestions during the day 
 of service, automatic status transition based on location
* Supervisor app – Scheduling interface for continuous operational insight and real-time visibility 
 into the field
The ClickMobile Touch user can carry on working even when the application is offline. When the application is back online, all of the information will be synchronized automatically. In addition, the back office can update the assignments for the user, which will be updated when the user is online again. This online/offline connectivity ensures maximum data exchange and visibility of workday progress, allowing increased work efficiency.

bluejetty:00086159:ios.description:
Shift Work Calendar Planner is a free calendar app for shift workers or for people who want to organise their work and everyday life. The simple and concise interface of the application allows you quickly display a schedule of any complexity. You can plan your off days with ease and keep track of your ever-changing schedule. It is especially beneficial for firefighters, nurses, linemen, deputy sheriffs, and other professionals who have a constantly changing schedule.
You can create as many calendars as you want and use them for different jobs or to track coworkers' schedules.
This app offers its own list of preset work shift patterns that you can immediately use. If your shift work doesn’t fall into any of those patterns, you can set a custom shift pattern and use it, or adjust and edit preconfigured ones.
The app is not only for work schedule roster, you can input your vacations, personal events, gym, holidays, etc.
The app also has a date search feature that lets you check if you’re supposed to be working on a particular day in the future, or compare calendars with coworkers.
Shifts :
Create or use preset, fully configurable shifts.
Enter your income, hourly rate, working time.
Customise it with different colours and icons.
Type a note for a shift or change its description.
Put as many shifts on any date as you need. 
Use preset shift patterns to add shifts quickly for longer periods.
 Multiple Calendars :
Create multiple Jobs/Calendars.
Create job schedules for multiple people.
Compare them on one page, date by date.
Backup and restore your calendars.
Personalize your calendar with multiple color palettes, icons and themes.
Analytics:
Track your working hours, shifts, personal events and money earned.
Select a period to see your income for each week, month or year.
Working goals and custom periods are under development.

bluejetty:00166432:ios.description:
GolfBPM was created so golfers can develop the same consistent tempo by timing their golf swing to music. 
HOW IT WORKS
- Download and Register 
- Choose a Station 
- Select a Club type & swing speed. If you are at home, start with putting 
- Start your swing on the “One” count 
- Start your down swing on the “Two” count 
- Make impact on the “Three” count 
- Boom! You now have perfect tempo 
Featuring original music from hip hop, to electronic, to rock and pop, each song contains subtly timed verbal queues, so a golfer knows exactly where to hit their swing marks. 
Thoroughly tested on PGA tour players, amateurs, juniors, and senior golfers. Golf BPM founder Doug Timmons (PGA Class A member) created GolfBPM to make your practice fun and more effective. 
No two golf swings are alike. But regardless of variables like grip, speed, or stance, every PGA Tour golfer in the world moves at an almost identically even tempo, on every swing. When you are watching PGA players at the US Open or The Master you will see perfect swing tempos.
Now you too can have that perfect muscle-memorized cadence by timing your swing to music.
TESTIMONIALS
"Audio cues are great ways to have a better visualization of the shot. The music makes it easy to get into a good frame of mind and the appropriate rhythm."
"In my mind the golf swing is about repetition of being in the proper positions with proper timing. Anything that helps make feeling the timing more natural is essential to ingraining that timing so that it becomes standard and can be reproduced under pressure."
"My instructor recommended that I use this app on the range. It has helped improve my game and practicing. First, I can clear my mind of all the swing thoughts and just hit to the beats. Second, In the car it is very relaxing and gets me mentally calm. Third, it really has been great with putting. I had a decelerating tempo before using this app and now my stroke is consistent."
APP FEATURES
• Free trial with registration 
• 8 stations - Over 100 song speeds
• Four different BPM speeds (Beats Per Minute)
• Three swing types: Driver, mid-ions, chipping and putting
• Voice Prompts to time your golf swing to
• Voice Control: Ability to turn on/off counting over the music
• Putting and chipping
• Tips and weekly video lessons
GET IN TOUCH
We’d love to hear from you on product, partnerships, content, press, and / or interest in joining our team: help@golfbpm.com
FIND US ON SOCIAL MEDIA
Instagram: @golfBPM
YouTube: @golfBPM
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account once you confirm your purchase. If you select a subscription plan, your iTunes account will be charged again when your subscription automatically renews at the end of your current subscription period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
Subscriptions: weekly, monthly and annual.
You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.
Lifetime Memberships are a one-time payment and are never re-billed.
Privacy Policy: https://www.golfbpm.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.golfbpm.com/legal.html

Get over hundreds of levels that have dynamic obstacles, and make it cleared!
Treasures, Pots, Blocks and Leaf Jail, Golden Tail, Rings ...... There are so many gates you can break through with joy!

Game Features:
- Classic match 3 games fun: Match, blast, and crush gems and jewels like candy in fun and challenging puzzles
- Hundreds of clever levels: Each level brings lots of new and exciting challenges to tease your brain
- Addictive and challenging jewel crush gameplay: Match special gems and jewels, set off their special abilities, and use powerful boosters to help solve the puzzles

On top of all of this, Jewels & Jungle Pop is as lightweight as possible for your enjoyment! No huge download, no distracting bells and whistles, no internet needed to play - we only care about your puzzle adventure fun!

Jewels & Jungle Pop's jewel crush puzzles are difficult enough to challenge even veteran puzzle game fans, but start off easy enough for beginning puzzlers to learn the ropes. With a trove of clever levels, obstacles, and puzzles, there is fun and excitement to be had for anyone. If you're tired of always crushing candy, what are you waiting for? Throw on your tomb raider hat and get ready for a gemstone treasure hunt! If you devour puzzle games and free match 3 games like candy, Jewels & Jungle Pop is the puzzle adventure game for you!

Welcome to the jungle!

bluejetty:00109706:android.summary:

Grab your friends, family, and colleagues, create groups, choose a league or five and bet on all European top leagues and the English Premier League!
These
bluejetty:00109706:android.description:
Predictor for Friends – the must-have app for any football fan and tipster group!
Grab your friends, family, and colleagues, create groups, choose a league or five and bet on all European top leagues and the English Premier League!
These leagues and competitions are included in the 2024/25 season of Predictor for Friends:
- Nations League
- Champions League
- Europa League
- Conference League
- Premier League (England)
- 1. & 2. Bundesliga (Germany)
- 3. Liga (Germany)
- DFB Pokal (Germany)
- Super League (Switzerland)
- Bundesliga (Austria)
- Ligue 1 (France)
- Primera Division (Spain)
- Serie A (Italy)
- Süper Lig (Turkey)
- Eredivisie (Netherlands)
- Jupiler League (Belgium)
- Primeira Liga (Portugal)
- Super League (Greece)
There‘s something for everyone!
FEATURES:
Predictor for Friends comes with a long list of features:
- Sort matches for date or matchday
- Current table
- Top 100 ranking for players and groups
- Champion bet for every competition
- Matchday ranking in your groups
- Create and join an infinite amount of groups
- Chat with your friends and fellow football fans in groups
- Invite your friends via Group Codes, Facebook, WhatsApp or mail
- Change the style of your app
- Push notifications for bet reminders and new match results
PREMIUM FEATURES:
All those who want an even better experience with Predictor for Friends can buy an annual ticket and get even more features!
- Bet history and statistics of other users
- Friends bets after kick-off
- No ads
SCORING & PLAYTIME
Who would’ve guessed the marvelous 4:0 for England in the Europa League 2016 Qualifications match against Lithuania?
Fate rewards the bold, and sometimes it’s advisable to go completely overboard with your bets. Predictor for Friends takes the regular playtime and added time into consideration – no matter the results after a penalty shootout. So betting on a draw isn’t an insensible thing to do even in a big tournament.
Additionally, you can place a Champion Bet in every competition. Intuition, analysis, it doesn’t matter: Betting on the right champion gives you bonus points in every competition!
GROUPS & GLOBAL RANKINGS
Group rankings turn friends into competitors: Whoever gains the highest amount of points betting receives the crown at the end of the season. Matchday rankings shorten the intervals between celebrations, since everyone’s might be having good or bad days betting.
And of course being at the top of the global rankings is where it’s at! Will your group make it among the Top 100?
There’s only one time for football – everywhere, all year! You won’t miss another match with Predictor for Friends, staying connected to what matters most: Your friends and football.
Download Predictor for Friends and see for yourselves!
Have a great football season and good luck betting!

bluejetty:00088975:ios.description:
Inspired by the simple question, “Aaja kati gatey?”(What’s today’s date?), Nepali Patro, Nepal’s first digital calendar has grown into a trusted platform helping Nepalese around the world stay connected to Tithi–Miti, festivals, and their cultural roots.
We believe a calendar is more than a tool to check dates. It is a living cultural bridge that connects our traditions, values, and shared identity across generations and geographies. With this belief and our new identity, we will continue to keep Nepalese around the world informed and connected, through meaningful information, creative expression, promotion of arts, and evolving technology.
The new logo presents an abstract form of the Nepali letter “ने”, symbolizing Nepal and Nepali identity. It also reflects the dynamic motion of a calendar in transition, capturing the continuous flow of time and change. This is not just a visual update, but a deeper expression of who we are and what we stand for.
With this, Nepali Patro aims to further strengthen its role in bringing together culture, community, creativity, and technology, creating a more meaningful and inspiring experience for all.
Happy New Year 2083!

Join the ranks of strategic masters in "The Army," the ultimate idle strategy game where your leadership skills are put to the test!

Dynamic Army Upgrades: Customize your army with power-ups, health boosts, increased attack speed, and more. Every decision counts!

Join "The Army" now and lead your forces to glory! Are you ready to make your mark in the annals of strategy gaming? Download now and start your conquest!

bluejetty:00126044:ios.description:
Over 10 million users! A drawing and communication app that makes your daily creative activities more fun!
It includes a Draw feature that allows you to easily draw at any time, and a community with over 11 million illustrations posted!
About pixiv Sketch
pixiv Sketch is a drawing and communication app by pixiv Inc.
・The Draw feature makes drawing feel just like sketching on paper, so you'll have no trouble getting exactly the results you want.
・The app features the latest drawing support technology, including automatic coloring using AI.
About pixiv Sketch's Draw feature
pixiv Sketch's Draw feature is the simplest you'll find around! Enjoy drawing digitally right away, even if it's your first time.
● Easy-to-use pens and brushes
・The app comes with pens and brushes that are easy for anyone to use, including first-time painters.
・The Sketch pencil feels as smooth as a real pencil.
・The variety of available brushes covers a wide range of media, including watercolor.
● Simple and intuitive interface
・The clean UI leaves room for a wider drawing canvas.
・The app includes special layouts for both right-handed and left-handed artists.
・No menus or tools getting in the way, allowing you a smooth drawing experience.
● Unique features to enhance your drawing experience
・Color your line drawings with AI! An automatic coloring feature is available for no-hassle coloring.
・The Drawing Motivator Voice feature will let you experience a new height of motivation!
・The Redraw feature allows you to add to other people's illustrations and daily themes.
Find new drawing friends with the Community feature
Communicate with your drawing buddies in a community where a total of over 11 million illustrations have already been posted.
● Enjoy a constant flow of illustrations on your Timeline
・Many new illustrations are posted every day. Check them out on your very own wall!
・Interact with your favorite illustrations by leaving a heart.
・Follow artists you like and connect with them.
● The Reply feature lets you respond to an illustration with another illustration
・Reply to everyone's posts with your illustrations.
・Use the Reply feature to easily join contests or post your own interpretation of daily themes.
・Send illustrations to other artists, or even have entire conversations using only artwork; how you use the Reply feature is up to you!
● Use the Redraw feature to add to existing illustrations
・Draw on the illustrations that others have posted.
・It's a great way to collaborate with other artists, for example by joining in on the daily theme or by coloring other people's line art drawings.
Notes:
A pixiv account is required to use some of the features.
If you have any questions or to report a problem, please contact pixiv Sketch Support.
https://www.pixiv.net/support.php?mode=select_type&service=sketch

bluejetty:00042321:ios.description:
Make every photo feel like a memory.
RetroShot is a vintage camera app that brings the charm of classic film photography to your phone. Capture nostalgic moments with retro filters, film-inspired tones, soft grain, timestamp effects, and old-camera textures designed to give your photos a timeless aesthetic.
Whether you're taking selfies, shooting daily moments, or editing pictures from your camera roll, RetroShot makes it easy to create warm, stylish images with a true retro feel. Use live camera filters while shooting in real time, or import photos and transform them with vintage effects in just a few taps.
With RetroShot, you can create:
- Retro film-style photos
- Vintage camera looks
- Disposable camera vibes
- Aesthetic everyday pictures
- Soft grain and nostalgic tones
- Old-school timestamp photo styles
Key features:
- Real-time camera filters for instant retro shots
- Import and edit photos from your library
- Vintage filters inspired by classic film cameras
- Date stamp and timestamp effects
- Soft grain for a natural film texture
- Flash effects for a more authentic camera feel
- Selfie-friendly camera experience
- Easy editing for portraits, travel, food, street photography, and daily life
RetroShot is designed for creators, film lovers, and anyone who wants photos that feel nostalgic, expressive, and effortlessly aesthetic. From casual snapshots to curated social content, you can turn ordinary moments into photos that look like memories.
Subscription information:
Some features may require a subscription to unlock premium filters, effects, or editing tools. Subscription options may vary by region and are managed through your App Store account.
If you love retro filters, vintage photo styles, and film-inspired camera effects, RetroShot is made for you.

bluejetty:00027331:ios.description:
Aurora Alerts is an app designed to monitor real-time auroral activity and push alert to let you know if there may be aurora borealis (northern lights) visible tonight. Whenever you are home or away, Aurora Alerts will notify you if the possibility of seeing the northern lights exists.
Main features:
- short-term aurora forecast for next hour with weather conditions and moon Illumination
- long-term aurora forecast for the next 3 days with weather conditions 
- long-term northern lights forecast for the next 27 days
- show probability to see Northern Lights based on your or custom location 
- current auroral activity (based on observed and predicted Kp Indices from U.S. Air Force Weather Agency)
- weather forecast to check visibility conditions before planning to see northern lights 
- solar wind data directly from the NASA satellite (wind speed, Bz, Bt and density)
- unlike many other apps, it uses the local time instead of UTC
Alerts: 
- when northern lights may be visible at current or custom location at the horizon or overhead
- Kp index reaches chosen value
- solar wind data reach chosen values
- you can filter out alerts based on time of the day
Boost your chances of viewing the northern lights!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aurora-alerts.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00073506:ios.description:
WooPlus is a body-positive dating app designed to create a safe, inclusive, and respectful space for everyone who's ever felt overlooked or judged elsewhere to feel respected, seen, and valued. We embrace diverse beauty and celebrate every body, and believe that connection goes beyond appearances.
Come as you are—and meet people who see and value you for the real you.
Whether you're seeking meaningful conversations, lasting relationships, or simply authentic connections, WooPlus provides an inclusive space where you are embraced, free, and confident to be your unfiltered self and enjoy love.
With over 12 million members around the world, WooPlus is one of the most welcoming and inclusive dating communities—and it's growing every day.
How WooPlus Works
- Create Your Story
Craft a profile that highlights your personality, passions, and what makes you unique. Real people. Real stories.
- Match & Connect
Say hi, start chatting, and build genuine connections based on kindness, honesty, and shared values.
- Express Yourself
Show your real self with videos and photos—because confidence is more attractive than any filter. Here, we honor individuality and encourage you to shine with your own unique beauty.
- Real Profiles
Every profile is reviewed to keep WooPlus a safe, respectful, and authentic community.
- Local & Global Connections
Find like-minded singles near you, or explore global matches who appreciate authenticity over appearances.
We respect all kinds of bodies, backgrounds, and identities—because beauty comes in every shape.
Why Choose WooPlus
- Body Positive Community
We embrace diversity in all its forms, creating a space where confidence thrives and kindness leads the way.
- Genuine Conversations
Start chatting without complicated rules—just honest, meaningful talks.
- Safety First
Profiles are professionally checked, and respectful behavior is our priority—making a safe space where all bodies are respected.
- Ally Recognition
Members who help foster kindness and inclusivity earn our Ally Badge.
- No Ads
Enjoy an uninterrupted experience focused purely on building real connections.
A Global Community That Celebrates You
From the US to the UK, Canada to Australia, Germany, and beyond, WooPlus welcomes people of all sizes, identities, and backgrounds. Here, everyone deserves to be seen, respected, and loved—just as they are.
Premium Upgrade
WooPlus also offers premium online dating services for VIP members. WooPlus has multiple In-app purchase subscription options to choose from:

bluejetty:00123451:ios.description:
It all starts by downloading the G-Plans app and taking our free quiz to get approved for weight loss medication within just a few minutes.
You won’t believe the information you’ll find out about your body...
And you’ll quickly be joining thousands of people just like you who want to live a healthier happier and better life!
That’s what makes G-Plans different... A prescribed, medical approach to weight loss and nutrition!
Featured in the New York Times, Cosmopolitan, Men’s health, Vogue, MSN, People magazine and more, we’ve helped millions of people around the world live their best live and achieve their health and wellness goals.
What is G-Plans?
G-Plans by Dr. Goglia is the only prescription weight loss program that combines medication and nutrition seamlessly. G-Plans provides weekly prescribed medication shipped to your door and fully customized meal programming and conditioning based on one’s metabolic type. Join the community and get access to the full suite of tools available and start being your best self today!
Dr. Goglia has combined his 30 + years of expertise and nutrition coaching into an innovative first of its kind application that will deliver his powerful nutrition coaching into a smart program for anyone to use to get his powerful program delivered to their devices.
Here’s what you’ll get with G-Plans:
Weight Loss Medication Program:
- Get approved for weight loss medication within minutes today
- Have complete oversight by a board-certified doctor in your state
- Ozempic(R) or compounded semaglutide shipped direct to your door at 70% off pharmacy prices
Nutrition:
- Perfectly matched meals to your body and prescription medication
- Weekly (changing) meal plans (with custom recipes) matched to you and your metabolic-ID and synched to your devices.
- Professional nutrition coaching and guidance.
- Programs suitable for many dietary restrictions and allergies - Paleo, vegetarian, pescatarian, vegan etc.
- Built-in exchange list so you can create your own delicious meals easily.
- Calorie, macro and daily performance tracking tools to keep you accountable.
- Built-in recipe generator to keep your plan delicious and easy to follow.
- Dedicated custom support team available around the clock to help you hit your goals.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS & PRICING
The G-Plans Weight Loss RX Program is just USD $129.99 per month for full access which includes your own doctor and medication prescription.
Medication costs are additional and based on type, which start at just $229 per month.
Payment will be charged to your credit card at confirmation of purchase. Subscription auto-renews automatically (unless canceled) at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing.
Subscriptions can be managed in the application. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Read full Terms of Service, our Privacy Policy, Refund Policy
at https://g-plans.com/new/pages/terms/
https://g-plans.com/new/pages/privacy/
https://g-plans.com/new/pages/refunds-policy/.
Results from RX Path may vary. Medication prescriptions are at the discretion of medical providers and may not be suitable for everyone. G-Plans typically result in 1-2 lbs per week weight loss in 4 weeks, involving a healthy diet and exercise changes. Consult a healthcare professional before using RX Path or starting any weight loss program.

bluejetty:00088407:ios.summary: Barbecuing with charcoal is the only way to achieve that unbelievable succulent, tantalizing flavor. Whether you're cooking beef brisket, pork ribs, or chicken wings, the key ingredients to mastering delicious barbecue are the perfect mix o
bluejetty:00088407:ios.description: Barbecuing with charcoal is the only way to achieve that unbelievable succulent, tantalizing flavor. Whether you're cooking beef brisket, pork ribs, or chicken wings, the key ingredients to mastering delicious barbecue are the perfect mix of time and temperature. Conquering this slow cooking process allows the tough, chewy protein fibers in meat to break down and transform into incredibly tender barbecue. The problem is that charcoal is notoriously difficult to control and wild temperature fluctuations can result in tough, dried, or burnt meat. Powered by smart technology, the BBQ Guru temperature control devices easily avoid this disaster by remotely measuring the internal temperature of your foods and effortlessly maintaining the precise cooking temperature inside your grill. The revolutionary DynaQ and UltraQ controllers take outdoor cooking to the next level with the Guru Status Light Ring. At a glance, you can get visual feedback on the status of your cooking temperature and the operation of the control. In addition, you can use this app to monitor or update your BBQ Guru temperature control device via Bluetooth or WiFi to achieve perfect predictability and consistency with your cooks without needing to hover by the cooker. You can also setup email and text notifications, so you’ll always know the most up-to-date status of your BBQ. Whether you’re in your backyard playing with the kids, relaxing by the pool, or hanging out with friends and family, a quick check on your phone over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi ensures your food is on target.

bluejetty:00073266:ios.name: AR Drawing Sketch: Trace Draw
bluejetty:00073266:ios.summary:
Introducing the new and improved AR Sketch Drawing, now enhanced with powerful learning features of guided drawing to offer the ultimate drawing experience for artists of all levels.
  Augmented Reality Drawing Meets Guided Learning
 AR Sk
bluejetty:00073266:ios.description:
Introducing the new and improved AR Sketch Drawing, now enhanced with powerful learning features of guided drawing to offer the ultimate drawing experience for artists of all levels.
  Augmented Reality Drawing Meets Guided Learning
 AR Sketch Drawing’s core strength—using your phone’s camera to project traceable images onto real-world surfaces—remains at the heart of the app. Now, it’s supercharged with Guided, step-by-step tutorials and real-time feedback. Whether you're tracing anime characters, sketching animals, or exploring creative templates, you'll receive guidance and performance evaluations to help you improve.
Guided drawing becomes your personal drawing coach. It helps you learn to draw through a fun, game-like experience while analyzing your progress.
 How is it different from other apps?
* It tracks your drawing accuracy • It assesses the quality of your strokes • Well-structured lessons that combine a little theory with plenty of practice • More than just line tracing – try skill-based trainers with instant feedback
Beginners can build strong fundamentals and improve gradually. Experienced artists can use this as a daily warm-up to refine and sharpen their skills.
It’s a true Drawing guide:  - Engage your creative muscles!  -It’s interactive, motivating, and enjoyable.
  AR Sketch Drawing app is a tool that allows users to take a photograph or image and trace over it to create a sketch or drawing. It typically has features such as adjustable line thickness, different brush styles, and an eraser tool. To use the app, the user first selects an image to trace or takes a new photograph. Place phone about 1 feet above and look into the phone and draw on paper.
So how does it work?
* Select an image from the app or gallery and apply a filter to create a traceable image. After that, you will see that image on the camera screen with transparency & you have to put drawing paper or book anything on which you want to trace and draw. Your image will not appear on paper but a transparent image with camera so that you can trace it on paper.
* Draw on paper by looking at the phone with a transparent image.
* Select any image and convert it to a tracing image.
AR Sketch Drawing Premium Subscription:
* With AR Sketch Drawing Premium Subscription, you will have access to all premium features like get access for drawing lessons, explore more creative images with an Ads-Free experience.
* AR Sketch Drawing Premium Subscription is billed monthly and annually at the rate corresponding to the selected plan.
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
 Key Features
* AR Tracing: Project images onto paper using your camera and trace with precision.
* 2,500+ Guided Lessons: Learn to draw with bite-sized tutorials covering doodling, sketching, painting, and handwriting.
* Stroke Evaluation: Receive instant feedback on line accuracy and stroke quality to track your progress.
* Creative Templates: Access a vast library of traceable images, including animals, cars, nature, and more.
* Apple Pencil Support: Enhance your digital drawing experience on iPad.
* Stress-Free Learning: Enjoy a game-like, relaxing environment suitable for beginners and pros alike.
 Terms of Use :- https://drawtraceandsketch.blogspot.com/2026/02/ar-drawing-ar-sketch.html
Privacy Policy :- https://drawtraceandsketch.blogspot.com/2023/06/draw-trace-draw-trace-sketch-app.html

bluejetty:00066412:ios.description:
Phone Case DIY is a phone case maker game where you can show your creative side and enjoy the custom art and see the phone evolution just the way you like it!
We know, this is the DIY game you were looking for!
Customize your phone case with the tons of features we have!
Game Features:
PAINTING - Spray Paint in all of the colors you can imagine! Embrace the beauty of the colorfy experience as you transform your device into a happy canvas.
ACRYLIC ART - Acrylic color and tie dye art on your Phone Case!
STICKERS - Choose many cool stickers for a fancy look
POP IT - phone case like your favorite fidget toys
STENCIL ART technique, as well as water marbling and injection coloring just like jelly dye
CLEAN IT - Clean your phone from dust and mud before you draw and decorate it
WIRELESS HEADPHONES CASE - there aren’t many headphones diy games, but here you can enjoy designing and painting their case. 
So how about you make it super pretty with some serious customization work? 
Unleash your creative mind and splash some color on this phone!
Make it glow! Make it bling! Make it glitter! Make it yours!
If you like DIY games, we have the perfect one for you. Dive into the world of acrylic, stencil and slime art. Let your case reflect your personal style with flair!
Choose your favorite happy color, draw, mix and paint, pop it and spray paint all over the phone case!
Become a colorfy master at drawing phone cases, create stickers, spray paint all over them and enjoy designing with this coloring game. All kinds of unique combinations to draw in your coloring game of choice. 
Get ready to unlock a happy color world of dye, mix and paint, and slime art design. Very easy to play, this surely will become one of your favorite DIY games!

bluejetty:00089091:ios.summary:
Start with some free money (thanks, sponsors!) then match up against other players in simple minigames to multiply your money. Cashout via PayPal.
[ PLAY & WIN FOR FREE ]
TallyUP is a new kind of game show that is 100% free to play, enabli
bluejetty:00089091:ios.description:
Start with some free money (thanks, sponsors!) then match up against other players in simple minigames to multiply your money. Cashout via PayPal.
[ PLAY & WIN FOR FREE ]
TallyUP is a new kind of game show that is 100% free to play, enabling anyone to compete in fun, simple, and very fair minigames and win up to millions of dollars in real prize money!
Start by receiving a small amount of free, real money, which is paid for by our game show sponsors.
Then get matched against another player who also has some real money from sponsors, and compete in one of our simple 1-minute minigames to determine who wins the pot and continues doubling their money.
Minigames can be learned, played and won by anyone in just minutes.
With Power Play, prize money accrues very quickly. If you start with even one penny, it can double each time you win a game, turning into more than $10 in just 10 wins, $10,000 in just 20 wins, and over $10,000,000 in 30 wins!
Any time you lose, daily rewards will provide some more free money to start over. Tries per day may be limited.
IMPORTANT: When you play, you are competing against other players and NOT against TallyUP. The app simply gives money to all players and lets them compete against one another. Any time you lose, it means another player has won. We have no incentive to rig anything and our goal is to give away the maximum amount of prize money possible (to players and charities). All of which is paid for by advertisers.
Unlike other competitive games, in TallyUP there is NO WAY to spend or risk your own money. And there is no need or ability to spend money to win. Anyone can play and if you stick with it and practice, you might just win a significant amount of free money in the Game Show for Everyone.
[ FAIRNESS ]
Every player has a fair and equal chance at winning real cash prizes, and it is a matter of testing your minigame skills, outwitting your opponents and a bit of luck! Games have been designed to ensure that players are unable to cheat or get any unfair advantage. TallyUP is designed to ensure anyone and everyone has a fair shot of winning.
[ TYPES OF GAME PLAY ]
Face off with other players in short minigames to win their balance and increase your balance. These tiny games are cleverly designed minigames made to be simple, addictive and endlessly enjoyable by anyone with elements of bluffing, strategy, game theory and luck.
Play and match against other players for a thrilling live-game experience, or challenge your friends or rivals into a MatchUP and play at your own pace!
Practice and hone your mini game skills in Arcade mode, where you can face-off with other players and build up your minigame might!
[ CASHING OUT AND DONATING TO CHARITY ]
Once you reach a balance of $10 or more, you may cash out winnings via PayPal.
When you win and cash out, 10% of winnings go to charity. You may always choose to give more than 10% and make a bigger difference. Top donors are ranked on a leaderboard of TallyUP’s most generous players!
[ TEST YOUR CHOPS DURING THE SURGE! ]
Play and compete against the best players on Tuesday and Thursday evenings (6PM PT- 7PM PT) in an epic hour of high-stakes minigame madness which we call “The Surge”! Winners are celebrated publicly on the Home Screen and our social media with all the glory and bragging rights.
[ GET EXTRA CASH WITH BOXES AND MEGA SPINS ]
Each day, the Game Show allows you 3 chances to open a mystery prize box to determine how much free money you will start with – anywhere from 1c up to 50c. 
However, you can also earn Mega Spins, which give you access to a special wheel! Mega Spins let you win at least 25c and up to $20!
Note: Apple, Inc. is not a sponsor of TallyUP tournaments, giveaways or prizes.

Explore Jewish Wisdom with Rabbi Ari: AI Chatbot
Welcome to "Rabbi Ari: AI Chatbot," your premier mobile guide for delving into Jewish texts and traditions through advanced AI technology. This app is designed for anyone eager to deepen their understanding of Jewish teachings, offering personalized, interactive chat experiences.
What You Can Expect:
Interactive AI Chat: Engage in meaningful conversations with Rabbi Ari, an AI-powered chatbot, to explore intricate questions and receive detailed answers about Jewish laws, ethics, history, and philosophy.
Tailored Biblical References: Rabbi Ari not only responds to your inquiries but also directs you to specific verses and resources within the Bible and other sacred texts, enhancing your study and understanding.
Learn at Your Pace: The app caters to learners at all levels, guiding you through the complexities of Jewish thought from the Torah and Talmud to modern interpretations.
Features:
AI-Powered Insights: Use cutting-edge AI to navigate the vast landscape of Jewish literature, from Torah study to Talmudic debates.
Rich Content Library: Access a comprehensive database covering everything from basic religious principles to intricate theological discussions.
Sleek, User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a distraction-free environment focused on your educational journey.
Community Engagement: Share insights and learn from a community of fellow enthusiasts, enriching your educational experience.
Continuous Content Refresh: Regular updates keep the app’s content fresh and relevant to ongoing religious studies and discussions.
Ideal for:
Individuals eager to explore Jewish religious texts.
Educators and students looking for a dynamic teaching and learning tool.
Anyone interested in the intersection of faith, tradition, and technology.
Enhance Your Learning Experience: "Rabbi Ari: AI Chatbot" marries traditional Jewish learning with modern technology, offering an accessible, engaging platform for exploring Jewish heritage. Whether you're studying alone or with others, this app serves as a bridge to millennia of Jewish wisdom, now at your fingertips through interactive chats.
Download "Rabbi Ari: AI Chatbot" today and begin a profound journey through Jewish learning, enriched by AI-driven insights and direct references to sacred texts.

bluejetty:00128949:ios.description:
No. 1 App for ZIP/RAR file management on iPhone/iPad! Most secure and fast Zip utility for business and professional users. 
iZip is a ZIP file management tool on iPhone and iPad. iZip has the following features: 
- Unzip files from ZIP format, including password protected and AES encrypted ZIP files. 
- Unzip many compressed files, including: RAR, 7Z, ZIPX, TAR, GZIP, BZIP, TGZ, TBZ, ISO, DEB, CAB, JAR, RPM, CBS, and more.
- Compress files into ZIP file. 
- Compress photos and videos from Photo Album. 
- Compress files with a password or AES encryption. 
- Open and view many document types: DOC, Excel, PPT, PDF, TXT, RTF, Pages, JPG, GIF, PNG, audios and videos.
- Open files directly from iCloud, Dropbox, Box, One Drive, and Google Drive.
- Upload/download files to/from Dropbox, Box, One Drive, and Google Drive. 
- Support Files app. Open files from iCloudDrive, other cloud drives, and third party Apps in Document Browser. Save files to iCloudDrive, other cloud drives and third party Apps.
- Append files to a ZIP file. 
- Support multiple ways of sharing files, including: Email, Message, Airdrop, Open in another App.
- Save photos to Photo Album. 
- Support HEIC to JPG conversion. Support different image sizes. 
- Print documents. 
- Download/upload files through iTunes.
- Support Face ID and Touch ID. 
With its simple interfaces, iZip provides the easiest way to manage ZIP files on iPhone and iPad. 
If you have any questions, please visit: http://www.comcsoft.com/Portfolio/our_apps/iZip/iZip_overview.php

1.) Log in to Planning Center, open any plan in your schedule, and choose which PDF to view for each song.

bluejetty:00179926:ios.name: Screen Mirroring - TV Cast Air
bluejetty:00179926:ios.summary: Screen Mirroring Z enables users to mirror their phone's screen to any smart TV wirelessly and in real-time without any delays. The app is ideal for making presentations, watching movies, or playing games on your TV. It supports TVs with we
bluejetty:00179926:ios.description:
Screen Mirroring Z enables users to mirror their phone's screen to any smart TV wirelessly and in real-time without any delays. The app is ideal for making presentations, watching movies, or playing games on your TV. It supports TVs with web browsers and those that support the following discovery protocols: DLNA, DIAL, Chromecast, and UDAP.
It is important to note that Screen Mirroring Z is not affiliated with any TV brands such as Samsung, LG, Sony, Roku, and others.
The app has several features, including the ability to mirror your phone's screen to your TV, cast photos and videos from your photo library to your TV, and mirror your phone's camera to your TV.
To mirror your phone's screen to your TV, you need to connect your phone and your TV to the same WIFI network. Then, open the app and connect it to your TV. After that, tap the "Screen Mirroring" button and follow the instructions to start mirroring.
Screen Mirroring Z offers a premium version that allows users to remove ads and unlock all features. You can choose to make a one-time payment or opt for a yearly or monthly subscription (with a 3-day free trial). Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the confirmation of purchase, and subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
The app's privacy policy and terms of service can be found on the developer's website at https://evolly.app/privacy-policy/ and https://evolly.app/terms-of-service/, respectively.

bluejetty:00146196:ios.description:
Welcome to the amazing world of Alcana! Play this Match-3 game with unsurpassed graphics and an exciting storyline; restore magical forests and castles; upgrade your fairy-tale creatures and look for ancient artifacts that will help you solve puzzles!
Your journey will be full of various locations inhabited by fairy-tale creatures and teeming with dangerous mysteries: Enchanted Forest, Burning Lands, Floating Islands, Underwater World, Snow Peaks, Charmed Garden, Forgotten Caves, Other Worlds and many others...
You will be confronted by witches, werewolves, trolls, krakens, dragons... But! Don’t worry! You can strike the right note with everyone, and you can even make friends with them!
A young dragon, a snow yeti, a time keeper and many other characters will take your side, and their help will be indispensable for you while you are completing the game tasks!
Game features:
● Unsurpassed graphics and an exciting story with many twists and turns!
● Unique playable characters, each with their own ability. Young Sparky will help you with his fiery breath, wise Marvin will give you extra moves, and mysterious Forest Spirit will enchant the game field...
● Ability to upgrade characters in exchange for the coins found. The stronger the hero – the more effective their ability!
● Many chapters made in different styles: from the Burning Lands – to the abandoned land of dragons and to the Flying Islands.
● Solve ancient puzzles to find powerful artifacts! Each artifact will provide you with invaluable assistance in completing Match-3 game levels.
● Complete weekly challenges, participate in tournaments, compete with other players in PvP, and discover many other game modes!
Story of Alcana is a free game, but some in-game elements can also be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00121344:ios.summary:

The game is still under active development. We carefully read all your comments and feedback to make sure every new update counts. Thanks for your support!
Jurassic Monster World 3D FPS is a mobile game like you've never seen
bluejetty:00121344:ios.description:
Hey everyone!
The game is still under active development. We carefully read all your comments and feedback to make sure every new update counts. Thanks for your support!
Jurassic Monster World 3D FPS is a mobile game like you've never seen before. Battle metal-plated monster dinos in a post-apocalyptic world! A synchronized 5x5 PvP action shooter with different modes! Control beasts on land or in the sky, fully mechanized, augmented or all-natural: the choice is yours!
Tame and command dozens of blood-thirsty metal hunters ready to destroy anything in their paths to win!
Gameplay: 
Unique setting! 
A harsh new world where only the strongest survive!
Game mechanics galore 
Chew through enemies in melee attacks or strike from a distance, sabotage on the sly or hurl headlong into battle!
Tons of different creatures
Metal, all-natural or augmented: take your pick!
Skills, skills, and more skills
Every dino is unique and has its own abilities, including dashes, jumps, splatter stuns, regeneration and more.
Land and air battles
Sky battle fans rejoice! We've got flying dinos and more. Pick your battleground!
A wealth of weapons
Equip your dino with any weapon you want, from traditional guns to next-gen energy blasters!
The game has 3 main dino types, including: 
1. Mechanized – AI machines devoid of any biological tissue and mercy. Specially equipped with an energy shield against weapons from the old world.
Tyrannosaurus is at the top of the metal jungle food chain. He can jump from place to place with super speed and stun several enemies at once. Deadly in melee battles. One false move and the enemy is toast.
2. All-natural – Life is evolving in round 2 upon the ruins of the destroyed old world. Now monsters from the Jurassic Era are out to kill, not to live.
Spinosaurus is an insatiable hunter killer. Dino butchers preying on lesser animals, spinosauri can hold their own in melee battle and against enemies with superior strength. Their jumps give them unmatched mobility, and their mighty roar can stun a whole group of enemies, leaving them open to deadly attacks.
3. Augmented – On the border of human and machine, they are the best of both worlds. Human intellect mixed with advanced tech form a deadly combination.
Triceratops – You don't want to get in his way when he's charging. Triceratops are always on the hunt for their next victim. Their razor sharp horns are tough to dodge in melee battle, and these beasts can even restore their own health if they need to. 
Jurassic Monster World 3D FPS is free to download and play, but some in-game elements are available for purchase. The game requires a stable internet connection. Mobile internet will do, but Wi-Fi is best.
Join our community:
https://www.facebook.com/jurassicmonsterworld

Welcome to Word Blocks 2025, a one-of-a-kind word puzzle game that brings together the best elements of Word Connect, Crosswords, and Anagrams! For fans of word games like Scrabble and Word Search, this free offline game is destined to be your new favorite.

Venture into an immersive word discovery journey that challenges your vocabulary and puzzle-solving prowess. Unearth hidden words, grapple with diverse difficulty levels, and enjoy a word challenge that keeps you captivated, whether you're a novice or a seasoned word game whiz.

Boost Your Brain Power

Customize Your Experience
Unlock alluring themes to tailor your gameplay. As you progress, earn rewards and personalize your word game journey.
Features
* Thousands of challenging word puzzles to put your skills to the test.
* Play offline - no need for WiFi!
* Daily brain teasers to keep your fun fresh.
* Unlock stunning themes to make the game your own.
* Intuitive, user-friendly interface.
* Perfect for word game enthusiasts of all ages.
* Seamlessly functional on both phones and tablets.
Download Word Crush 2025 today - the ideal game for lovers of Scrabble, Word Search, and Word Connect. Kickstart your word exploration journey, play anytime without the need for WiFi, and exercise your brain like never before!

bluejetty:00137379:ios.description:
Introducing Pusher Master - Coin Fest, the ultimate coin pusher adventure that brings the excitement of pushing coins and winning big right to your fingertips!
Looking for a free arcade game that blends nostalgia with nonstop action? You’ve found it.
If you love classic arcade-style coin pushers, combined with the thrills of a Vegas-style casino, then this is the game for you.
Step into the world of Pusher Master - Coin Fest, where each push of a coin can bring you closer to incredible rewards and non-stop fun. With vibrant graphics, thrilling sound effects, and interactive gameplay, this game will keep you coming back for more.
Enjoy the fun of pushing coins, unlocking surprises, and filling your board with cascading wins!
Game Features:
Nostalgic Gameplay: Experience the classic coin pusher mechanics that you know and love. Watch as the coins drop, push more coins forward, and collect exciting prizes along the way.
Unique Boosters: Use special coins and boosters to enhance your gameplay. Giant Coins, coin walls, and other power-ups will help you push more coins and increase your winnings.
Exciting Prizes: Collect a variety of unique prizes, including bonus coins, jackpots, and other rewards. Every coin drop brings new opportunities to win.
Daily Challenges: Return every day for new challenges and fresh bonuses. Get free coins, complete daily quests, and watch your rewards grow.
Vegas-Style Attractions: Feel the thrill of Vegas with spinning wheels and slot machines that add extra excitement to your coin-pushing experience.
Challenge your timing and reflexes in this satisfying and highly addictive arcade experience.
Key Features:
Stunning Graphics & Sounds: Enjoy colorful visuals, smooth animations, and immersive sound effects that bring the excitement of the casino to your mobile device.
Interactive Gameplay: Take control with interactive elements. Shake the machine for extra coins, use boosters strategically, and watch your winnings pile up.
Perfect for players who love fun, quick gameplay with lots of satisfying feedback and visual effects.
Endless Fun: With new prizes to collect and coins to push every day, the fun never stops in Pusher Master - Coin Fest.
How to Play:
Push Coins: Drop coins onto the pusher and watch them push more coins forward. Keep your eyes on the prizes!
Use Boosters: Activate special boosters like Giant Coins and coin walls to maximize your winnings.
Collect Coins: The more coins you push, the more prizes you unlock! Keep pushing and see how far you can go.
Whether you’re on a break or deep into a gaming session, it’s always a good time to play Pusher Master - Coin Fest.
At Pusher Master - Coin Fest, the joy of pushing coins and winning prizes is endless. Whether you’re a fan of classic arcade games or just looking for a fun way to pass the time, this game has everything you need to enjoy hours of entertainment.
Ready to push, win, and celebrate? Download Pusher Master - Coin Fest today and join the ultimate coin pusher adventure. The festival of coins and prizes is waiting for you!
Note:
Pusher Master - Coin Fest does not offer real money gambling or an opportunity to win real money or prizes. This game is intended for adult audiences for entertainment purposes only.
Practice or success at social casino games does not guarantee future success at real money gambling.
This game includes in-app purchases.
The “Coins” and “Bonus” mentioned above are game currency, not real money. You can only use them to play within the game.
