Turn any photo into a viral AI video in seconds.
Dance, transform, and star in your own cinematic clip. Bring old family photos back to life. Hugi is the fastest way to create scroll-stopping AI videos from a single photo or a text prompt — no editing skills, no timeline, no watermarks on your best moments.
Creators, families, and casual posters are using Hugi to make content that actually gets shared. If you've seen an AI transformation video go viral on TikTok or Reels, chances are it was made in under 60 seconds in an app like this one.
WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
• AI Dance Videos — trending dance moves applied to your selfie
• Action & Fight Scenes — movie-style fight choreography from one photo
• Transformation Videos — glow-ups, age shifts, outfit swaps
• Anime & Cartoon Effects — turn yourself into an anime character in motion
• Cinematic AI Clips — film-grade camera moves and lighting
• Prank Videos — funny AI reactions perfect for stitches and duets
• Magic & Visual Fantasy — floating, flying, elemental powers
• Text-to-Video — describe any scene, watch Hugi generate it
WHY HUGI
• Powered by the latest AI video models — cinema-grade text-to-video with advanced effect pipelines
• Audio-enabled effects on select styles for fully shareable clips
• New trending effects added weekly — stay ahead of the feed
• HD export, optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat
• One-tap share — no cropping, no re-rendering
• Available in 9 languages — English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Polish
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick an effect or type a prompt
2. Upload a photo
3. Tap generate — your video is ready in under a minute
4. Download or share instantly
JOIN CREATORS ALREADY USING HUGI
Thousands of creators and families use Hugi every week to turn memories into motion. Whether you're turning an old family photo into motion, riding a trending dance, or building viral content for your brand — Hugi gives you studio-grade AI in your pocket.
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
Your photos are yours. We don't train models on your uploads, and your generations stay private unless you choose to share.
DOWNLOAD HUGI TODAY
Your next viral post is one photo away.

Hugi offers Weekly and Annual auto-renewing subscriptions that unlock unlimited AI video generations, premium effects, and priority processing. Prices vary by region and are displayed in the app before purchase.

• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00156173:ios.description:
Driving across town or across the country, AARP Roadside Assistance from Allstate lets you travel with confidence and peace of mind. Designed exclusively for AARP® members, AARP Roadside Assistance offers 24-hour emergency roadside service and a variety of travel and car care benefits. 
The AARP Roadside Assistance app has been carefully designed to make requesting assistance faster, more accurate, and convenient.
Functions:
•Request assistance for a mechanical issue, dead battery, flat tire, out of fuel, lock out, and more
•Use GPS, maps and satellite to pinpoint the vehicle location 
•Follow a dialogue assisting you in diagnosing the problem and requesting appropriate service
•Retrieve confirmation service is on the way and the estimated time of arrival 
•Your AARP Roadside Assistance from Allstate membership number confirms eligibility for Roadside Assistance under your plan.
The app is free to use with your AARP Roadside Assistance from Allstate membership.
AARP Roadside Assistance from Allstate
© 2018 Allstate Insurance Company

bluejetty:00070378:ios.summary:
Nowa Poczta INTERIA jest darmową aplikacją do obsługi poczty elektronicznej.
Działa szybko, jest bardzo intuicyjna i prosta w użyciu. Możesz dodać w niej każde konto pocztowe, dzięki czemu będziesz mógł wysyłać i odbierać maile z różnych
bluejetty:00070378:ios.description:
Nowa Poczta INTERIA jest darmową aplikacją do obsługi poczty elektronicznej.
Działa szybko, jest bardzo intuicyjna i prosta w użyciu. Możesz dodać w niej każde konto pocztowe, dzięki czemu będziesz mógł wysyłać i odbierać maile z różnych kont w jednym miejscu.
Nowa Poczta Interia umożliwia obsługę:
• Gmail
• ONET poczta
• WP poczta
• poczta O2
• Yahoo
• Apple
• Microsoft
Chcieliśmy aby obsługa wiadomości e-mail na Twoim telefonie była jak najlepsza. Nasza aplikacja pocztowa udostępnia pełną funkcjonalność poczta Interia. Za bezpieczeństwo i prywatność twoich maili odpowiadamy w pełni, jako jedna z największych firm internetowych w Polsce z wieloletnim doświadczeniem w świadczeniu usług pocztowych.
Jeśli podoba Ci się nasza aplikacja to będziemy wdzięczni za 5 gwiazdkową ocenę.
Co nas wyróżnia:
• dostęp do załączników bezpośrednio na liście maili
• podgląd zdjęć na liście wiadomości – nie musisz otwierać maila aby podejrzeć zdjęcie
• filtry użytkownika, w tym filtr „od znajomych”, dzięki któremu jednym kliknięciem na liście maili zobaczysz wyłącznie maile od osób z którymi korespondujesz
• możliwość dostosowania wyglądu poczty poprzez dodanie własnej tapety
(zarządzanie z poziomu desktopa)
• automatyczne odpowiadanie na maila z adresu, na który został przesłany
• unikalny system grupowania wiadomości (wątkowanie wiadomości) – po wejściu do maila masz możliwość zapoznania z całą korespondencją na dany temat.
• automatyczne filtry – jednym kliknięciem decydujesz, które maile mają być automatycznie przenoszone.
Najważniejsze funkcje:
Nawigacja:
• prosta nawigacja umożliwiająca łatwe poruszanie się po całej aplikacji
• przejrzysta lista wiadomości z podglądem załączników graficznych widocznych na pierwszy rzut oka
• na liście maili widoczne oznaczenia typu załączników
• intuicyjne pisanie wiadomości z możliwością dodawania wielu załączników za jednym razem (uzależnione od wersji iOs)
• awatary na liście wiadomości ułatwiające odnalezienie maili od konkretnego nadawcy
• możliwość ustawienia własnego awatara widocznego dla odbiorców Twoich maili
• filtry użytkownika, w tym między innymi filtr „od znajomych”, dzięki któremu jednym kliknięciem w odebranych zobaczysz tylko maile od osób z którymi korespondujesz
• rozbudowana lista maili
• menu kontekstowe pojawiające się wtedy kiedy go potrzebujesz (swipe na liście wiadomości)
Zdjęcia:
• opcja prostego przeglądania i pobieranie zdjęć – załączników w Galerii
Ułatwienia:
• rozbudowane, błyskawiczne powiadomienia umożliwiające szybką odpowiedź
• szybkie opróżnianie folderów spam i kosz 
• zaawansowana wyszukiwarka
• szybkie wylogowanie
• operacje na wielu wiadomościach
• i wiele, wiele innych.
Aplikacja działa zarówno na tabletach, jak i na smartfonach. Świetnie wygląda i działa na każdym urządzeniu.
W razie jakichkolwiek problemów, prosimy o kontakt pod adresem pomoc@firma.interia.pl.
Na wszystkie maile odpowiemy niezwłocznie.

bluejetty:00119631:ios.description:
Work from Home as a Laundry Pro & Earn up to $6000/month
A NEW KIND OF GIG
Poplin welcomes service-and-detail-obsessed people into a career as a Laundry Pro. It’s the perfect gig for a domestic diva (or divo) who takes pride in their work, but wants to be home.
HOW IT WORKS 
1. Sign up & learn. Once you create an account, you’ll have access to our best practices videos and a 10-min Getting Started guide. 
2. Accept the jobs you want. We’ll alert you to jobs in your area and guide you through your first order. It’s always up to you when you work.
3. Pick up, launder, return — repeat. Start turning laundry piles into perfection (and cash). Wash, dry, fold and return the next day. 
EARN A LIVING ON YOUR TERMS
Poplin is flexible and supports your earnings goals. Go all-in or pick up a load here and there to cover an expense.
$5800/month
Average earned by our top 10 Laundry Pros
$2500/month
Average earned by our top 100 Laundry Pros
AT HOME BUT NEVER ALONE 
Whether fabric care is woven into your DNA or you’re looking to refine your folding techniques, Poplin’s Laundry Pros join an active community of over 20,000 people sharing tips and tricks of the trade every day.
HOW MUCH DO I ACTUALLY GET PAID?
Price per pound earnings range depending on location and service speed requested by customers. Many Laundry Pros gig part time and earn to save for a vacation, pay a particular bill, or contribute to a college fund.
There is a guaranteed minimum per order, so you'll always make at least $22.50 per order (plus tips) — with higher minimums in some areas. 
WHAT ARE MY HOURS AND WORK AREAS?
That’s up to you. You’re the boss. You set your hours and your work area. Work when you want; take off when you feel like it.

bluejetty:00004079:ios.description:
A simple but comprehensive, brief and clear personal & business finance management app. 
Be good at managing money matters will make your life relaxed and well-organized.
Check your Accounts transactions and balance;
Check Transactions under a Category;
Create Budgets and track transactions under them;
Track income and expense Bills and make sure they are paid on time.
View Transactions by date.
It supports multiple profiles; you can track yours, family members or business finance separately.
It can list your transaction by daily, weekly, monthly or yearly, and generate kinds of reports, so you can see clearly about your earnings and spending.
Key Features:
⁃ Add a transaction with photo of receipt, payees, account, category, budget, check number, and date. 
⁃ Track total accounts balance and balance of each account.
⁃ Check transactions of each account.
⁃ Create categories and sub-categories.
⁃ Check transactions and amounts under a category.
⁃ Create budgets and transaction their transactions.
⁃ Calendar and list view of bills.
⁃ Mark bills as fully or partially paid.
⁃ Create bills reminders to make sure they are paid on time.
⁃ Calendar and list view of Bills.
⁃ Track income and expense bills with or without a repeat cycle.
⁃ Show all transactions by daily, weekly, monthly and yearly.
⁃ Copy transaction to quick add a new one.
⁃ Hide or show cleared transactions.
⁃ Add repeat and one time transactions.
⁃ Mark transaction as cleared or not.
⁃ Dividing one transaction to multiple.
⁃ Built-in calculator or default keyboard to enter amount.
⁃ Check total accounts balance chart view.
⁃ Supports multiple currencies.
⁃ Search transactions by payee, category, account, amount or note.
⁃ Over view of recently finance status.
⁃ Nine finance reports.
⁃ Supports multiple groups, manage your personal, family member and business finance separately.
⁃ Passcode protection.
⁃ Share data by email.
⁃ Supports AirPrint.
⁃ iCloud backup and restore.
⁃ Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Create multiple reminders.
⁃ Refresh exchange rate or change them manually.
⁃ Supports Today Widget.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch.
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad).
Payment:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscribe semiannual. You will be charged in your local currency at the prevailing exchange rate as defined by iTunes."
Purchase semiannual subscription for all features for USD$2.99.
Auto Renew：
Once subscribes, your account will be charged USD$2.99/semiannual, based on your previous subscription, for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Change Subscription Type：
If you want to change your subscription type, Open the "Settings" app. Tap your name, then tap "Subscribe." Tap the name of the subscription you want to change. If different types of subscriptions are available, a list will be displayed. Tap the desired option.Tap "Buy".
Share Subscription：
If you want to share a subscription with family, please open the Settings app, tap your name and Subscriptions. Then tap the name of the subscription that you can share with family, scroll down and turn on Share with Family.
Cancel Subscription：
Subscriptions are managed by your Apple account and auto-renewal can be turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in Account Settings after purchase.
By completing your subscription, you agree to app's Term of Use & Privacy Policy.

bluejetty:00145952:ios.description:
No more boring Pilates! Get Peachy online with actual instructors from our studios. This is a complete digital health hub - a one stop shop for your body, mind and soul. All our workouts can be completed at home, in the gym or wherever you are and the majority are under 30 minutes so you can get a sweat on and then get back to your day. - Huge library of - mostly healthy but always delicious - recipes that anyone can make at home.
- Pre-natal programs to keep you fit during pregnancy. All instructors are pregnancy trained.
- Post-natal program to help you return to movement after birth.
- New workouts and recipes added every month.
- No commitments and no lock in contracts, cancel whenever you like.

bluejetty:00100543:ios.description:
Train Your Brain — Classic Klondike Solitaire
A relaxing brain training solitaire designed for seniors, suitable for players of all ages. Keep your mind sharp with daily card play — Draw 1 & Draw 3 Klondike modes included. Offline play, no Wi-Fi needed.
Large Card Design & Eye-Friendly Visuals
Big cards, bold fonts, and an eye-care color palette make every card easy to see — even in bright light. Varied themes, smooth animations, and left-handed solitaire mode create a comfortable experience for long play sessions.
Journey Mode — World Tour Solitaire
Embark on a solitaire journey across 27 countries. Unlock 130+ real-world landmarks, collect worldwide postcards, explore cultural background stories, and track your travel miles across a global adventure map.
Unlimited Hints & Undos — Never Get Stuck
Advanced hints use a two-phase search (fast + deep) to detect dead-ends before they happen and guide you to the best move. Unlimited hints and unlimited undos keep the game friendly and frustration-free — perfect for beginners and seniors alike.
Trophy Collection & Achievements
Build your trophy collection, complete milestone challenges, and earn rewards as your solitaire journey spans the globe. A rich achievement system keeps every session meaningful.
Offline Solitaire — No Wi-Fi Needed
Classic Klondike offline — play anywhere, anytime. No internet connection required. Great for travel, commutes, or quiet moments at home.
Core Features
• Brain training solitaire: Draw 1 & Draw 3 Klondike
• Large card design — easy to see for seniors
• Eye-friendly design & eye-care mode
• Left-handed solitaire mode
• Unlimited hints & undos (advanced hints)
• Solitaire journey: 130+ landmarks, worldwide postcards, travel miles
• Trophy collection & comprehensive achievements
• Varied themes
• Offline solitaire — no Wi-Fi needed
• Designed for seniors, suitable for players of all ages
Download now and start your solitaire journey — train your brain, explore the world, and collect postcards from every corner of the globe.

bluejetty:00161490:ios.description:
With Cifras Offline, you'll have an immense collection of chorded songs on your phone.
There are over 320,000 songs with chords and tabs from more than 7,500 artists already stored in the app, eliminating the need to access the internet for the chords.
The app features a chord dictionary with over 8,300 chords and more than 34,000 chord variations for Guitar, Ukulele, Keyboard, and Cavaco.
Once you select a chorded song or tab, the app loads it into a viewer where you can automatically scroll through the song, adjust scrolling speed, and associate the chorded song with a video for easier learning.
In the chord and tab viewer, you can change the key of the song, allowing for better execution and matching the singer's vocal range.
If you encounter an unfamiliar chord while playing a song or need to find a more accurate variation, the app has a feature to display the chord of the song by clicking on it, along with its variations.
A search tool is available to easily find a song or artist among the vast options.
To make things even easier, the app allows you to favorite artists and songs, making access to your most played songs and artists much quicker.
In addition to favoriting preferred artists or songs, the app offers the functionality to create setlists, allowing you to quickly access collections of songs for each occasion.
If you have original songs, the app allows you to manually input them, enabling you to view them with the available app features.

bluejetty:00171826:android.name: Summoners Raid: War Legend RPG
bluejetty:00171826:android.summary: Summon legendary heroes, pick your team of fantasy champions and win epic boss battles in this fantasy rpg turn based role-playing game. RPG summoning games with turn-based fights offer fun for months and Summoners Raid is going to delivery
bluejetty:00171826:android.description:
Summon legendary heroes, pick your team of fantasy champions and win epic boss battles in this fantasy rpg turn based role-playing game. RPG summoning games with turn-based fights offer fun for months and Summoners Raid is going to delivery in graphics, tactical gameplay and RPG elements. You will enjoy strategy of building powerful teams of heroes for single player role playing campaign and online PvP in competitive multiplayer league.
Summoners greed is getting insatiable. You will be summoning mighty champions to fight for you and reclaim what was taken from you. You will raid shadow dungeons, follow epic story-line full of monstrous enemies and, if desired, aim for glory in the multiplayer PvP arena. With our fun and rewarding PvP league system, you can battle real players from whole world become one of the RPG mobile legends - true reward of mastering PvP game.
FEATURES
* Epic single player story campaign
* Team combat
* Fantasy games tactical RPG - mix good vanguard champions with support ones and effective damage dealers
* Raid dungeons full of legendary boss enemies
* Online multiplayer RPG mode - PvP game
* Turn based strategy RPG - choose right champions to defeat your enemies
* Enter the league of legends in competitive multiplayer arena
* Summon heroes - get new strong champions from shards and summoning scrolls
* Factions conquests - fight against different factions to unlock epic rewards
* Breathtaking fantasy graphics with realistic 3D heroes
SUMMON LEGENDARY WARRIORS
You will obtain powerful summoning scrolls by simply playing. Summoners war for these and you will need them to summon champions to fight for you.
CAPTIVATING DARK FANTASY STORY
You are son of Grand Summoner, most powerful among Captain Summoners who long ruled this world as kings. In the age of rise of kingoms, when magic awakened, mighty kings employed first Captain Summoners to lead and expand their armies but these powerful individuals soon found out that there is no reason to follow, just because of a crown on his head. Captain Summoners became royalty and age of magic and war followed. Infinite magic raid is no more though. Peace became more common and your family lived honorable life, until your father was slain in mortal combat before your eyes by other summoners greed and their monster of legends, demonic Cerberus. You escaped, with your summoning powers still weak, you will have hard time to fight for your survival and perhaps, one day, you will awaken chaos era, unleash grand monster strike and get revenge on those assassins.
ADVENTURE THROUGH EPIC RPG JOURNEY
Summoners Raid spans multiple game modes but story campaign is in its core. It spans 7 Acts, each in different parts of the world of Captain Summoners. You will visit mighty city of Brnovia and you will try to snap marvel of elven race hidden in the fortress of undead or travel through wild rift into ethereal dimension realm and demonic realm where dark forces bring nothing but ruin.
COMPETITIVE MULTIPLAYER PvP RAID ARENA
Highly addictive marvel of contest of champions and players. Raid other players and get rich and famous.
TURN BASED STRATEGY AND TACTICAL RPG
You can use autoplay to quickly and easily finish battles which are easy, but you can also take full control and enjoy amazing rpg strategy. It will come handy during multiplayer RPG games or epic boss battles where victory requires skill and ability to counter enemy affinities and strengths and exploite enemy heroes weaknesses. Always make sure that you have assembled the best raiding party so you have a chance of winning, no matter if you choose autoplay or more strategical approach.
Disclaimer: Summoners Raid: War Legends RPG is free role playing game but you can speed-up your progress with in-app purchases. Free-to-play model allows everyone to obtain all content in the game for free.

bluejetty:00154885:ios.description:
Altered states are not escapes; they are portals.
ALTERD is an AI-powered journaling app + community designed for intentional exploration of altered states of consciousness. Record state-aware thoughts in a safe, educational context. Our AI automatically analyzes your thoughts to help you with personal growth, explore your soul / mind, integrate, spark creativity, and connect with a supportive community.
Journaling & Capture
Pick your state each time you enter the app. Capture your thoughts, emotions, and reflection. Use intelligent prompts help you record the nuance details, creating a rich journal that evolves with you.
Privacy & Anonymity First
ALTERD is your private space for self-exploration. We do not allow public attribution of entries to any specific user. What you share is yours alone—safe, secure, and anonymous by default.
AI Integration and Understanding
Your entries aren’t just stored—they’re transformed. Advanced AI tools analyze your journal entries, detecting mood patterns, recurring themes, and unique insights that help you better understand your inner experiences. Look forward to AI insight summaries that automatically analyze your personal journey. Understand yourself with other AI tools - such as "Chat with your subconscious" or calling up @being or the "Brilliance Detector."
Community Feed 
Explore and share anonymously within our supportive community, united in exploring consciousness and the human experience.
Knowledge Hub 
Bridge science with spirituality. Tutorials, news, real stories, research deep dives, harm-reduction guides, and practical tips on altered states, consciousness, and mental health.
Educational & Harm Reduction Focus
ALTERD prioritizes education and safety. References to substances are solely for harm reduction and educational purposes. We do not encourage or facilitate the use, sale, or exchange of any illegal or controlled substances.
Content Moderation
ALTERD employs strict content moderation to remove any material that promotes unsafe behavior. Users must follow all local laws and regulations.
ALTERD is intended solely as an exploration tool that empowers individuals to learn about and discuss states of consciousness in a safe and legal context. We do not endorse, recommend, or encourage the use of any illegal substances, tobacco, or vaping products.
Our content does not promote, facilitate, or glamorize the sale or consumption of any controlled or illegal substances, tobacco products, vaping products, or excessive alcohol usage.
We explicitly prohibit minors from using this app in any capacity related to substance use.
We encourage users to follow all applicable laws and regulations in their local jurisdictions.
Educational and Harm Reduction Focus
Any content presented is for educational and informational purposes only and should not be interpreted as medical or legal advice.
We firmly believe in harm-reduction and responsible decision-making and provide resources or information aimed at fostering safety and well-being.
No Sales or Transactions
The app does not enable the purchase, transaction, or exchange of any controlled substances or related items.
We do not host or link to any services facilitating such transactions.
Doing so will result in a ban from our platform.
Subscription Details (ALTERD Premium)
ALTERD Premium is offered as a monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the subscription’s expiration. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID Account Settings.
For more information, please review our Terms, Privacy Policy, and EULA (linked below)
TERMS OF USE: https://www.alterd.me/terms
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.alterd.me/privacy
EULA AGREEMENT: https://www.alterd.me/eula

BE YOUR OWN BOSS

EARN MONEY
Making money is easy because you earn each time you complete a shopping or delivery order. Plus, you always keep 100% of confirmed customer tips. Incentive programs and referral offers give you the opportunity to earn even more!
EASY TO USE
After you’ve accepted a trip, the app helps you every step of the way — from navigating to the store, to helping you find items in your shopping trip, to delivering to a customer’s location.

bluejetty:00022618:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00022618:ios.description:
E240 turns your iPhone into a camcorder from the 90s. Not a filter slapped on top of a clean video. The real thing: tracking noise, colour bleed, tape wobble, a timestamp in the corner, and audio that sounds like it came off a cassette.
You pick a tape, you hit record, and what comes out looks like it's been sitting in a shoebox since 1996.
THE TAPES
Seven cassettes, from a worn-out family tape to a crisp fresh-from-the-shop one, plus a night vision mode for dark rooms. Two of them run on a real NTSC signal simulation, so the noise behaves like actual analog video instead of a static overlay. Swipe across the viewfinder to switch.
HOLD TO EAT THE TAPE
Press and hold the screen while recording and the VCR starts chewing the tape. The picture tears, rolls, and loses colour. The sound warps with it. Let go and it snaps back. Every hold plays out differently.
THE TV
There's an old TV and a VCR built into the app. Press NEXT and it digs through your photo library, cuts a short memory tape from your own clips, and plays it on the tube with the dates you actually shot them burned in. Rewind, fast-forward with proper tearing, or hit NEXT again for a fresh one. It's oddly emotional the first time.
Like one? Eject it onto the shelf, give it a name, come back to it whenever. Not quite right? Open the edit bench, cut and reorder the clips, swap the cassette, then export the whole thing to your Photos.
THE SMALL STUFF
Timestamp with the real date and time, in the proper camcorder font. Or set your own date, if you're feeling nostalgic.
Sound gets the same treatment as the picture: hiss, hum, muffled highs.
Shoot portrait or turn the phone sideways for the old 4:3 frame.
Photos too, not just video.
Already have footage? Import it and run it through any tape.
Everything you shoot saves straight to your Photos and to the in-app library.
E240 PRO
PRO unlocks unlimited recording and full editing and export for imported videos and photos. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://e240.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://e240.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00116260:ios.description:
Welcome to Zombie Hunter: Shoot or Dead, the ultimate FPS zombie shooting game where survival is your only option. In a world overrun by zombies, your mission is simple – shoot or be dead, take them down or they take you out. But it won’t be easy. Are you ready for the most epic zombie hunting experience?
THRILLING FPS ACTION WITH DIVERSE ZOMBIE THREATS AWAIT
In this zombie game, you’ll face a wide range of deadly zombies with different abilities and attack patterns, each zombie type presents its own threat. You'll need to think quickly and fight strategically to survive. Every encounter brings a new challenge, and you must be ready to face it head-on.
A MASSIVE ARSENAL OF WEAPONS TO KILL ZOMBIES
As a true zombie hunter, you’ll need the right tools, more than just courage, to fight off the relentless undead and survive. From deadly machine guns, heavy sentry guns, bazookas, rocket launchers to other powerful support equipment. There are hundreds of weapons to help you take on the zombie horde. 
REALISTIC 3D ACTION GRAPHICS
Immerse yourself in the world of zombie chaos. Feel each battle's tension and heart-pounding excitement, and fight against zombies in beautifully 3D rendered landscapes. Explore different battle zones, each filled with dangers that only the best zombie hunters can survive.
REGULARLY UPGRADE YOUR WEAPONS
In this epic survival challenge, your weapons are your lifeline. Regularly upgrade and customize your gear to stay ahead of the zombie threat. Keep your arsenal updated by upgrading to the latest modern weapons and tools to ensure you’re ready for any zombie attack that comes your way. 
FIGHT TO SURVIVE - SHOOT OR DEAD?
In this thrilling shooting game, it’s not just about killing zombies – it’s about surviving to the end. Every day is a battle for your life as you face off against waves of zombies in brutal combat. The clock is ticking, and only the strongest will survive. Can you be the last survivor in this brutal, zombie-infested world? 
Are you ready to face the zombie threats? Will you be the one to survive, or will you become another victim? Download Zombie Hunter: Shoot or Dead now and start hunting the undead in the most thrilling zombie game ever!

bluejetty:00026438:ios.description:
Mahjong Nines now has 9 games in one app!
Duel COM, a friend or online players in Nines, then relax with Mahjong Solitaire, Tile Connect, Triple Match, Tile Sudoku and more.
Big, easy-to-read tiles, a cute sticker look and a new Today's Puzzle every day.
--- 9 GAMES ---
- Nines: push tiles and line up 1–9 before your rival. Play vs COM, play a friend on one device, or play an online match (random opponent or room code). Start small on the Road to Nines and unlock the full 9-column board
- Mahjong Solitaire: match free pairs and clear the stack. Easy, Normal and Hard
- Tile Connect: link pairs with a line of up to 2 turns
- Triple Match: collect 3 of a kind in the tray
- Tile Memory: flip tiles and find the pairs
- Mahjong Slide: slide tiles to line up a pair
- Tile Sudoku: sudoku with tiles 1–9
- Tile Sort: sort tiles into stacks of 4
- Fruit Drop: drop and merge fruits up to the watermelon
--- EVERY DAY ---
- Today's Puzzle: the same board for everyone. Solve it on more days each month to earn Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond badges
- Weekly ranking: earn points in any game and climb the leaderboard
- Daily Missions and a Daily Bonus
--- COLLECT TILE THEMES ---
- 95+ tile themes: animals, food, flags, space, seasons and more
- Get pieces by playing, from missions and from the Daily Bonus, then add themes to your Tile Collection
- Invite friends to get the exclusive Friends theme
--- EASY ON THE EYES ---
- Big, readable tiles and a bright, cute sticker design
- Prefer the classic look? Choose "Classic look" in Settings > Board & tile look to bring back the original tiles, crisp outlines and green/blue boards in every game
- Play offline (online matches and rankings need an internet connection)
Also known as mahjongg or majong.
--- NINES PLUS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION) ---
Nines Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription (in-app purchase), monthly or yearly:
- No ads
- Every tile theme, including Plus-only themes (except the invite-only Friends themes)
- Always ×2 pieces
- Hints, undo and shuffles without watching videos
- Free mission swaps
- Price: shown in the app before you buy, and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase.
- Auto-renewal: the subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
- How to cancel: you can't cancel inside the app. On your device, go to Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period; the current period is not refunded.
 https://support.apple.com/118428
- Restore purchases: if you subscribed before, tap "Restore purchase" at the bottom of the Nines Plus screen.
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy Policy: https://tomople.com/privacy_policy/

bluejetty:00019336:ios.description:
Ready for the new Cricket Game 2k26 challenge?
Play with ultimate charm, realistic feel of real cricket without an overly complex game. Persons of every age can experience cricket match action games with more real and precise features than ever before. This game is specially designed for sports fans to give them a full fledge experience of what an actual stadium match feels like. Get ready to gain some experience and play among the best players in the league. It is nothing like any other cricket game that you have played before. Pick a mode you like and start the match.
PLAY THE REAL SENSATION OF CRICKET GAME:
Play cricket tournaments and leagues with international rival cricket teams like Australia, South Africa, West Indies, India, Pakistan, and many others, blaze your way across the amazing cricket final to unlock the next level and become a world superstar. Play like a PRO to win all the matches in my cricket game. Now is your chance to play for your favorite nation and serve as a hero for them by winning the trophy. Do not let your people down, take your shots with passion to win. On screen score display will help you gauge the winning team. Keep an eye out for the opponent’s score so that you can defeat them.
HIGH-QUALITY GRAPHICS AND SURROUNDINGS:
• Cricket game is constructed with vibrant graphics and lively ultra-realistic animations.
• Pleasant stadium environments in a beautiful city to bring colors to a game.
• Sound effects that bring energy and passion to cricket fans while playing the game.
• Extremely beautiful background and realistic crowd for cheering.
• Realistic stadium environment with actual boundaries and pitch.
SMOOTH TOUCH CONTROLS:
• Single finger or two simple controls for batting.
• Accurate ball hitting controller to shot at leg and offside.
• Score sixes or four by swiping in different directions of the ground.
• Landscape gameplay for realistic premium cricket practice.
• On-screen UI controls for smooth play.
• Easy game controllers to take a flick with bat.
• Play or pause the game with simple touch on the screen.
DIFFERENT PLAYING MODES TO DISCOVER REAL CRICKET ON YOUR DEVICE:
• “Quick match” select your favorite team, your opponent, several balling over’s and difficulty level to play a quick match. Score as many wickets as you can in the quick mode. This is an instant start to your cricket journey.
• “Challenge” play leagues in form of levels, beat the opponent to play next level, and move towards the world championship. Win all the levels to be a part of the world match, all players have their eyes on you. Run towards your victory with experience and good sports skills.
• “Beat your best” play as a champion cricketer, score maximum runs with a single wicket and make a record of highest runs. Your runs will determine who gets to keep the trophy.
LEARN CRICKET GAME THROUGH TUTORIAL MODE:
Learn playing cricket through integrated tutorial mode for a better cricket experience and user convenience for excellent performance in challenging modes. Learning is the best way to get experienced and then compete with the world famous teams in the league.
Play Cricket Games 2k26 Features:
-World top class teams to play the match with.
-High Quality graphics and beautiful environments
-Realistically designed stadiums with real crowd.
-In-screen score display and easy to use UI controls.
-3 different playing modes, to select the one you like.
-Screen score display, to keep points in check.
-Smooth gameplay and awesome background music.

bluejetty:00068669:ios.description:
Are you a heavy sleeper who just can’t manage to get out of bed on time?
Do you need a LOUD alarm clock that WAKES you up?
Are you late to meetings and calls?
We have created an alarm clock that will get you out of bed.
How? 
It requires you to scan a barcode.
It’s impossible to miss.
In fact, this alarm clock is so annoying, it will make you want it to stop immediately. You will HAVE to get up to turn it off.
*** Blaringly Loud Ringtones ***
Our alarm ringtones are procedurally generated and unpredictable to prevent auditory adaption. Every time one of them goes off, no matter how deep asleep you are, your brain is going to wake your body up instantly. 
*** Toothpaste Barcode Scan ***
To turn off this alarm clock, you will need to scan the barcode of your toothpaste or any other predetermined barcode.
That way, you will be forced to get out of bed to stop the alarm. Yes, you will have to look yourself in the mirror to make it stop.
*** Multiple and Repeating Alarms with LOCK Feature ***
We’ve made it impossible to cancel your alarm. There is no way to stop it from ringing once it’s set. How annoying is that? You can’t mute it either!
*** Alarm Features ***
- Interactive wake-up technology that works
- Barcode scan required to stop annoying sound
- Choose different objects with barcodes to stop alarm
- Impossible to mute
- Use it anywhere
- Crazy loud ringtones for heavy sleepers and night owls
- Procedural Ringtones¹ to never sleep through any alarm again
- Multiple, repeating alarms
- Lockable alarms to prevent yourself from cheating
- Randomizable ringtone playlists
- Mix in ringtones with your own music
*** Motivational Features ***
- Bedtime Reminder
- Bedtime Enforcer
- Morning Routine
*** Bonus Don’t Wake My Spouse Button ***
Do you want to allow your spouse to keep sleeping while your phone alert wakes YOU up? We’ve included a ‘don’t wake my spouse button,’ which comes with a super short time snooze. Trust us, your spouse will thank you later.
*** Totally Customizable ***
- Dark mode to help you power down at night
- Bright alarms
- Customizable color themes and alternative app icon colors
- Bedside Clock with changeable clock face
- Highly customizable with full-screen clock, analog clocks, digital clocks, hourglass clock, landscape and portrait, clock wallpaper, and more.
*** Say Goodbye to Bad Sleeping Habits ***
You deserve good sleep. But, you also deserve good habits. Our phone alarm clock will help you create a schedule that is productive and healthy for you. Whether you need our Bedtime Reminder or Bedtime Enforcer option, our app will ensure you are awake, alert, and enthusiastic whenever you need to be.
*** Track Your Morning Routine ***
Our heavy sleep alarm clock will help you create and track a morning routine that is right for you. Download our app today!

bluejetty:00034984:ios.summary: Wagotabi is your daily companion for learning Japanese from scratch, at your own pace, and with maximum immersion. Learn to read, write, and understand Japanese in context, while retaining Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji. Use your knowledge d
bluejetty:00034984:ios.description:
Wagotabi is your daily companion for learning Japanese from scratch, at your own pace, and with maximum immersion. Learn to read, write, and understand Japanese in context, while retaining Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji. Use your knowledge directly in context, by interacting with locals, and using Japanese in daily situations.
Discover real Japanese cities and culture while going on a quest to become a Japanese Grand Master. 
Designed in close collaboration with +300 Japanese language experts, official Japanese prefecture tourist associations and thousands of early testers, Wagotabi provides you with an immersive approach to language learning following a graded reader approach. Words and grammar points are introduced according to the JLPT standard, beginning with N5.
—
◆ START from zero: the game is beginner friendly: no initial Japanese knowledge needed. Concepts are introduced step by step and used right away in-game. Non-beginners will progress faster and equally enjoy the game.
◆ JOURNEY in Japan: Explore real cities, learn to introduce yourself, order food, ask your way to the locals and unravel hidden secrets!
◆ COLLECT new words, Kana, Kanji and get detailed explanations on grammar patterns and conjugation step-by-step. No more overwhelming Kana / Kanji / vocabulary lists.
◆ CHALLENGE Japanese Grand Masters in their castle to earn their respect!
◆ COMPETE with fellow learners on Kana and Kanji minigames and post your top scores to the leaderboard!
◆ PERSONALIZE your learning experience: benefit from our SRS tool pin-pointing your weaknesses, create your own avatar, set the game difficulty. This is your Japanese journey.
◆ ENJOY a fully ad-free experience without in-app purchase, the game can be entirely played offline!
—
(Non-exhaustive) list of features :
Interactive dictionary (with illustrations, tags etc.), clear grammar explanation, interactive tooltips, fully voiced in Japanese, SRS powered smart tests, interactions with environment, quests, 2 minigames (Kana and Kanji), boss fights, Hiragana / Katakana / Kanji stroke order and calligraphy, Kanjidex, resembling Kanji, conjugation, cloud save, advanced progress tracking tools …
—
The game is in constant development, with regular updates adding new content.
Currently available content:
+440 carefully selected words and grammar points 
+210 Kanji 
+680 example sentences 
+3000 voiced Japanese dialogues 
+400 unique NPCs in game 
All words / grammar are used extensively and in context for better retention
—
What our early testers are saying about Wagotabi:
"You guys are a blessing to bring this to the learning market!"
"I have been using some of the App's examples for my lessons and my students are responding to them really well."
"I don't have the budget to travel to Japan, however I'm totally immersed in this game, learning effectively and witnessing my progress daily."
"Thanks to this app, my kids are now self-motivated to learn Japanese and reconnect with their roots. This concept is so Kawaii!“
"I'm preparing a trip to Japan and will definitely go check these spots I already visited in-game." 
—
Privacy Policy: https://www.wagotabi.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.wagotabi.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00070802:ios.description:
Modern Battle Tanks spearhead the assault, Attack Subs prowl the oceans for lone Carriers, Ace Pilots dominate the skies with Stealth Fighters… while your hand reaches for the Nuclear Launch Button. In Supremacy: World War 3 you control the course of history on a global scale! 
Take control of one of the mightiest nations of the world and face the looming threat of World War 3. Conquer resources, forge alliances and strengthen your economy. Research devastating weapons of mass destruction and risk it all to become the dominating superpower on the planet. 
Intelligent alliances or ruthless expansion, stealth warfare or nuclear devastation? The choice is yours: The nation’s military power is awaiting your command - 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Are you ready to take control?
For fans of realistic grand-strategy games, Supremacy: WW3 offers a gigantic playing field, a multitude of military units, and infinite paths to success. Jump into a match, plan your strategy, and lead your troops to victory in the days and weeks ahead. Rank up and claim your place among the best players in this addicting World War 3 game.
FEATURES
- Up to 100 human opponents per match
- Units move in real-time across the battlefield
- Loads of different maps and scenarios
- Real military technologies and equipment
- Huge research tree with over 350 different unit types
- Three distinct doctrines: Western, European, Eastern
- Terrain based combat with stealth, radar and missiles
- Nuclear and chemical weapons of mass destruction
- Fresh content, updates, seasons and events 
- Dedicated alliance gameplay in a huge community
Join the race for the best strategy players on the planet! Jump right into World War 3, and test yourself in real time against human players across geopolitical maps of the modern world!

Supremacy: WW3 is free to download and play. Some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you do not want to use this feature, please set up password protection for purchases in the settings of your App.

bluejetty:00116379:ios.description:
Welcome to "Solitaire Pal - Card Klondike"!
This is a classic solitaire card game designed for senior players as well as all solitaire fans. We are devoted to providing a simple, enjoyable, and beneficial form of entertainment. If you enjoy solitaire card games such as Klondike, Spider Solitaire, Freecell, or Tripeaks, you're in for a real treat. Get ready to start your solitaire journey with large-sized cards, an eye-friendly interface, and intuitive gameplay!
While keeping the classic Solitaire rules intact, we’ve added several challenging modes, making this game perfect for relaxing and exercising your brain. Our big cards with large fonts ensure that even players with poor vision can easily enjoy the game. Download now and try this incredible solitaire experience!
Why Choose Solitaire Pal - Card Klondike?
Eye-Friendly and Easy to Operate
Big cards with large fonts and soft colors help reduce eye strain, making long play sessions comfortable. The controls are simple and intuitive for both new and experienced players.
Classic Yet Challenging
We retain the timeless Klondike rules and scoring system, while adding game modes like winning games, daily challenges, and solitaire journeys. Endless fun awaits!
Unique Features
- Multiple themes and background options
- Adjustable difficulty levels
- Daily challenges with trophies
- Solitaire journey mode with new twists
- Daily missions and gold rewards
- Unlimited undo and hint
- Offline play support
- Boosters to help you when stuck
- Game statistics tracking
- Left-handed mode and landscape orientation
- Draw 3 cards mode for added challenge
Say goodbye to boredom and enjoy an elaborately crafted solitaire game! Dive into the relaxing world of Solitaire Pal - Card Klondike. We're always working to improve, so feel free to contact us with suggestions: shorelineparkinc@gmail.com

bluejetty:00164201:ios.name: Pure Nature: Immersive Sounds
bluejetty:00164201:ios.summary:
Immerse yourself in the healing voices of the natural world! Be instantly transported into the great outdoors, where the tonic of wildness soothes the spirit and brings a relaxed sense of joy to your day.
Designed primarily for headphone l
bluejetty:00164201:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the healing voices of the natural world! Be instantly transported into the great outdoors, where the tonic of wildness soothes the spirit and brings a relaxed sense of joy to your day.
Designed primarily for headphone listening, this app features over 130 spacious 3D binaural soundscapes, meticulously gathered by recording artist Lang Elliott in wild and remote places across North America and beyond. New immersive soundscapes are added every month. Audio quality is superb throughout.
• Calm yourself with the all-encompassing voices of thunderstorms, rain, wind, and waves.
• Sleep soundly to the rhythmic night songs of insects, frogs, and whip-poor-wills, enlivened by the distant hoots and howls of owls and coyotes.
• Relax to gentle dawn choruses of birds, or the mesmerizing blend of birdsong and flowing water.
• Awaken to uplifting soundscapes that help clear the mind at the beginning of each new day.
• Learn about each recording while listening through detailed descriptions that include dates and locations.
• Use anywhere and anytime — in coffee shops, subways, airport terminals, workplaces — whenever you feel the need to be soothed by nature’s healing music.
Additional Features:
• ONE FREE ALBUM is included with the app, offering a complete introduction to the soundscapes.
• Full access to the entire library of 130+ soundscapes is available via a monthly or annual subscription, or through a one-time lifetime purchase for those who prefer not to subscribe.
• New, unique soundscapes are released every month and are included with active subscriptions and lifetime access.
• Discover curated soundscape recommendations personally highlighted by Lang.
• Individual recordings and full albums can be looped indefinitely, with optional timer-controlled listening sessions.
• Favorite tracks can be saved to a personalized “Favorites” list that functions just like an album.
Why Use Headphones?
These recordings were made using a special microphone that simulates the human head. To experience the remarkable 3D effect, it is best to listen with headphones, where the right ear hears only the right channel and the left ear hears only the left channel. While headphones provide the most immersive result, earbuds may also be used; however, they often emphasize treble and lack bass. To address this, the app includes a custom equalization setting specifically tuned for Apple EarPods and AirPods.
To experience nature’s magic in noisy environments, we highly recommend modern noise-cancelling headphones, which greatly reduce ambient noise. It is entirely possible to relax into pristine nature while riding a subway or flying on an airplane.
When listening through speakers in a conventional stereo setup, both ears hear both channels, creating “crosstalk” that weakens spatial cues. Placing speakers farther apart can improve spaciousness by allowing the head to naturally reduce crosstalk. While speaker listening can be enjoyable, headphones offer a far more immersive experience — one that truly transports the listener into wild nature.
Support and App Information:
If you experience technical problems or have questions about the app, please contact us at:
app@musicofnature.com
For contact information, copyright notice, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy, please visit:
https://musicofnature.com/app
Lang Elliott
Developer

bluejetty:00073384:ios.description:
Let's Boost Your Natural Beauty with 8 minutes of Face Yoga Every Day in FaceYogi!
Experience a fresh, natural facelift with FaceYogi - A holistic face yoga app that tailors a 7-day personalized program to follow your unique facial skin condition. 
You can practice face yoga, master skincare, manage stress, and nourish your body with healthy meals, achieving your perfect visage with our specially designed face yoga courses.
An incentive system helps you persist
Just 8 minutes a day
Visible effects in a short time
Features:
- FaceYogi will give you detailed and personalized face exercise course recommendations according to your facial skin issues including eye bags, dark circles, asymmetrical faces, sagging jawlines and others. Our smart coach system can generate a special 7-day face yoga program with your given information to offer you a naturally lifted, toned, healthier and fresh look.
- FaceYogi's Facial Diary motivates you to monitor your skin condition after training. By doing our face yoga courses, your skin will improve day by day. So keep track of your daily facial image, then you can see an impressive change after a short time. 
- FaceYogi's incentive system encourages you to keep practicing every day and offers you a sense of satisfaction by visual progress record. 
Our facial yoga fitness courses are scientifically designed, and focus on various objectives:
- Double chin reducing - stretch neck and chin area, stimulate blood circulation, and tight up against your muscles 
- Anti-aging - aim at reducing the lines and wrinkles on your face, like laugh lines, and replace them with a younger, fresher you.
- Skin firmness - boost facial elasticity and refresh your skin 
- Skin Spa - focus on relaxing your facial muscles 
Does Face Yoga Work?
- Yes! Numerous Studies have confirmed the benefits of face yoga. A study conducted by Northwestern University showed that practicing facial yoga for 20 weeks can not only lift the jawline and get high cheekbones but also reduce dark circles, smooth eye bags, correct lip lines and asymmetrical faces, making participants look 3 years younger on average.
All you need to do is to add 8 minutes to your morning routine and you can see a glorious face after 7 days!
What is Face Yoga? How Does it Work?
Face yoga is a series of facial exercises intended to tone the muscles in the face. This is a non-injection method of maintaining facial beauty and reducing the signs of aging.
Working Principle：
- Increase the blood circulation, awaking less used muscles
- Let more oxygen and more nourishment reach the cells of the skin and keep your skin clear of toxins
- Remove tension and stress from the muscles
- Stimulate collagen production
- Improve cell renewal
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

Payment: Payment will be charged to your Apple account on confirmation of purchase
Cancellation: cancel in your Apple account settings
Settings Renewal: your account will be charged for renewal
24 hours before the end of the current period
Privacy: https://s.bongmi.cn/miscs/face-yoga/en/privacy.html

This daycare software and a user-friendly app allows providers to send daily updates, infant sheets, photos, videos, reminders, newsletters, incident reports, schedules, and emergency notifications directly to parents through the secure, free myKidzDay Parent app. Student sign in/out app and staff attendance software is super easy. It helps boost enrollment, enhance communication, and reduce printing costs, increasing profitability.
Key Features:
For Child care & Preschool Directors and Owners:
Daycare Staff & family management
Student online registrations and enrollment paperwork
Waitlist & parent inquiry management
Real-time attendance, ratios, and reporting
Enhanced parent communication & emergency notifications
Meal tracking, CACFP reports, and menu uploads
Lesson planning and curriculum tracking
Immunization and allergy records
Financial management, invoicing, and expense tracking
W10 and tax reports
Licensing, star rating, and reimbursement reports
Staff attendance and scheduling
For Daycare Staff:
Digital daily reports (meals, naps, toileting, activities)
Instant messaging & emergency notifications
Staff and student attendance tracking, time sheets
Share pictures, videos, and documents
Voice-enabled data entry, assessments, and observations
Incident reports, newsletters, and calendar management
Tag activities with curriculum standards 
Activity and lesson planning, children's portfolios
Free daycare staff app available on all platforms
For Daycare Parents:
Free and secure app on all platforms
Real-time updates, reminders, photos, and videos
Instant messaging with providers
Eco-friendly memory journal
Unlimited storage and child portfolios
Incident reports with electronic signature capture
With over 60,000 users, myKidzDay daycare software helps childcare providers enhance communication, track attendance, streamline operations, and increase profitability, all while giving parents peace of mind.
Free no-risk trial available.
Special discounts on this daycare app for non-profits and members of NAEYC, ELL, PAHSA, GCCA, FACCM, MDCCA, and more. Can take family report exports from Procare, Brightwheel, Playground, Lillio, Class Dojo, KidKare, and other systems.

bluejetty:00070716:ios.description:
Play against 30 million opponents!
Wordfeud is a multiplayer puzzle game where you can challenge friends and random opponents and play in up to 30 separate games simultaneously!
Create and place words on the 15 by 15 tile board and earn points for creativity and placing letters on the high scoring Double Letter, Double Word, Triple Letter and Triple Word tiles.
Search for friends to play against or allow Wordfeud to match you up with an opponent. Even chat with them - smack talk or praise - it's your choice!
Tired of the same standard board each game? Choose the option to randomize the board and change up where the DL, TL, DW, TW tiles are placed - giving the classic game a new twist!
Features:
- Choose to play with friends or be matched up against random opponents
- Play in 30 simultaneous games!
- Random board option to mix up the DL, DW, TL, TW tiles
- Push notifications informing you of opponent's latest move
- Uses English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Dutch, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish and Finnish dictionaries
- Chat with your opponents
For more information on Wordfeud, visit us at Wordfeud.com and follow on Twitter @wordfeud. Also check out the Facebook fan page at http://www.facebook.com/WordfeudGame

bluejetty:00124124:ios.description:
Exciting match-3 game! Unforgettable adventures are waiting for you!
You are a young corsair, your aim is to become a pirate. To make your dream come true, you must find real treasures using old maps.
 The game consists of different episodes. In each episode you have a treasure map. Follow it to the end and you will find the pirate's treasure. 
 The principle of this game is "three in a row", which means you have to switch two elements next to each other in order to get 3 or more similar gems in a row. At each level, you have a specific list of goals that need to be completed.
 If you have any difficulties passing a level you can use coins to buy a helpful bonus. The coins are also used to restore lives and buy rum for the sailors in order to open new episodes.
 Collect treasures, compete with your friends and become a real pirate!

bluejetty:00096611:ios.name: I am Not a Robot - Brain Test
bluejetty:00096611:ios.summary:
TEST YOUR BRAIN

bluejetty:00096611:ios.description:
TEST YOUR BRAIN
Let’s face it, there are tons of brain games out there that claim to help improve your memory or concentration, but they’re nothing more than simple logic puzzles and brain tests. As the name suggests, I Am Not A Robot takes memory games and logic puzzles to the next level of fun as you have to try and prove that you are indeed human, no matter what crazy puzzle solving game comes your way! A variety of different puzzles and riddles await, ranging from concentration games to logic puzzles, brain teasers to memory games and more.
WHAT’S THE LOGIC?
Each level consists of a different type of logic game or brain teaser, and your goal is to win and prove that there are no bots here! Puzzles range from simple pictures where you need to spot the difference to more challenging riddles and brain games where you need to place the tiles correctly in a limited amount of time. With such a huge variety, both you and your brain will never get tired of seeing what test is next.
Type of challenging games and brain puzzle games you can find within our brain test:
Puzzle solving games – place pieces in the correct spot to make the picture whole
Brain training games – find the difference between pictures
Mental games – prove that you’re not a robot
Brain tests and puzzles – create images with the tools given
Fantastic features:
- Variety is the spice of life – Hundreds of levels, and tons of different types of brain training games are all crammed into this one app! While they all focus on helping you keep the old noggin sharp, you’ll always find something new to try, keeping playtime fun, exciting, and most importantly, mentally stimulating. Problem solving games will get you thinking, concentration games will help you focus, puzzle games make you think, and logic games will test your ability to think several steps ahead. And just when you think you’ve got the hang of it, here comes a super challenging game level!
- Simple yet effective – The riddles and puzzle games are specifically designed with straightforward graphics and clear instructions, allowing you to really focus on what you need to do (in this case, solve some brain teasers!) and not on distractions. Even though they’re simple, the variety and pacing of the memory games and brain puzzles will keep you on your toes as you solve one after another.
- Great for on the go – Levels are short and sweet, meaning you can quickly move on to other things… or other levels! These concentration brain games are perfect for when you’re out and about and may only have a few minutes to spare, or for when you want to sit down and have some me-time with a useful game that trains your logic. The choice is yours!
RIDDLE ME THIS
We all know the importance of keeping our minds sharp, but sometimes it can be hard to find the time or motivation. I Am Not A Robot enters the chat, with a whole host of different puzzles, logic games, riddles, and brain teasers. Fly through levels or just play a few a day, either way you’ll be strengthening your logic skills and memory, as well as having fun. These brain games, tests, and puzzles are sure to please everyone and keep the good times rolling.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00147362:ios.description:
Welcome to Kiwii Pocket!
Join Dankiwii, a famous influencer, and her raccoon companion, Makani, on an unforgettable adventure inside your phone!
Makani and Dankiwii find themselves trapped in the digital world. Now, it's up to you to help them navigate this quirky new reality.
Take Care of Makani:
- Feed, bathe, and play with Makani to keep her happy and healthy.
- Clean up after their playful antics and earn coins for your efforts.
- Catch magical fairies who bring gifts and help you progress.
- Play a variety of exciting minigames in "Playtok" mode and gain likes from your adoring fans.
- Show off your skills and rack up high scores to earn coins and unlock new games.
- Customize Dankiwii's look with a vast collection of outfits and accessories.
- Decorate your virtual space with fun and unique furniture.
- Collect adorable stickers through a gacha mechanic and complete your sticker album.
Features:
- Engaging Tamagotchi-style pet care gameplay.
- Over 30 fast-paced and addictive minigames.
- Extensive customization for your virtual space.
- Collecting unique stickers.
- Level-up system with exciting rewards and unlocks.
Are you ready to become the ultimate pet care streamer? Download Kiwii Pocket now and embark on a heartwarming adventure!
A percentage of the money earned through ads and in-app purchases will be used to help animal shelters.

bluejetty:00044928:ios.description:
Zèya: The Value Exchange Marketplace
Swipe to Swap. Buy. Sell. Make a Deal.
Welcome to Zèya, a new way to exchange value.
Zèya is a new way to exchange value. Swipe to discover items, swap what you own, buy what you want, or sell what you no longer need. Swap item for item, combine items and cash, or make a straight cash offer. More ways to exchange value, more opportunities to make a deal.
And coming soon, exchange services and skills, unlocking even more ways to get what you want without relying on money alone.
Key Features
Swipe to Discover. Explore items through our swipe-based marketplace. Find what you love, express interest, and discover new opportunities.
Swap, Buy, or Sell. Exchange item for item, combine multiple items, add cash to balance a deal, or make a cash-only offer. You’re in control of how you make a deal.
AI-Powered Listings. Snap a photo and let Zèya’s AI generate your item’s title, description, and category. List in seconds, not minutes.
Flexible Offers. Create and negotiate offers that work for both sides. Swap, Swap + Cash, or Cash Offers, all designed to help you reach an agreement.
Your Zèya Wallet. Manage money from your sales in your Zèya Wallet. Use your balance toward future deals or withdraw your funds. Payments are powered by Stripe.
Discover Locally. Find items and connect with people nearby. Explore your local marketplace and discover opportunities within your community.
Groups & Communities. Join groups based on shared interests, explore specific categories, and connect with people who value the same things you do.
Services Coming Soon. Go beyond physical items. Soon, you’ll be able to offer your skills and services as another way to exchange value and make deals.
More Value. Less Waste. Give your items a second life, unlock the value of things you already own, and participate in a smarter, more sustainable marketplace.
A New Way to Exchange Value
Zèya is more than a swapping app. We’re building a marketplace where value goes beyond money, giving everyone more ways to get what they want using what they already have.
Don’t just shop. Swipe, swap, buy, sell, and make a deal.
Join the growing Zèya community and discover a whole new way to exchange value.
No listing fees. Cashing out from your Zèya Wallet is currently available in the United States only.

bluejetty:00043930:ios.name: iFly Weight and Balance
bluejetty:00043930:ios.summary:
iFly Weight and Balance
iFly Weight and Balance is a paid service that is ideal for corporate and commercial operators and is extremely simple to use. American Aeronautics can create a weight and balance system for any aircraft. Each aircr
bluejetty:00043930:ios.description:
iFly Weight and Balance
iFly Weight and Balance is a paid service that is ideal for corporate and commercial operators and is extremely simple to use. American Aeronautics can create a weight and balance system for any aircraft. Each aircraft starting weight and cg is preset. This way you are guaranteed to have the correct starting point every time you do a weight and balance. All you have to do is add your passengers, baggage, takeoff fuel, and landing fuel. If you are out of limits, just adjust the various weights until you are within limits. It’s that easy! You will never worry about being out of limits again.
iFly Weight and Balance comes pre-loaded with one sample aircraft to demonstrate the app’s capabilities. A second sample aircraft can also be downloaded which demonstrates aircraft with complex fuel burn sequences. In order to use iFly Weight and Balance for your aircraft you must be a subscribed user. Contact American Aeronautics for details.
Please bear in mind that iFly Weight and Balance is not a generic weight and balance app that requires the user to enter aircraft specific data. Each individual aircraft is custom created by American Aeronautics to your exact aircraft type and serial number specifications and is licensed to you. We can create a system for ALL aircraft. Each aircraft is payable with a one time setup/design fee and a recurrent maintenance subscription. All pricing can be viewed at our website.
Once your aircraft is downloaded there is nothing for you to do but start adding passengers, baggage and fuel. The software is YOUR actual aircraft. There are no cg limits to program and no fuel moment data to enter. Once you have completed your weight and balance computation you can simply email a copy for your records.
All violations are shown visually. Are you too far forward? The forward cg limit will turn red. Are you over maximum landing weight? The maximum landing weight limit will turn red. Simply adjust your load until all limits are black.
Many aircraft have complex fuel burn sequences. iFly Weight and Balance depicts the exact fuel burn sequence of your aircraft.
ATTENTION TO ALL FAR 135 OPERATORS utilizing (or wanting to utilize) operations specifications A097. iFly Weight and Balance supports (dynamic) curtailing of the CG envelope as prescribed in AC120-27F. This is a requirement of A097. A098, and A099 when using standard average passenger and bag weights. Contact American Aeronautics for details.

bluejetty:00146403:ios.description:
Are you going through a break up right now? Do you need help to maintain no contact with your ex until he/she reaches out to you? If that’s the case, we’re sorry you’re going through such a difficult time. 
Our app is here to help you find stress relief through self-help affirmations and a guided meditation to manifest a text from your ex. One of the essential parts of a break up is to stop contact and focus on yourself. The app is designed with a no contact timer which you can use to count the number of days you’ve successfully stayed in no contact. You can always press the panic button to hear a short encouraging message to help you stay in no contact. 
The app is called Silenzio (this means silence in Italian). It's for people who are going through a breakup. It will help you to either move on or get your ex back.
Try Silenzio – Breakup Help, Positive Affirmations now!
Play and Record Affirmations 
Positive affirmations are a great way to remind yourself of your worth during a break up. 
Support your mental health by recording affirmations in your own voice. You can record upto three positive affirmations and play them repeatedly to help you during the no contact period and beyond. You can also track the time spent listening to your affirmations in the "Mindfulness" section inside Apple Health App. 
Upgrade to a Premium version to unlock unlimited affirmations which will enable you to listen to and record as many affirmations as you want.
Meditation to Manifest A Text From Your Ex
Listen to the guided meditation to manifest a text from your ex. Follow the easy instructions during the mediation, and set an intention for your ex to contact you. Many people have heard from their ex after listening to this mediation.
Practice No Contact Timer Restraints 
To maintain peace after the break up, it is important to cut all ties with the ex and get over the past trauma. This self help app comes with a no contact timer, which tracks the number of days you’ve successfully not contacted your ex. 
It also contains a panic button which you can press to hear a motivational message from Lucia that will stop you from breaking no contact.
Upgrade to a Premium version to unlock more than 3 motivational messages from Lucia!
Support your mental health and find the peace that you deserve. 
Best Practice Tips
Record at least 3 affirmations of what you want to manifest
While recording the affirmations, say them like you mean it!
Play the affirmations on a loop for at least 10 minutes in the morning when you first wake up, 10 minutes at night before you go to sleep and whenever your mind starts to think fearful thoughts about the breakup.
Listen to the same affirmations for at least 21 days in a row, in order to re-program your subconscious mind.
Use headphones or earbuds for best results.
Features of Silenzio – Breakup Help, Positive Affirmations, Guided Meditation
No contact timer lets users keep themselves accountable for how long they've been in no contact- A panic button in case they are about to break no contact- Guided Meditation to manifest a text from an ex
- Ability to record and play back affirmations on a loop with peaceful music and a choice of beautiful scenery in the background- Time spent listening to affirmations can be tracked in Apple Health
Download and use Silenzio – Breakup Help, Positive Affirmations today!

Study smarter with SimpleStudy – the trusted revision app for UK, Ireland & South Africa students
SimpleStudy is the all-in-one study planner and revision app made for UK, Irish, and South African students. Whether you’re preparing for your GCSEs, A Levels, Scottish Highers, Junior Cert, Leaving Cert, or NSC exams, we’re here to help you revise smarter, study faster, and feel confident on exam day.
Our app is built to match the latest AQA, Edexcel, OCR, SQA, State Examinations Commission (SEC), and DBE (Department of Basic Education) curriculum - making it the perfect exam prep tool for every student. With revision notes, quizzes, flashcards, study planners, past papers, mock exams, and even a built-in CAO Points Calculator, SimpleStudy gives you everything you need in one app to prepare for top marks.
Key Features (for better revision):
• Smart Revision Notes
Concise, topic-based study notes for GCSE, A Level, Scottish Highers, Leaving Cert, Junior Cert, and NSC that simplify difficult topics, match your syllabus, and help you revise efficiently.
• Flashcards & Quizzes
Boost your memory with interactive flashcards and topic-based quizzes. Perfect for active recall, spaced repetition, and quick study sessions.
• Mock Exams & Past Papers
Practice under exam conditions with full mock exams, timed questions, and official past papers with mark schemes. Build confidence with realistic exam prep.
• Study Planner, Progress Tracker & CAO Points Calculator
Plan your revision, set study goals, track your progress, and (for Irish students) calculate your CAO points to stay organised and on track for your goals.
• Covers All Core Subjects
Access resources for Maths, English, Irish, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, History, Geography, Business, Psychology, Sociology, Economics, Accounting, Afrikaans, and more - covering GCSE, A Level, Scottish Highers, Leaving Cert, Junior Cert, and NSC.
Aligned with UK Exams & Boards
• GCSE (Key Stage 4)
• A Level (Sixth Form/College)
• Scottish Highers (SQA)
All content follows major UK exam boards:
• AQA
• Edexcel (Pearson)
• OCR
• SQA
Aligned with Irish Exams & Curriculum
• Junior Cert (Lower Secondary)

▷ 내비게이션, TMAP
대한민국에서 가장 많은 사용자가 선택한 내비게이션, 티맵. 일상이 편리해지는 완벽한 이동의 경험을 선사해요.
2,000만 사용자의 주행 데이터를 실시간으로 수집, 가공해 최적의 경로로 안내해 드려요.
▷ 대중교통도, TMAP
버스, 지하철이 포함된 대중교통 경로를 확인할 수 있어요.
자주 가는 곳을 대중교통 실시간 경로에 등록하고 경로를 바로 확인할 수 있어요.
▷도보 이동도, TMAP
자동차 내비를 보듯, 내가 이동하는 방향에 맞춰 티맵 화면이 알아서 움직이면서 실시간 소요시간과 거리를 계산해줘요
경로를 이탈하면 즉시 현재 위치를 파악해 새로운 최적의 길을 다시 찾아드려요
출발지부터 도착지까지 전체 동선을 한 눈에 파악할 수 있어요
▷ 숏폼
이동에 필요한 정보를 이제 영상으로 만나보세요!
티맵 숏폼은 출발 전 목적지와 주변 장소를 영상으로 미리 둘러보고, 목적지 도착 후 장소 및 이동에 필요한 콘텐츠를 즐길 수 있는 서비스예요.
안전한 운전을 위해 길안내 중에는 숏폼 피드를 이용할 수 없으며, 길안내 화면에서는 영상이 노출되지 않으니 안심하세요.
▷ 소셜 제보
주행 중 사고, 공사 등 도로 상황을 직접 제보하고 다른 사용자에게 바로 공유할 수 있어요.
지도에서 다른 사용자의 제보를 확인하고, ‘있어요/없어요’ 등의 참여로 정보를 함께 검증할 수 있어요.
▷ 대리운전
대리운전이 필요할 땐, 티맵에서 쉽고 빠르게 이용하세요.
티맵 대리를 이용하면 마일리지도 적립하고 사용할 수 있어요.
▷ 운전점수
매일 쌓이는 운전 데이터 기반의 운전 점수로 자동차 보험료 할인 받으세요.
운전하는 모든 순간, 운전 생활로 더 스마트하게 관리해보세요.
▷ TMAP AI 음성비서
티맵의 새로운 AI 서비스와 함께 더 똑똑한 이동을 시작해보세요.
“속초 물회 맛집 추천해줘”, “내 주변 카페 들렸다가 집으로 가자”, ”오늘 날씨 알려줘” 등 사용자 요청 맥락에 맞는 대화가 가능해요.
▷ 어디갈까
어디 갈지 고민될 때, ‘어디갈까’가 내 주변 인기 장소부터 나를 위한 맞춤 추천까지! 가 볼만한 장소를 확인할 수 있어요.
내 주변, 취향 저격 맛집부터 주말에 가 볼만한 장소, 여행지의 맛집, 관광명소, 숙소까지 인기 장소를 알려드려요.
▷ 검색
‘인기 급상승 맛집’부터 다시 찾게 되는 ‘단골 맛집’까지 - 지금 내 위치 주변 테마별 맛집을 추천해요.
삼겹살, 파스타, 마라탕처럼 원하는 음식명으로 맛집을 검색할 수 있어요.
▷ 마이/포인트미션
새로워진 ‘마이’ 탭에서 나의 프로필을 손 쉽게 관리해보세요
마이에서 나에게 꼭 맞는 혜택도 확인하고, 다양한 미션에 참여하여 포인트도 받아보세요.
▷ 오픈 프로필
내 오픈 프로필을 통해 나의 이동 경험을 다른 사용자들에게 공개할 수 있어요.
리뷰, 저장 그룹, 숏폼 등 다양한 콘텐츠를 통해 다른 사용자들의 오픈 프로필에도 방문할 수 있어요.
▷ 전기차 충전
전국 5만기 이상의 충전기를 카드 없이 TMAP으로 이용할 수 있어요.
탭탭차지로 차 안에서 터치 한 번으로 충전기를 인증하고 이용할 수 있어요.

도보이동·대중교통·대리·주차·렌터카가 필요할 때도 티맵과 함께 하세요!

▷ 내비게이션, TMAP
대한민국에서 가장 많은 사용자가 선택한 내비게이션, 티맵. 일상이 편리해지는 완벽한 이동의 경험을 선사해요.
2,000만 사용자의 주행 데이터를 실시간으로 수집, 가공해 최적의 경로로 안내해 드려요.

▷ 대중교통도, TMAP
버스, 지하철이 포함된 대중교통 경로를 확인할 수 있어요.
자주 가는 곳을 대중교통 실시간 경로에 등록하고 경로를 바로 확인할 수 있어요.

▷도보 이동도, TMAP
자동차 내비를 보듯, 내가 이동하는 방향에 맞춰 티맵 화면이 알아서 움직이면서 실시간 소요시간과 거리를 계산해줘요
경로를 이탈하면 즉시 현재 위치를 파악해 새로운 최적의 길을 다시 찾아드려요
출발지부터 도착지까지 전체 동선을 한 눈에 파악할 수 있어요

▷ 숏폼
이동에 필요한 정보를 이제 영상으로 만나보세요!
티맵 숏폼은 출발 전 목적지와 주변 장소를 영상으로 미리 둘러보고, 목적지 도착 후 장소 및 이동에 필요한 콘텐츠를 즐길 수 있는 서비스예요.
안전한 운전을 위해 길안내 중에는 숏폼 피드를 이용할 수 없으며, 길안내 화면에서는 영상이 노출되지 않으니 안심하세요.

주행 중 사고, 공사 등 도로 상황을 직접 제보하고 다른 사용자에게 바로 공유할 수 있어요.
지도에서 다른 사용자의 제보를 확인하고, ‘있어요/없어요’ 등의 참여로 정보를 함께 검증할 수 있어요.

대리운전이 필요할 땐, 티맵에서 쉽고 빠르게 이용하세요.
티맵 대리를 이용하면 마일리지도 적립하고 사용할 수 있어요.

운전하는 모든 순간, 운전 생활로 더 스마트하게 관리해보세요.

티맵의 새로운 AI 서비스와 함께 더 똑똑한 이동을 시작해보세요.

내 주변, 취향 저격 맛집부터 주말에 가 볼만한 장소, 여행지의 맛집, 관광명소, 숙소까지 인기 장소를 알려드려요.

bluejetty:00157241:ios.description:
Attention is your go-to app for personalized doses of wisdom, designed to enhance mindfulness, self-care, and mental clarity. Whether you’re seeking motivation, support, or simply a moment of calm, this app delivers customized messages that fit into your busy life exactly when you need them.
Receive daily wisdom from trusted sources like life coaches, wellness experts, and meditation instructors, or create your own attentions for yourself or others. These thoughtful notifications, called “attentions,” offer timely reminders to focus on your intentions, reduce anxiety, and stay balanced.
Key Features:
- Custom Attentions: Personalize and schedule messages to keep you on track with your goals.
- Trusted Sources: Subscribe to experts who share motivational content that aligns with your wellness journey.
- Mindfulness on Demand: Whether it’s daily affirmations, calming insights, or reminders of self-worth, you’ll always have the right words at the right time.
- Public and Private: Choose to share your wisdom with a community or keep it private for personal reflection.
Enhance your daily routine with Attention and stay connected to what truly matters—your well-being, balance, and mental clarity.

bluejetty:00150695:ios.description:
Greenville FCU Banking is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Greenville FCU Banking:
 - Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 - Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 - Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 - Transfer money between your accounts
 - Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 - Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 - View and save your monthly statements
 - Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Greenville FCU Banking app, you must be enrolled as a Greenville FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.
