bluejetty:00018530:ios.name: 52 Week Money Saving Challenge
bluejetty:00018530:ios.summary:
Having trouble saving money?
This app was designed to help you start saving cash! The app Tracks your progress and includes reminders and notifications to help you along the way. The best part? The app is completely FREE!
How does it work?
bluejetty:00018530:ios.description:
Having trouble saving money?
This app was designed to help you start saving cash! The app Tracks your progress and includes reminders and notifications to help you along the way. The best part? The app is completely FREE!
How does it work? Well, it’s simple, you have different ways to start saving:
1. Incremental Savings Challenge: Start saving low and increase over the time your weekly savings. Start with $1 dollar the first week, then $2 dollars the second week, $3 dollars the first week, and by the end of week 52 you will have saved a total of $1,378.00 dollars.
2. Reverse Challenge: The second mode is inverse, you start saving more the first weeks and progressively save less and less every week, and by the end of the 52nd week you’ll have saved $1,378.00 dollars.
3. Fixed Amount: If you like to save a fixed amount every week, our app will track your progress and help you continue saving every week.
4. By goal: Planning on buying something? Create a goal and set the amount you want to raise, then just let our app track and help you reach your target budget!
What makes us different from all other savings apps? We have several reasons, here is our full feature list:
• Different dynamics and alternatives to make it easy and fun for you to start saving money.
• Graphs are included to help you visualize your progress.
• Our App includes notifications; we will send you notifications to remind you about your savings goals.
• Ability to create multiple Savings Goals.
• The App is Multi-language.
• No internet connection is required to use the app, and it’s designed to work for every device with any software version.
• We made it so fast and simple to use that you’ll be able to start saving money in a matter of seconds!
• We will constantly update our App to support a wider range of features.
Download Now! 52 Week Money Saving Challenge for FREE in App Store!

bluejetty:00073437:ios.summary: Transit makes it easy to get around your city. No more waiting. No more guessing when your ride will arrive – our app helps you travel by public transit in 1,000+ cities. With live departure times and real-time vehicle tracking, you’ll alwa
bluejetty:00073437:ios.description:
Transit makes it easy to get around your city. No more waiting. No more guessing when your ride will arrive – our app helps you travel by public transit in 1,000+ cities. With live departure times and real-time vehicle tracking, you’ll always know EXACTLY when your bus or train is coming. With Transit, you can get anywhere without needing a car:
• Plan the fastest route from A to B on public transportation
• Quickly compare options like bike + rail or bus + subway
• Get instant alerts about delays and disruptions
• Save your favorite destinations and lines – then plan trips in just one tap!
HERE’S WHAT THEY’RE SAYING
“Gives you the best route to where you want to go” - New York Times
“You won't realize how much time you can save planning until you use this app” - LA Times
“Killer app” - Wall Street Journal
“MBTA has a favorite transit app – and it's called Transit” - Boston Globe
“A one-stop-shop” - Washington Post
AND HERE’S THE WORD FROM PUBLIC TRANSIT RIDERS:
“Your app was the deciding factor in selling my car.”
“Blows Google Maps out of the water.”
“The head of our local transit agency recommended this app over the one her agency created.”
6 GREAT THINGS ABOUT TRANSIT:
THE BEST REAL-TIME DATA: Using the best transit agency data, GO crowdsourcing data and our in-house ETA prediction engine, we get you the most accurate real-time info possible for all transport modes: bus, subway or metro, train, streetcar, ferry, rideshare and more. Prefer to travel on two wheels? See live bikeshare and scooter locations right on the map.
OFFLINE SUPPORT: Bus schedules, stop locations, subway maps and even our trip planner are available offline. When GPS is spotty underground? Use GO and you’ll still get precise ETAs.
TRIP PLANNING PAR EXCELLENCE: See fast and easy routes on buses, subways and trains, and even multiple modes in one trip (bus + bike or scooter + metro). Personalize your journey planner in the settings: skip long walks or the modes you’d rather avoid. It’s like using the MTA Bus Time, MTA Train Time, NJ Transit MyBus, SF Next Muni, CTA Bus Tracker, WMATA Next Arrivals, SEPTA app – all in one!
GO NAVIGATION*: Use GO to receive departure alarms to catch your bus or train, and get alerted when it’s time to get off or transfer. You’ll also contribute more accurate info and real-time ETAs for other passengers – and rack up points for being the most helpful rider on your line.
CROWDSOURCED WISDOM: See what millions of riders say about crowding levels, on-time performance, the best station exits, and more.
EASY PAYMENTS: Pay your transit fare and buy bikeshare passes directly in the app in 100+ cities.
*Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.
NOW SUPPORTING 1000+ CITIES INCLUDING:
Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Barcelona, Boston, Buffalo, Charlotte, Chicago, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Columbus, Dallas, Denver, Detroit, Dublin, Hartford, Honolulu, Houston, Kansas City, Las Vegas, London, Los Angeles, Louisville, Madison, Miami, Milwaukee, Minneapolis, Nashville, New Orleans, New York City, Orlando, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Providence, Portland, Sacramento, Salt Lake City, San Antonio, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Tampa, Washington D.C.
1000+ PUBLIC TRANSIT AGENCIES INCLUDING:
AC Transit, Atlanta Streetcar (MARTA), Bee-Line, Big Blue Bus, Caltrain, CapMetro, CATS, CDTA, CTA, CT Transit, DART, DC Metro (WMATA), DDOT, GCRTA, HART, KCATA, King County Metro, LA DOT, LA Metro, LBT, LIRR, Lynx, MCTS, MDOT MTA, Metra, Metrolink, MetroNorth, Miami Dade Transit, NCTD, New Jersey Transit, NFTA, NICE, NYC MTA, OCTA, PACE, PATH, PRT, RTA, RTC Transit, RTD, SEPTA, SF BART, Sound Transit, SORTA/Metro, St. Louis Metro, TANK, TheBus, TriMet, UTA, Valley Metro, Via
SEE ALL SUPPORTED CITIES & COUNTRIES: transitapp.com/en/region

bluejetty:00188836:ios.description:
Download the BGG App and get ready to live your most organised, fulfilled and happy life. In this day and age, it’s hard to balance the perfect social life, work commitments and life admin whilst also living a healthy lifestyle. THE BGG APP is the one organisational tool you need to stay on track in all areas of your life. It’s your little best friend in your pocket keeping you accountable. It’s modern and cool design makes being organised feel FUN.
Download now to set your goals, resolutions and upcoming events in one easy-to-use app. 
Features include:
• Use the calendar to plan and view your daily, weekly and monthly schedule. 
• Plan and invite friends and colleagues to events and meetings.
• Use the to-do list and reminders to get sh*t done. 
• Reflect with the journal feature. 
• Share your events, plans and journal entries with your friends and followers on social media. 
• Stay motivated with daily affirmations and weekly horoscopes. 
• Track your period with the period tracking tool. 
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Using this app requires an active subscription, available on a monthly or yearly basis. 
Our subscription options are listed below. You will have access to all features of the app with the Pro Monthly or Pro Yearly subscription.
• Lite Monthly
• Lite Yearly
• Pro Monthly
• Pro Yearly
Pricing varies depending on your country.
Monthly users are automatically billed per month, renewing automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period in your iTunes Account Setting. Yearly users are billed the total annual fee from the purchase date and will renew automatically as well unless you turn off auto-renew in the iTunes setting.
Terms of use: https://abasicgirlsguide.com/pages/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00155975:ios.description:
Gymnastics Dream is a casual mobile gymnastics game where you tap to perform routines, customize your gymnast, compete for medals, and rise from beginner to gymnastics star.
Every champion starts with a dream.
Your story begins in the locker room, where your coach sees your potential and names you team leader. Now it’s time to train, enter the arena, and show the world what you can do.
Follow the glowing guide, tap at the right moment, and complete graceful gymnastics moves like flips, jumps, handstands, poses, bar routines, and floor exercise performances. Hit perfect timing to boost your score, win medals, climb the leaderboard, and reach the top.
Miss a move? Keep improving. Train again, master every routine, and come back stronger. Each level brings new challenges, new rewards, and new chances to shine.
Gymnastics Dream is not only about winning gold — it’s also about expressing your style. Unlock sparkling leotards, try new outfits, choose hairstyles and hair colors, and create a gymnast who looks ready for the spotlight.
As you progress, new levels, new arenas, new looks, and new worlds await. From your first tap to your first gold medal, every performance brings you closer to becoming a true gymnastics champion.
FEATURES:
* Easy tap-to-play gymnastics gameplay
* Fun routines with flips, jumps, handstands, poses, bars, and floor exercise
* Gymnast customization with outfits, leotards, hairstyles, and hair colors
* Training challenges, competitions, scores, medals, and leaderboards
* Perfect timing moments that make every move feel rewarding
* Level progression with new arenas, new worlds, and unlockable rewards
* A stylish sports game for fans of gymnastics, dress up, dance, competition, and casual tap games
Tap to win, dress to shine, and become the gymnastics star of your dreams.
Your gymnastics legend begins now.
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our privacy policy: https://crazylabs.com/app

Join millions of players in the world’s favorite free online Bingo game! 
Free daily Credits? Now THAT’s a Bingo!
Experience your Bingo Moment, when everything comes together at once and it all feels just right! Enjoy exciting gameplay, endless content and an active social community!
Join Blitzy the cat as he travels around the world, playing Bingo and making friends in every new place he visits.

• Timely celebrations: Whether it’s a seasonal festival, a holiday or an important global event, you can be sure that Bingo Blitz will get in the spirit with unique content!
We love our Bingo Blitz players, and we show you that love DAILY!
• Free daily Credits!
• Free daily wheel spins for even more rewards!
• Daily quests with extra prizes!
• New extra content every day!
Play Bingo and make new friends from around the world!
• A global, social community with millions of players, just like you!
• In-game chat rooms
• Exchange items with other players and help each other win!
• Invite friends for more rewards!
• An active social media community where you can share your Bingo fun and make new friends!
Get in touch: Tell us about your Bingo Blitz experience!

Bingo Blitz does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Bingo Blitz may also contain advertising. You may require an internet connection to play Bingo Blitz and access its social features. You can also find more information about the functionality, compatibility and interoperability of Bingo Blitz in the above description and additional app store information. 
By downloading this game, you agree to future game updates as released on your app store or social network. You may choose to update this game, but if you do not update, your game experience and functionalities may be reduced.

bluejetty:00073411:ios.name: Zocdoc - Find and book doctors
bluejetty:00073411:ios.summary:
Zocdoc is the leading healthcare app that makes it easy for you to find and book the right doctor. Each month, millions of people use Zocdoc to search for in-network care and instantly book appointments online. 
Whether you need a same-day
bluejetty:00073411:ios.description:
Zocdoc is the leading healthcare app that makes it easy for you to find and book the right doctor. Each month, millions of people use Zocdoc to search for in-network care and instantly book appointments online. 
Whether you need a same-day appointment or want to schedule a doctor appointment online, Zocdoc makes it fast and easy. Patients typically see a doctor within 24 to 72 hours of booking. 
Download the FREE Zocdoc app to find and book a doctor today.
WHY PATIENTS LOVE ZOCDOC
Zocdoc makes it easy to go from searching to scheduling in just a few taps.
- Search by your insurance and city to find in-network doctors near you
- Browse by specialty, availability, or procedure to get the care you need
- Filter by what matters to you: distance, gender, ratings, and more
- Read real, verified reviews from other patients
- See providers' real-time appointment availability
- Easily book in-person or telehealth visits that fit your schedule
- Get automatic reminders so you never miss an appointment
- Fill out your forms ahead of time, so your visit starts smoothly
POPULAR CARE OPTIONS
Zocdoc connects patients to more than 250,000 providers across more than 200 specialties. You can book an online doctor for a virtual visit, schedule urgent care, book in-person care near you, or find providers who accept Medicare plans.
Looking to schedule a dental cleaning, therapy appointment, or Rx refill? Zocdoc helps you book the appointment you need, from routine visits to specialized care.
Here are just a few of the most popular services patients book through the app:
- Dentist: Dental cleanings, checkups, and x-rays
- Therapist: Therapy sessions for mental health support
- Primary Care Doctor: Annual checkups and physicals
- OB-GYN: Pap smears and women’s health visits
- Dermatologist: Skin checks and acne consultations
- Psychiatrist: Medication management and evaluations
- Pediatrician: Wellness visits and sick appointments for kids
- Eye Doctor: Vision exams and prescription updates
- Orthopedic Specialist: Joint pain, injuries, and sports medicine
- Cardiologist: Heart health screenings and follow-ups
There are many more specialties and procedures you can book with Zocdoc. Your healthcare, on your terms.
INSURANCE PLANS ACCEPTED
Zocdoc makes it easy to find doctors who accept your insurance, with no phone calls or guesswork required. Here are some of the most commonly accepted insurance plans on Zocdoc.
- Cigna
- UnitedHealthcare
- Aetna
- Kaiser Permanente
- Blue Cross Blue Shield
- Anthem
- Humana
- Oscar Health
- Molina Healthcare
- Healthfirst
Doctors on Zocdoc accept nearly 20,000 different insurance plans, making it easy to find in-network care. No matter what plan you have, Zocdoc helps you see what's in-network and book care confidently.
HOW TO BOOK AND MANAGE CARE WITH ZOCDOC
Search and compare.
Search by specialty or symptom, along with location, availability, and insurance, to see providers who are in-network. Research and compare providers by reviewing their profiles, which include professional statements, education background, photos, and verified reviews and ratings from other patients.
Instantly book.
View providers’ real-time appointment availability, select a convenient time, and click to instantly book an appointment, 24/7.
Prepare for your appointment.
Save time by filling out intake forms and insurance information on Zocdoc ahead of the visit.
Stay on top of your healthcare.
Keep track of upcoming visits with appointment reminders and personalized recommendations for preventive care. View your care team and easily rebook.
From search to follow-up, Zocdoc makes it simple to manage your care from one place.

bluejetty:00124352:ios.description:
It’s time to experience the magic of Harry Potter games like never before! Prepare to cast spells, outsmart challenges, and celebrate the wonder of the wizarding world to solve incredible magical Match-3 puzzles from your mobile device! Prove your Match-3 skills by beating levels to unlock new spells to aid your quest to conquer difficult Match-3 puzzles in this Harry Potter game. Upgrade your spells as you prepare for the magically mischievous Match-3 challenges ahead in these free puzzle games.
As you progress in your Match-3 adventure, relive classic moments from the films featuring your favourite wizarding world characters from the Harry Potter films, including Harry, Ron, and Hermione toppling a troll, Fred & George playing pranks, and Hagrid taking care of his magical creatures at Hogwarts! Learn more about the wonders of the wizarding world as you collect magical creatures to aid your Match-3 puzzle solving, this is the best matching game for a Harry Potter fan! Get ready to ‘swish and flick’ your way into a magical journey of your own with this whimsical Match-3 game! This matching game for adults blends strategy, nostalgia, and community into one unforgettable journey.
o Daily Mini-Games: It's more than puzzles! Play different daily activities like fun mini-games: Find the Hidden Object and more matching games for adults.
o Unlock and Upgrade Spells: Use Spells, like Wingardium Leviosa and more, to obliterate obstacles and remove hazards to beat Match-3 puzzles.
o Celebrate the Magic of Harry Potter: Solve new Match-3 games while reliving memorable scenes and sounds from the Harry Potter stories in this strategy game filled with top rated puzzles. Along the way, the Daily Prophet will keep you up-to-date with Harry and his epic journey at Hogwarts.
o Win Rewards: Complete daily missions and limited time events to unlock exclusive event chests filled with power-ups, gold and more collectable rewards to help you with your puzzle mastery
o Play In Clubs: Unite with your clubs to climb the leaderboard and build your legacy. Taste sweet victory when you work with your clubmates to win collaborative challenges like Club Challenge and Battle of Hogwarts, where you must awaken your competitive side and defeat dark foes like Bellatrix, Nagini and more!
o Events Galore: Enjoy daily events! You’ll never get bored when playing fun free games like Duelling, Broom Race and more awesome Match-3 games! These free match 3 games each feature different challenges.
o Unlock Magical Creatures: Amass a glorious collection of marvelous wizarding world creatures to aid in solving challenging Match-3 puzzles and level up your tile-match mastery. Each Magical Creature has unique skills and benefits to assist you in solving challenging and fun free games.
o Customize Your Avatar: Join your favourite Hogwarts house, choose your wand and customize your avatar with unique hairstyles and accessories to stand out in your puzzle solving journey through magical Harry Potter moments!

bluejetty:00171591:ios.description:
Experience the Ultimate Ball Sort Puzzle!
Ball Sort Puzzle: Color Bubble is the perfect ball sorting game combining strategic thinking and fun color match gameplay. Enjoy addictive puzzles that train your brain and sharpen your color matching skills.
How to Play
- Tap any tube to pick up a ball, then tap another tube to pour the ball into it. You can only stack balls of the same color together.
- Fill each tube with balls of a single matching color to complete the level.
- If needed, you can use the "Undo" button to correct moves, restart levels anytime, or add extra tubes for tricky ball sort puzzles.
Features of Ball Sort Puzzle
- Offline mode lets you enjoy puzzles anytime, anywhere.
- No time limits to play at your own pace.
- Thousands of challenging levels with unique color matching puzzles.
- Beautiful colorful graphics and relaxing sound effects enhance ball sorting fun.
- Intuitive one-finger controls make ball sort easy and accessible.
- Strategic power-ups such as undo, restart, and extra tubes deepen your gameplay.
- Cognitive benefits include improved pattern recognition, logic, and spatial skills through ball sorting.
- Suitable for quick breaks or long ball sort sessions.

bluejetty:00085211:ios.description:
Further your parkrun experience with the parkrun app!
What is parkrun?
parkrun is a free, community event where you can walk, jog, run, volunteer or spectate. 
parkrun is 5k and takes place every Saturday morning. junior parkrun is 2k, dedicated to 4-14 year olds and their families, every Sunday morning.
parkrun is positive, welcoming and inclusive, there is no time limit and no one finishes last, as each event has a volunteer Tail Walker. Everyone is welcome to come along.
Why use the parkrun app?
Result History:
Check out your own or your family/friends' result history whether that be volunteering or finishing. Keep track of your Personal Bests, events you’ve attended, volunteer roles you’ve fulfilled and more.
Course Info:
Want to try a new event? Read the course description, check for cancellations and more by using the event map to view every parkrun event across the world.
Planner:
With so many parkruns to choose from, try our planning tool to help keep track of your up and coming events.
Milestones:
Track your progress towards your next finisher or volunteering milestones as you strive to join thousands of others in our various milestone clubs.
Barcode:
Use the barcode feature to help you on the day at events!
Volunteering:
All parkruns are delivered by volunteers so we've made volunteering easy. Simply pick an event, view the list of available roles and quickly send an email to the event organiser to put your name down or get more information.

bluejetty:00162688:ios.description:
«Штрафы ГИБДД официальные» – надежное приложение для проверки и оплаты штрафов ГИБДД во всех регионах. Нам доверяют более 13 млн. пользователей.
ПОИСК ШТРАФОВ И ЗАДОЛЖЕННОСТЕЙ ВО ВСЕХ ОФИЦИАЛЬНЫХ ИСТОЧНИКАХ
• Проверяем базы ГАИ (ГИБДД) МВД РФ, ГИС ГМП, МАДИ, АМПП, ЦОДД, ФССП
• Проверяем штрафы по гос номеру авто, водительскому удостоверению, СТС
• Ищем штрафы по номеру постановления
СВОЕВРЕМЕННЫЕ УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ О ШТРАФАХ
• Напоминаем о новых штрафах
• Напоминаем, когда истекает льготный период на оплату штрафа со скидкой 25%
• Напоминаем о просроченных штрафах
УДОБНАЯ ОПЛАТА ШТРАФОВ
• Оплата штрафа банковской картой любого банка
• Отправляем квитанцию об оплате на email
ГАРАНТИЯ ПОГАШЕНИЕ ШТРАФА
• Отправляем запись о произведенном платеже в ГИС ГМП (Федеральное казначейство)
• После оплаты отправляем на email квитанцию с печатью банка 
• Все квитанции оплаченных штрафов хранятся в приложении
ОПЛАТА ПРОЕЗДА ПО ПЛАТНЫМ ДОРОГАМ ВОВРЕМЯ
• Уведомляем о задолженности за проезд по МСД, Проспекту Багратиона (СДКП), ЗСД (Витебская развязка), трассам Автодор: ЦКАД А-113 и М-12 «Восток», А-289 «Краснодар-Темрюк»
• Предоставляем все данные о проезде: дата, название КПП, сумма начисления, срок оплаты
• Мгновенно сообщаем о новых задолженностях. Чтобы водитель успел оплатить проезд в положенные 5 дней без штрафа.
ОФОРМЛЕНИЕ ОСАГО ОНЛАЙН
• Быстрый расчет на основании минимума документов всего за 5 минут
• Автоматическое заполнение данных об автомобиле
• Сравнение цен сразу в 20 известных страховых
• Страховой полис всегда останется под рукой: в приложении и на email
• Уведомление о завершении действия страхового полиса ОСАГО за 30 дней до его окончания
ПРОВЕРКА АВТО за 1 минуту

►Explore Collections
Discover various coin collections from around the world, broadening your numismatic knowledge and providing inspiration for your own collection.

bluejetty:00041356:ios.description:
GiftList — Wishlists, Gift Registries & Secret Santa
Make and share free wishlists and gift registries with gifts from any store. Get ready for Christmas, birthdays, weddings, baby showers and more. Invite family to a group to keep everyone's shared wishlists together, or organize a Secret Santa gift exchange.
CHRISTMAS & HOLIDAY WISHLISTS
Create a Christmas wishlist, save gift ideas and share one link with friends and family. Gift-givers can reserve gifts on an accessible shared list without an account. Reservations help avoid duplicate gifts while keeping the surprise.
NEW: GIFT EXCHANGES & SECRET SANTA
Organize a gift exchange for up to 100 people. Set a budget and exchange date, draw names and let each person see their own recipient. Participants can link a wishlist or choose gift hints with Mystery Q&A, then use Santa Mail to ask their assigned recipient anonymous questions. A free account is required to view a match and take part.
NEW: GROUPS
Invite family and friends to a group and keep up with their shared wishlists in one place. Make it easier to find gift ideas for birthdays, holidays and the occasions you celebrate together. List privacy settings still apply.
ADD GIFTS & SHARE YOUR LIST
Browse stores inside the app or paste a product link. GiftList can fill in product details when available; you can edit the details or add an item yourself. Share your list by text, email or social media. Gift-givers can view accessible lists and reserve gifts without downloading the app. Reservations stay hidden from the list owner until they choose to reveal them.
CARDS & EVENT INVITES
Choose a card design or upload an image or GIF. Add a message and envelope, then send by email or private link. Recipients can open cards in a browser without an account. Create event invitations, collect RSVPs and attach a gift list. Guests can RSVP without an app or account.
MORE WAYS TO MAKE GIFTING PERSONAL
- Most Wanted, tags, custom covers and sorting to organize your lists
- Collaborative lists to plan with a partner or family member
- Registry imports from supported retailers
- Cash funds and group gifting using supported external payment methods; provider fees may apply
- Price comparisons across supported retailers
- Favorite stores for faster browsing
- Gift tracking with order and delivery details
- My Gifts to keep received and purchased gifts together
- Genie AI gift ideas, curated collections and gift guides
- Birthday and occasion reminders, plus a notification center
- Choose who sees each list on your profile (everyone, friends only or no one), and add a password to lock a list
- Shipping addresses or custom delivery instructions
- Dark mode and lists that sync across iPhone, iPad and the web
Make a wishlist for Christmas, birthdays, Hanukkah, Eid, Diwali, weddings, baby showers, housewarmings, graduations or any occasion.
Download GiftList and create your free gift list.

Discover IMPOSTER! Can you blend in, or will you be caught?

MORE FUN Than Classic Group Games: Forget simple party classics like charades, truth or dare, or heads up — IMPOSTER brings a thrilling mix of strategy, laughter, and suspense.

bluejetty:00150907:ios.description:
Log In Using Your Tria Health Patient Portal Account: myportal.triahealth.com
Tria Health’s mobile app will enhance your ability to interact with Tria Health and empower you when it comes to managing your health. In order to access the app, members will have to enroll with Tria Health and complete an initial consultation with their Tria Health pharmacist. The Tria Health app will then allow the member to access their personalized care plan developed with their Tria pharmacist at any time. 
Key Features
• Medication reminders - so you never forget to take a medication
• A complete medication list - for easy access when you are at doctor’s appointments
• Opportunities to save money on your medications
• Your personalized health care recommendations
Comprehensive Medication Reminders
Medication regimens can vary in complexity, and we know you need more than just a simple alarm to manage it all. Tria Health’s medication reminders allow you to track your medication in any form, at any time of day and ensure you’re aware of when you need a refill. The planner tool allows for greater freedom in customizing your medication schedule.
Customized Care Plan
You’ve taken the first step and worked with a Tria Health pharmacist to develop a personalized care plan. Now there’s an easy way to access everything you discussed with your pharmacist from medication recommendations, preventative services and more! You’ll never have to worry about forgetting what you wanted to discuss with your doctor, you’ll have it ready to go in the palm of your hand. 
Disclaimer: This app offers general information and is not a replacement for professional medical advice. Please consult a licensed healthcare professional before making any medical decisions based on the app's content. 
All medical devices that connect to this app are cleared for use by the FDA in the United States.

bluejetty:00135136:ios.description:
Simple, powerful, and customizable.
This all-in-one clock app combines Alarm, Timer, and Stopwatch functions into a clean, intuitive interface.
Privacy-friendly: When headphones are connected, the alarm sounds only through the headphones, not the device speakers.
By making advanced features optional, we maintain a minimalist design while meeting a wide range of user needs.
[General]
Customization: Color themes, "My Theme" creation, and adjustable font sizes.
Typography: Choose from system fonts, specialized clock fonts, or even add your own custom fonts.
Time Display: Toggle between 12/24-hour formats, customize 12:00 vs. 0:00 display, and enable/disable leading zeros (e.g., 09:00 vs. 9:00).
[Clock]
Dual analog and digital display with extensive layout options.
Design: Multiple dial designs and support for custom image/video backgrounds.
Visibility: Toggle seconds, choose second hand movement (Ticking vs. Smooth), and customize date formats/languages.
Dynamic Layout: Hide the status bar, tab bar, or settings button for a cleaner look. Digital-only mode available in landscape orientation.
Hourly Chime: Use simple presets or create a fully customized hourly schedule.
World Clock: View multiple cities and time zones simultaneously in a convenient list.
[Alarm]
Set unlimited alarms with full background notification support. Compatible with AlarmKit (iOS 26.1+), allowing alarms to sound even in Silent or Focus modes.
Scheduling: Powerful repeat options including daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and custom intervals (e.g., every 2 days). Supports pause periods.
Sound: Use custom recordings or local music files (when the app is in the foreground).
Management: Organize alarms with folders, label search, and easy duplication. Sort by time or firing order.
Advanced Features: Checklist, Snooze, Auto-stop (by duration/repetition), Skip next, and one-tap global pause. New alarms can automatically inherit previous settings for faster setup.
[Timer]
Run multiple timers simultaneously ranging from 1 second to 10000 hours.
Quick Start: Access presets and history for instant activation.
Interface: Switch between list and full-screen views. Choose between 10-key or picker input with customizable units (1s/10s/1m/10m).
Foreground Features: Displays estimated completion time and supports auto-stop for sounds.
[Stopwatch]
Records: Capture lap times with precision.
Export: Send your recorded data as a text file via email.
[Other Settings]
System Integration: Audio mix mode (play alongside other music apps), and Auto-lock.
Display: Brightness adjustment with "Darkness Correction" and customizable UI elements (toggle between switches or checkboxes).
Note on Music:
Currently, this app does not support playback for Apple Music, iCloud-only songs, or purchased songs that have not been downloaded to the device storage.
URL Scheme:
net.hakoniwa.clock://

bluejetty:00073635:ios.description:
Bark Kids is the free child companion app for both Bark and Bark Jr. To use it, you’ll need to have an established Bark account and install Bark Kids on your child’s device. Here are the features this app enables:
SCREEN TIME MANAGEMENT
Families can set healthy time limits and create schedules for when their children’s devices can connect to the internet (through both cell service and Wi-Fi).
WEB FILTERING
Our web filter lets you select which websites your child can access on their devices. You can allow or block specific sites — or even whole categories like streaming services, online gaming, sexual content, and more.
GPS-POWERED LOCATION TRACKING
Bark’s robust location tracking enables you to track your child in real time on a map. You can even find out if they’re stationary, walking, biking, or moving in a car. 
CHECK-INS
Check-Ins are an easy way for families to get peace of mind when their kids are out and about. Rather than sending a "Did you get there?" or "Where are you?" text, you can rely on a GPS-based location confirmation from your children to verify that they've safely arrived at their destinations. It can even give you step-by-step directions via Google Maps so you can meet them where they are if necessary.
PERSONAL ACCOUNT CONNECTIONS
The Bark Kids app allows kids to connect their own accounts to Bark’s monitoring service (not available with Bark Jr). By allowing them to connect directly to our monitoring service, they get more privacy without having to share their usernames or passwords.
HOW BARK KIDS WORKS WITH THE BARK PARENT APP
Download the Bark Parent companion app to manage your child’s entire digital world
- Monitor texts, apps & social media
- Create custom screen time schedules
- Block websites & apps
- Get insights into online activities
- Track location
WHAT PARENTS ARE SAYING
- "My wife and I LOVE Bark. We've had some tough but productive conversations with our 13-year-old son. It's proving to be extremely valuable." — Josh L.
- “It’s just another set of protections we as parents give our kids for the digital environment (or as my 10-year-old calls it, a “cell phone seat belt”). My oldest is a 9th grader, and while I trust her, I’ve come to realize through the alerts that some of her friends aren’t truly her friends. It’s led to some amazing conversations about choosing friends wisely and recognizing toxic people. While she wasn’t for Bark at first, she’s since said she’s grateful that I saw those messages because it reaffirmed what she was feeling but didn’t know how to verbalize without sounding sensitive.” — Bark Parent
- "Bark notified me that my young daughter had unknowingly revealed her phone number to strangers on Twitter. The fact that Bark notified me was impressive and led to an informative discussion with her the same day." — Jon B.
- “Since Bark alerted us to the suicidal language used in the Google doc that was being used in a chat document with a friend, we have seen both a pediatrician and a licensed counselor. We are hopeful for a positive outcome. Thanks to Bark for letting us peek into our child’s mind!” — Bark Parent
- “This app is a lifesaver! It has allowed us to catch so many “red flags” in the content my kids have accessed on their devices and in their interactions with friends and other people online that I wouldn’t have ever known about otherwise. The big difference between Bark and other “Parental Control” software is that Bark allows your kids to have so much more privacy. It doesn’t show you everything they do, but sends an instant alert regarding any activity that might be concerning. Highly recommended!” — Bark Parent
With Bark, you can help keep your kids safe both online and in real life. Try it out for seven days absolutely free!
Our Family Online Safety Specialists are standing by to help answer any questions you might have. Email help@bark.us or visit help.bark.us to get answers and advice from the Bark Team.

bluejetty:00182993:ios.description:
Welcome to the Musical World of Cytus
LET’S EXPERIENCE MUSIC ’N ART, BEAT ’N REBOUND!
Check the screenshots and you will see the most AWESOME mobile music game ever!
Just PLAY and ENJOY! 
------------------------------------------------------
FEATURES
- 200 songs and 400 variations, including many from famous composers around the world 
- Beautiful hand-drawn art style (as illustrated in the screenshots)
- Easy, intuitive Active Scan Line system and 3 types of notes 
- Different display modes allow player-friendly previewing of notes
- Strong beat and rhythms provide satisfying feedback for taps
- More than 9 difficulty levels for more fun and challenges
- Various music genres: POP, JAZZ, TRANCE, HARDCORE, DRUM 'N BASS and many more 
- Connect to Facebook and show off your Cytus skills
------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO PLAY
- Follow along the Active Scan Line
- Tap each note as the line passes through
- Time your taps as the line is at the center of the note for a higher score!
------------------------------------------------------
STORY
In the distant future, the only sentient beings in the world are robots. 
They are the last remnant of the human spirit. 
However, mankind is not dead. 
Technology exists that is capable of transferring memories to these robots. 
But with limited space, new memories will gradually overwrite the old. 
To prevent the emotions in human memories from fading away, the robots resorted to converting the emotions to music, and storing them in a place called Cytus. 
The robots use these songs to experience human emotion and dream that souls exists in each of them...

bluejetty:00027649:ios.name: 3D Offline Maps: GPS tracker
bluejetty:00027649:ios.summary: Detailed 2D and 3D maps for navigation, travel, hiking, and outdoor adventures all over the world. Download maps in advance, use them offline without internet access, record GPS tracks, save routes and waypoints, import and export GPX files
bluejetty:00027649:ios.description:
Detailed 2D and 3D maps for navigation, travel, hiking, and outdoor adventures all over the world. Download maps in advance, use them offline without internet access, record GPS tracks, save routes and waypoints, import and export GPX files, and keep everything important close at hand on every trip.
Plan routes, build your own collection of tracks, mark interesting places on the map, share data with friends, and travel more comfortably even where there is no signal. The app supports offline maps with no time limits on storage and contains no ads.
Main features:
- 9 map types: satellite, vector, and 3D maps.
- compatible with Apple Silicon Macs.
- background track recording.
- compare tracks by speed, elevation, and time at any distance, including gains and delays relative to a selected reference track.
- fast and convenient map downloads.
- route planner.
- step counter with data for the last three months (steps, distance).
- elevation for any waypoint.
- address search.
- coordinate search.
- compass.
- barometer.
- track processing and optimization.
- offline map downloads with unlimited storage time.
- supports all available ways on your device to import and export tracks and waypoints in GPX, KML, KMZ format.
- color gradient by speed and elevation for imported tracks when this data is available.
- color gradient by speed and elevation for recorded tracks.
- records speed and elevation in tracks.
- contour lines in outdoor mode.
- extended track information: average and maximum speed, duration, distance, and number of waypoints.
- different units of measurement: miles, kilometers, feet, meters.
- view one or multiple tracks in any app mode, including while recording another track.
- create, edit, and delete waypoints in any mode and anywhere on the map.
- selectable icons for waypoints.
- track recording quality settings, distance filters, and power saving mode.
- points to the selected waypoint and shows the distance to it.
- shows the current distance covered and time on route.
- quick start and stop of track recording.
- several map orientation modes: by device compass, by direction of movement, centered mode, and north-up mode.
- map tilt with a two-finger gesture.
- quick selection and convenient viewing of saved tracks, waypoints, and downloaded maps.
- speed and elevation charts with zooming and scrolling.
- link to the user guide in settings.
- waypoint photos: take photos, store them, open the waypoint on the map from the photo, and share your shots.
- photo geotagging: coordinates and shooting data are saved in the text caption and in EXIF/GPS metadata.
- Terms of Service: https://appsupport.store/terms/
- Privacy Policy: https://appsupport.store/privacy

Plan routes, build your own collection of tracks, mark interesting places on the map, share data with friends, and travel more comfortably even where there is no signal. The app supports offline maps with no time limits on storage and contains no ads.

Main features:
- 9 map types: satellite, vector, and 3D maps.
- compatible with Apple Silicon Macs.
- background track recording.
- compare tracks by speed, elevation, and time at any distance, including gains and delays relative to a selected reference track.
- fast and convenient map downloads.
- route planner.
- step counter with data for the last three months (steps, distance).
- elevation for any waypoint.
- address search.
- coordinate search.
- compass.
- barometer.
- track processing and optimization.
- offline map downloads with unlimited storage time.
- supports all available ways on your device to import and export tracks and waypoints in GPX, KML, KMZ format.
- color gradient by speed and elevation for imported tracks when this data is available.
- color gradient by speed and elevation for recorded tracks.
- records speed and elevation in tracks.
- contour lines in outdoor mode.
- extended track information: average and maximum speed, duration, distance, and number of waypoints.
- different units of measurement: miles, kilometers, feet, meters.
- view one or multiple tracks in any app mode, including while recording another track.
- create, edit, and delete waypoints in any mode and anywhere on the map.
- selectable icons for waypoints.
- track recording quality settings, distance filters, and power saving mode.
- points to the selected waypoint and shows the distance to it.
- shows the current distance covered and time on route.
- quick start and stop of track recording.
- several map orientation modes: by device compass, by direction of movement, centered mode, and north-up mode.
- map tilt with a two-finger gesture.
- quick selection and convenient viewing of saved tracks, waypoints, and downloaded maps.
- speed and elevation charts with zooming and scrolling.
- link to the user guide in settings.
- waypoint photos: take photos, store them, open the waypoint on the map from the photo, and share your shots.
- photo geotagging: coordinates and shooting data are saved in the text caption and in EXIF/GPS metadata.

bluejetty:00185371:ios.description:
Hunting Simulator 3D is an unforgettable adventure for real men where you have to come face to face with the lords of the wilderness and hunt them down. If you are a hunter, start up your 4x4 off-road vehicle, hook up your trailer, grab your rifle and ammo and set off on a hunt right now for different kinds of animals. You're in for an unforgettable adventure!
*****Special features of the game:*****
- Hunt for animals. The best hunting simulator.
- Wide selection of weapons.
- The coolest 4x4 off-road vehicles for hunting.
- Trailers for your vehicles.
- Animal traps.
- Beautiful graphics and realistic 3D environment.
- Realistic animated animals to hunt.
- Sounds of nature that create the effect of being there.
- Diverse animal life and hunting maps.
- Pursuit of quests and missions.
- Accomplishments and table of the game's best hunters.
- Daily bonuses.
Advice for a successful hunt:
1. Go through training. That way you will acquire your first hunting skills and will earn your first money.
2. Beware of predators. They can attack hunters.
3. Use the sight for accurate shooting.
4. Purchase a powerful gun so you'll have a better chance of killing the beast with the first shot.
5. Don't approach your quarry too closely or you will scare it away.
6. Aim at the animal's head, it's the most vulnerable place.
7. Once you have shot your quarry, don't forget to load it onto the carrier.
8. The bigger the quarry, the more money you earn.
9. Use the money you earn to buy new vehicles that have larger carriers for hauling the animals you shoot.
10. Buy trailers for off-road vehicles. With a trailer on the hunt, you can take more animals and get to more distant sections of the map where the forest animal life is more varied.
11. The more animals downed, the higher your achievements and your rating.
Respect the hunting regulations and you will become the biggest, baddest hunter!
And remember, the deeper into the woods you go, the more wild game there is!
4x4 Hunting Simulator is your best choice!
Have a successful hunt and shoot straight!
Thank you for playing with us. Watch for updates. Leave reviews and provide feedback in comments!
While you're thinking, your friend is already hunting!

bluejetty:00155926:ios.description:
Introducing the Easy at-Home Waxing Guide and Scheduler App
Say hi to your newest waxing bff, WaxPal.
Tress Wellness, the best-selling waxing brand on Amazon, brings an all-in-one home-waxing solution, WaxPal.
What makes WaxPal your best bud?
WaxPal Educates
Whether you are a waxing newbie taking baby steps at home-waxing or you are an aspiring waxing pro eager to learn the best-kept waxing secrets, WaxPal has got you covered! The app has tutorial videos by licensed estheticians, so you know that you are learning from only the best. Beginner-friendly home waxing tutorials, expert techniques to get the closest wax, genius hacks to make waxing less painful, and best tips for skin prep and aftercare, WaxPal tutorials bring you all of this and more!
Got a waxing query? Don’t sweat it, we’ve got all the answers.
WaxPal Schedules
Who knew routines could be this fun? WaxPal helps you schedule all your self-waxing sessions so that you are always ready to hit the beach or up for last-minute brunch plans. The scheduler comes with an easy-to-use calendar where you can feed in your waxing routine, make notes, and schedule reminders. It’s like having your personal waxing diary!
WaxPal Personalizes
Your Pal gives you a totally personalized waxing experience. No more salon visits at odd hours. Schedule your waxing session on the go and wax from the comfort of your couch. Wax wherever you want, whenever you want, you always have a friend to count on.
A truly convenient and customizable waxing experience is now at your fingertips with WaxPal!

Water Sortpuz is the new free to play, addictive color sort puzzle game! Sort the colored liquids into the right bottles to solve this water sort puzzle with thousands of challenging levels! 
Improve your memory and train your brain while having fun.
HOW TO PLAY
Water Sortpuz is an extremely easy-to-play THEMED color sorting game for all ages!
1. Your mission? Sort all liquids in their own bottles
2. Tap the bottles and begin mixing colors. The goal is for all the bottles to contain ONE color 
3. Level up & earn coins to power-up and complete the most challenging levels 
UNIQUE FEATURES
- Unlock 40+ fun BOTTLE SETS and more!
- Relax with over 30 beautiful puzzle BACKGROUNDS: Ocean, Northern Lights, Beach, Cherry Blossoms, and more!
- Move up the map by collecting coins and leveling up
- Progress even faster with special link game power-ups: Rollback, Restart, Color Inversion and adding tubes to pour new color liquids into
- Free to play and download
- Relaxing sound design
- Easy to Play Hard to Master
- Log in every day to collect your Daily Bonus!
BRAIN TRAINING BENEFITS
Inspired by the classic, sorting puzzles: Water Sort is bound to get your cogs turning, as well as offering a number of other mental health benefits.
- Acting as a “mind sport” - Water Color Sort is designed to train your brain while captivating you through challenging, themed levels
- Wind down after a long day by relieving stress & relaxing with an intuitive puzzle game
- Stimulate your brain in a low-stress environment with puzzles and incredibly cute graphics
Download now to play this free puzzle app on AppStore and enjoy one of the most relaxing and addictive games. 
Show the world your mastery of space and color with Water Sortpuz today!

bluejetty:00037729:android.name: BetterPlace Money
bluejetty:00037729:android.summary: BetterPlace Money (Betterplace Safety Solutions Private Limited) is a financial services platform which aims to help improve the financial health of frontline workers in India. BetterPlace Money acts as a bridge between the frontline worker
bluejetty:00037729:android.description:
BetterPlace Money (Betterplace Safety Solutions Private Limited) is a financial services platform which aims to help improve the financial health of frontline workers in India. BetterPlace Money acts as a bridge between the frontline workers and the big Banks/NBFCs by providing a simple and clear process for access to loans for the next billion population of India. The NBFC which is currently available on our platform is NDX P2P Private Limited (Liquiloans).
A user can avail instant cash personal loans of up to Rs 25,000 at a 1%-3% interest rate with no other hidden charges. We charge a small processing fee of Rs 200/- to Rs 600/-, exclusive of GST. 
A representative example of the total cost of the Personal Loan, including all applicable fees:
Highlights:
* Finance Amount: Upto Rs 25,000
* Repayment Tenure: Minimum 3 months to maximum 6 months
* Rate of Interest / Annual Percentage Rate (APR): Minimum 20% to Maximum 50%
* Processing Fees: Rs 200-Rs 600/- (exclusive of GST)
Sample Loan Example:
Amount: Rs 10,000/- 
Interest Rate: 1.5% monthly simple interest
Tenure: 3 months
EMI Frequency: Monthly
Processing fee: Rs 300/- 
Disbursed Amount: Rs 9,700/-
Total Interest payable: Rs 450/- (interest is 1.5% per month = Rs 150 * 3)
Monthly Payment: Rs 3483.33/- 
Total payment in 3 months: Rs 10,450/-
Overall Cost: Rs 750/- (includes Rs 450/- as interest and Rs 300/- as processing fee)
APR: (750/10000)*(365/90) = 30.4%
*Interest rate and processing fees vary as per your product
https://betterplace.co.in/
Please reach out to loansupport@betterplace.co.in for any questions.

bluejetty:00064591:ios.description:
Bank of Richmondville is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Bank of Richmondville:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
-Turn off your debit card if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Bank of Richmondville app, you must be enrolled as a Bank of Richmondville Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00127526:ios.description:
Oblíbený bezplatný nástroj pro vyhledávání spojení v novém! Nový design a uživatelské prostředí, vyšší stabilita a rychlost, aktuální data všech dostupných jízdních řádů pro vlaky, autobusy a MHD. 
Dotazy a problémy prosím pište na idos@chaps.cz. Děkujeme.
Hlavní funkce:
 • Vyhledání vlakových, autobusových a MHD spojů včetně zadání zastávky z mapy
 • Online vyhledávání = vždy aktuální a oficiální informace včetně zpoždění a výluk
 • Offline možnost si prohlížet historii vyhledaných spojení
 • Inteligentní našeptávač zastávek a adres s návrhem oblíbených spojů
 • Automatická detekce MHD jízdního řádu a nejbližší zastávky dle GPS
 • Výběr dopravních prostředků v Rozšířeném nastavení a nastavení zobrazených možností v Nastavení
 • SMS jízdenky
 • Široké možnosti sdílení spojení
 • Zobrazení odjezdů/příjezdů z vybrané zastávky s možností filtrovat na konkrétní spoj
 • Uložení 6 spojení do oblíbených, 6 posledních hledání v historii s offline přístupem k výsledkům hledání
 • Vyhledávání bezbariérových spojení, spojení pro cyklisty nebo pro cestující s dětmi
 • Podrobné informace o spoji včetně nástupiště, koleje, čísle zastávky, zpoždění, aktuální pozice spoje na mapě, výlukách, orientační ceně jízdného a řazení vlakových vozů s popisem
 • Zobrazení trasy a polohy spoje na mapě
 • Kontextové propojení do prodejních systémů třetích stran pro rezervaci/zakoupení jízdného
 • Zobrazení legendy k použitým piktogramům
 • Nápověda - průvodce aplikací
 • Možnost odstranění reklam na vždy za poplatek (naleznete v nastavení pod ikonou Více)
Možnosti vyhledávání
 • Postupné zadávání názvu a zužování výběru z našeptávače
 • Zadání začátku názvu
 • Zadání začátků slov - např. "P H" = Praha Hradčanská
 • Zadání textu obsaženého v názvu - např. "UAN" = Ostrava UAN, Brno UAN, Praha UAN
 • Možnost zadat jako cíl adresu nebo název objektu - např. "Praha, Divadlo v Dlouhé" nebo "Praha, Ve Smečkách" = najde nejbližší zastávku k tomuto bodu a spojení z výchozí polohy hledání
 • Možnost zadat "!" Před název zastávky nebo cíle a omezí se našeptávač na první nalezenou položku např. "!Ben" = Benešov

The unique variation of the traditional puzzle-block game called Sea Block 1010 will help you immerse in the relaxing sea floor with the beautiful scene. This amazing variant, which combines colorful fossil blocks with a ocean-themed design, will undoubtedly offer a novel gameplay experience.

Similar to playing a different block puzzle game, placing the block with the full line vertically or horizontally will make the block disappear and give you experience score. - Use sea block puzzle blocks to build the line.

- Various difficulties from Beginner to Master as your score advances.
- Not your usual block puzzle, but the one that captures your attention.
- Earn diamonds so you can purchase the booster.
- A straightforward game that combines relaxing and difficult elements.

bluejetty:00086080:ios.name: Pitch Checker: Chromatic Tuner
bluejetty:00086080:ios.summary:
The app analyzes real-time audio from your microphone and displays musical note, pitch, octave, frequency, and waveform information.
■ Measure and Track Your Vocal Range
Tap “Measure vocal range” in the Range tab to measure your highest an
bluejetty:00086080:ios.description:
The app analyzes real-time audio from your microphone and displays musical note, pitch, octave, frequency, and waveform information.
■ Measure and Track Your Vocal Range
Tap “Measure vocal range” in the Range tab to measure your highest and lowest notes. Hold the same note for one second to register it, then save once both notes have been measured.
View your saved measurements in the history graph and look back at how your vocal range changes over time.
It also includes a Metronome feature (Beta), allowing you to set the tempo and practice with sound and vibration cues.
■ Usage Examples
- Measure vocal range
- Practice absolute pitch
- Detect the musical notes of a song (pitch detection)
- Vocal exercises
- Karaoke practice
- Improve pitch accuracy
- Measure frequency
- Voice training
- Basic instrument tuning (use it as a tuner)
- Do, Re, Mi note detection
- Rhythm practice using the metronome
You can pause the analysis with a tap, allowing you to review the results at your own pace. The display also supports notations such as low A, mid2 A, hihi A, etc.
■ How to Use
Simply launch the app, and it will automatically measure the pitch of sounds captured by the microphone — whether voice or instruments. To avoid picking up small sounds and background noise, slide the “Microphone Sensitivity” bar in the upper-left corner upward.
The metronome can be used by simply setting your desired tempo.
■ Settings
Tap the gear icon in the top-right corner to access the following settings:
- Toggle between sharp and flat notation
- Change the large center display notation (Do, Re, Mi / C, D, E, F, G, A, B)
- Set the reference pitch
- Adjust pitch detection speed
- Set the metronome tempo
■ FAQ
Q. I want to measure my vocal range.
A. Tap “Measure vocal range” in the Range tab to measure and save your highest and lowest notes. Review your saved results in the history graph. Extended notations such as hihi A and lowlow A are also supported.
Q. Pitch is displayed even when it’s quiet.
A. Even in very quiet environments, tiny background noise may be detected.
To prevent this, slide the “Microphone Sensitivity” bar upward to ignore softer sounds.
Q. I want to use it as a tuner.
A. No special settings are required. However, switching the large center display from "Do, Re, Mi" to "C, D, E, F, G, A, B" may be more convenient.
Tap the gear icon and change the “Large Display Notation” setting.
■ Other Information
Permissions:
- Microphone: Used to analyze audio input
- Siri & Search, Cellular Data: Used for AdMob advertisements
Terms of use can be found here:
https://pitchchecker.app/terms/
For bug reports or inquiries about the app, use the contact form on our official website:
https://pitchchecker.app/en/
Feel free to use this app on media platforms such as TV.

bluejetty:00038637:ios.name: Famileo: Your family newspaper
bluejetty:00038637:ios.summary: With Famileo, you can turn your everyday photos and messages into a personalised family newspaper, in just a few clicks. Famileo is the first app designed to bring generations together by making it easy to privately share family news. It’s
bluejetty:00038637:ios.description:
With Famileo, you can turn your everyday photos and messages into a personalised family newspaper, in just a few clicks. Famileo is the first app designed to bring generations together by making it easy to privately share family news. It’s the perfect gift for grandparents! Famileo is available for home delivery (from $9.99/month, cancel anytime) or in care settings (fee covered by the care setting and includes additional features). Over 260,000 families have already subscribed and just as many happy recipients!
► How does it work?
Each family member shares their photos and messages via the app. Famileo then transforms this family news into a personalised printed gazette. Thanks to the family wall in the app, everyone in the family can see and enjoy each other's shared memories and moments. And for your loved one, it’s a joy to regularly receive news from the whole family, delivered to their doorstep. The Famileo subscription is completely commitment-free, flexible, and guaranteed to be advert-free.
► Features:
• Share your everyday moments: Upload photos straight from your phone or computer, write a personal message, and publish it instantly. You can customise the layout – use single photos, collages, or even full-page images. Your memories are automatically transformed into a printed family gazette for your loved one.
• Reminders: You can fill out your gazette at your own pace, and we will send reminders so that you never miss the publication date.
• Family wall: See everything your relatives have posted and catch up on everyone’s news.
• Community wall: If your loved one lives in a participating care home, follow their updates and stay informed about events, activities and announcements.
• Gazettes archive: View PDFs of all past gazettes – perfect for printing or saving.
• Photo gallery: Thanks to Famileo, your family's photo album is always right at your fingertips. You can quickly access, save or print any of the family's uploaded photos.
• Invitations: Easily invite relatives to join your loved one’s private family network by message or email.
► Why you’ll love Famileo:
• Our easy-to-use app, designed especially for families and for building intergenerational bonds.
• A clear, easy-to-read printed gazette with large, high-quality photos.
• Automatic layout, no matter the order of your posts.
• A family kitty – ideal for sharing the subscription fee (and joint gifts!)-Printed in France and affordably priced.
• International service available in multiple languages (French, English, Dutch, Spanish, German) with worldwide delivery included at no extra cost.
►About us
Founded in Saint-Malo, France, in 2015, Famileo is now a team of nearly 60 passionate people working to strengthen the ties between generations.
With over 260,000 subscribing families and 1.8 million users, Famileo is the go-to private family app and the perfect way to stay connected across generations.
Got a question? Our friendly customer support team is here to help:
hello@famileo.com
+1 786 758 3096
See you soon!
The Famileo Team

• Noticias e informações

bluejetty:00158118:ios.summary:

The underlying mechani
bluejetty:00158118:ios.description:
With just one click, this tool scans the current network for any suspicious devices, ideal for uncovering hidden spy cameras and safeguarding privacy in critical areas such as conference rooms, hotels, and bathrooms.
The underlying mechanism involves scanning devices on the Local Area Network (LAN), capturing their Mac addresses, and utilizing the uniqueness of these addresses. This information is then compared with cloud data to identify the device's name, type, and manufacturer.
This Spy / Hidden Camera Detector app serves as an expert tool in detecting concealed cameras in private spaces.
It simplifies the process of finding hidden cameras in various accommodations like hotels, inns, and guesthouses, making it an essential tool for travelers staying in such places.
Key Features Include:
- Detection of Cameras in Network Settings
- Infrared Camera Red Dot Identification
- Common Creepshot Device Detection
- Magnetic Detection Feature
- Guide for Anti-creepshot Measures
Subscription:
- Upon purchase confirmation, a charge will be applied to your iTunes account.
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless you disable automatic renewal no less than 24 hours before the current period expires.
- Within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, the account will incur a renewal fee and the subscription will be extended.
- Users have the ability to manage their subscriptions. Automatic renewal can be deactivated by accessing the user's iTunes account settings after the purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://hiddencameradetector.pro/privacy.html
Terms & Conditions: https://hiddencameradetector.pro/terms.html

bluejetty:00179665:ios.name: imgLive - Live Photo Maker
bluejetty:00179665:ios.summary:
imgLive is a great live photo maker app. With imgLive, you can make your own live photo easily without camera capturing. You can set live photo as wallpaper or send it to your friends by sms or other apps.
Photos/Video/Gif to Live Photo
•
bluejetty:00179665:ios.description:
imgLive is a great live photo maker app. With imgLive, you can make your own live photo easily without camera capturing. You can set live photo as wallpaper or send it to your friends by sms or other apps.
Photos/Video/Gif to Live Photo
• Choose up to 30 photos or 30 seconds video to edit
• Apply filters to photos or video, built-in more than 50 fancy filters
• Change content ratio or aspect fit/fill content
• Setup content background with colors
• Add music into live photo
• Adjust volume of content
• Edit live photo cover
• Save to Camera Roll
Double Screen Mode Live Maker
• You can use double screen mode to splice a video into two live photos, and set it as your lockscreen with your bf or gf
• Apply filters to vide
• Add background musics into video
• Adjust volume of video
• Export two live photos
Info Live Maker
• Add some share data to your lockscreen wallpaper, and use 3D Touch to display it.
• Support QRCode, text, photos, voice
• AutoFit wallpaper size
• Preview and export
Live Photo Cover Editor
• Edit live photo cover
• Select new cover from ablum library or video content frames
Live Photo to Video
• Convert your live photo to video content
• Apply filter to video
• Add musics into video
• Adjust volume of video
• Support batch processing
Live Photo to Gif
• Convert your live photo to gif
• Cut the live photo content as you want
• Setup the gif loop mode with normal, reverse and pingpong
• Config the export arguments for fps, quality
Live Photo to Photos
• Export any live photo content
* imgLive need iOS9.1 up system, download and make your own live lockscreen wallpaper.
About Subscription
The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account when you confirm your purchase, and the subscription will be automatically renewed unless you cancel your subscription at least 24 hours in advance of your current subscription. Your account will be deducted from your package within 24 hours of the end of the current subscription period. After purchase, you can manage or turn off automatic renewal at any time in the Apple ID account settings.
Privacy URL : https://note.youdao.com/s/E5AXtqMd
Terms of Service : https://note.youdao.com/s/b68DbWk0

Telekom MK ви ги нуди сите информации за вашата искористеност на интернет, минути, роаминг и SMS на вашите мобилни броеви, воедно е најдобрата алатка за едноставно и лесно следење на сите ваши фиксни и мобилни услуги на едно место. Дополнително, Telekom MK ви нуди најбрз и најбезбеден начин да ги платите вашите сметки и да надополните припејд ваучер. Управувајте со вашите и услугите на вашите најблиски насекаде во секое време.
Што нуди Telekom MK?
1. Едноставно следете ја потрошувачката – сѐ на почетниот екран
• Проверете во секое време колку минути имате потрошено и колку преостануваат
• Имајте преглед на потрошувачката на мобилен интернет брзо и едноставно
• Следете повеќе додадени услуги: управувајте со услугите на вашите најблиски преку додавање на нивните проеви на вашиот профил
• Dark mode тема на апликацијата: персонализирајте го изгледот на апликацијата според вашите преференци и лични потреби
2. Управувајте со повеќе услуги на едно место
• Управувајте со сите услуги со едноставен преглед: разговори, SMS, роаминг, интернет пакети и фиксни услуги
• Управувајте со додадени броеви од вашите најблиски
• Додадете нови броеви на вашиот профил едноставно и брзо
3. Имајте преглед на деталите за услугите и активации на дополнителни пакети
• Добивајте известување за месечните сметки и нивниот статус
• Купете дополнителни пакети за разговори, SMS, роаминг и интернет
4. Платете ги вашите сметки или сметките на други со внесување на бројот на фактурата или со скенирање на баркодот на хартиената сметка. 
• Детален преглед над сите ставки во вашиот месечен износ за плаќање
• Платете повеќе сметки одеднаш
• Платете електронски со кредитна или дебитна картичка
• Добивајте нотификации за навремено и редовно плаќање на сметките
• Проверете ги платените сметки од минатите месеци
5. Дополнување на припејд ваучер
• Уживајте во ексклузивните понуди само преку Telekom MK и бидете во тек со останатите понуди
• Надополнете го вашиот припејд ваучер или на друг Телеком број
• Едноставно активирајте дополнителни пакети
6. Помош и поддршка
• Виртуелен асистент (chatbot) кој ќе ви помогне да дојдете сами до бараните податоци или контактирате со корисничка поддршка преку chat 
• Добијте одговори на често поставените прашања во секцијата за Помош и поддршка
• Пријавете можни пречки во користењето на Телеком услугите, детектирајте ги и решете ги во најбрз можен рок преку опцијата Виртуелен техничар
• Следете ја состојбата на пријавените пречки во користењето на Телеком услугите и дознајте веднаш штом истите се отстранети
Aplikacioni i përmirësuar celular Telekom MK ju ofron të gjitha informacionet e shfrytëzimit të internetit, minutave, roaming dhe SMS në numrat tuaj celular, si dhe njëkohësisht, ai është mjeti më i mirë për monitorimin e thjeshtë dhe të lehtë të të gjitha shërbimeve tuaja fikse dhe mobile në një vend. Për më tepër, Telekom MK ju ofron mënyrën më të shpejtë dhe të sigurt për të paguar faturat dhe rimbushjen e numrit tuaj pripejd. 
Menaxhoni shërbimet tuaja dhe shërbimet e miqve tuaj më të afërt dhe anëtarëve të familjes kudo dhe në çdo kohë.
The improved mobile application Telekom MK offers you all the new information on your internet, minutes, roaming and SMS usage on your mobile numbers, and concurrently, it is the best tool for simple and easy monitoring all your fixed and mobile services in one place. In addition, Telekom MK offers you the fastest and safest way to pay your bills and top-up your prepaid voucher. Manage your services and the services of your closest friends and family members anywhere and anytime.

bluejetty:00119504:ios.summary:

Redtail CRM was fo
bluejetty:00119504:ios.description:
Access the day-to-day contact information, calendar items, and CRM capabilities necessary for you to manage your client relationships whether you’re in the office, on the road, up in the air, or walking the family dog.
Redtail CRM was founded in 2003 as the first cloud-based CRM tailored specifically for advisors to provide anywhere, anytime access to their data and processes, an essential need in our increasingly connected world. Redtail CRM’s companion app aims to provide you with many of the tools from the CRM you access from desktop or laptop, in order that your ability to service your clients effectively remains consistent, no matter the device you are currently using or where you find yourself.
If you aren’t already a Redtail CRM subscriber, we welcome you to take advantage of our 30-day free trial! The Redtail CRM app is free-to-use for subscribers.
Using the Redtail CRM app, you can stay on top of meetings and opportunities and stay connected to your clients, your prospects and your team:
Access your Redtail calendar, as well as the calendar of your other database users. View individually or view multiple users’ calendars at once.
See your calendar in Day, Month, or Week (with expandable agenda view for each day of the week) views.
Expand your activities to a card view on the today page to view relevant details. Quick completion or edit options are accessible from an activity’s card view (or with a left swipe on a non-expanded card).
Create, edit, assign, complete and/or delete activities. The date picker for activities features days of the week along with the date in order to facilitate ease of selection.
Add contacts and/or attendees to new activities. Edit contacts and/or attendees on existing activities.
Easily access your Contacts A-Z page and your recently viewed contacts, or search your entire database of contacts.
Quickly access your contacts’ activities, notes, accounts, contact card and details, important information, keywords and tag groups. Be prepared for every meeting, whether it occurs by schedule or by chance.
Reach out to your contacts via phone, text or primary email from any page within their contact record.
Click a contact’s address to access Maps and driving directions.
Add notes to contact records. Adding notes during or directly after a client interaction allows you to document what is important before it can slip from your mind. This also means you aren’t leaving this all-important task to the end of the day, when there may be competing pressures for your attention.
Add or edit activities, phone numbers, email addresses, physical addresses, social media addresses and/or website addresses for your contacts.
View, edit or add new opportunities to your CRM.
About Redtail Technology:
Founded in 2003, Redtail Technology is a leading provider of web-based Client Relationship Management (CRM), compliant text messaging solutions (Redtail Speak), paperless office, and email archiving solutions in the financial services industry. The company is dedicated to helping advisors efficiently grow their firms by providing them with the core technologies that drive their day-to-day operations, offering low cost and easy to implement applications and integrating with many of the industry's most widely used applications. As a pioneer in the financial technology industry, Redtail is committed to providing advisors exceptional customer service and strives to contribute in meaningful ways to its local communities in California, Arizona, and Georgia.

The KTSU App allows you to listen to KTSU, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for KTSU all at once! You can explore and listen to On Demand content whenever you want, share stories with your friends, and wake up to KTSU with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from KTSU even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing.
• Integrated program schedules for our streams!
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to KTSU in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
• Read news stories, articles, and other information from the station all in one place.
The KTSU App is brought to you by the people at KTSU, and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, on whatever device you have!
Please support KTSU by becoming a member today!
https://ktsuradio.com
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

DIRE
bluejetty:00178058:ios.description:
Ball Sort Puzzle® is a challenging puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours! Sort the colored balls in the tubes until all of the same-hued balls are in the same tube. A brain-teasing game that is both tough and relaxing!
DIRECTIONS FOR PLAYING:
- Tap any tube to shift the ball that is lying on top of it to a different tube.
- You can only lay a ball on top of another ball if all of them are the same color and the tube into which you wish to travel has adequate space.
- Try not to get stuck, but if you do, don't worry; you can always restart the level.
FEATURES:
- Control with just one finger.
- Completely free and easy to play.
- There are no penalties or time limits, so you can play Ball Sort Puzzle whenever you want!

bluejetty:00159510:ios.description:
Keep passwords safe and secure with CyberFOX Password Manager – the ultimate password manager app!
Our easy to use password wallet and password filler app logs you into any website without having to enter your passwords - it is the easiest way to store & remember your passwords. 
Stores an unlimited number of passwords so you can keep all of your passwords in one spot. 
This is the Password Manager you have been looking for
EASY PASSWORD MANAGER & PASSWORD KEEPER
CyberFOX Password Manager will make different passwords for every website for you to keep your accounts safer in case of a security breach.
WE DO MORE THAN JUST PASSWORDS TOO: 
- Digital Wallet stores your credit cards for online checkouts with NO TYPING
- Built-in Two Factor Authenticator (2FA) with TOTP codes
- Emergency Access gives someone else access to your passwords in case of an emergency
- Secure Notes store all of your important stuff like travel programs or insurance info in one place
- Automatic form filling with a single tap
- Saves passwords for everything like websites, Apps and Servers
- Share ANYTHING with ANYONE - passwords, credit cards, anything.
...and much more!
WORKS ON ALL OF YOUR DEVICES
All of your passwords are synchronized to all of your devices
Make changes on one device and all other devices are updated automatically. Enjoy the simplicity that you can’t find in other password keeper & password fillers apps.
BANK-GRADE SECURITY KEEPS YOUR PASSWORDS SAFE
Your vault is protected with strong encryption, and only you can unlock it - CyberFOX never has access to your data.
SUPER-EASY TO USE
CyberFOX Password Manager makes is easy for password managing and password storing. We have been reviewed as one of the easiest password managers available. The process of storing passwords and login details in your digital wallet is easy as 1, 2, 3. You can also login to your CyberFOX Password Manager password wallet with your fingerprint.
GET MORE WITH CYBERFOX PASSWORD MANAGER PREMIUM
- 2-Step verification
- Online backups
- Unlimited sharing 
- Priority support
As a password manager - CyberFOX Password Manager is free to download and use. However, our free password manager app also has CyberFOX Password Manager Premium service which adds the great features above and is available by an auto-renewing subscription for $29.99 per year.
So stop wasting time and money by not safely storing and securing your passwords.
Download now and get your own password wallet and password filler app!

bluejetty:00184032:ios.description:
Keen Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Keen Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Keen Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Keen Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. Member FDIC.
