bluejetty:00129577:ios.name: Police Mission Chief Emergency
bluejetty:00129577:ios.summary: Enjoy the most realistic police dispatcher simulation at your finger tips! Plan and create your very own dispatch center and place police stations in familiar precincts, using real life maps. You want a faithful representation of real life
bluejetty:00129577:ios.description:
Enjoy the most realistic police dispatcher simulation at your finger tips! Plan and create your very own dispatch center and place police stations in familiar precincts, using real life maps. You want a faithful representation of real life police locations? Or would you rather build a police headquarters right on top of the Madison Square Garden? It is all up to you!
You will begin with a police station and a patrol car. Afterwards you can expand your justice system any way you want. Add more specialist vehicles like the FBI surveillance or bomb technician vehicles, sheriff units or expand your police force further with SWAT and K9 units and cover a wide variety of dispatch calls!
The game allows for vast customization, so all stations and vehicles can be named. And as some specialized vehicles need trained personnel, you can set up training courses and assign specialists to specific vehicles. Advanced players can use police helicopters to get to the most urgent calls quickly!
If you enjoy teamwork then help friends by joining or creating an alliance. You can share missions to help each other out as well as allow friends to take detainees to your prison. A bigger network that you control will boost your call amount too, increasing the challenges you face. Remember, some calls will require different types of units to be sent so ensure your fleet is up-to-date!
Staying true to our passion of simulation games, it has always been important to have realistic missions with authentic demands for vehicles and units - from small missions like patrolling the river to big ones like a massive prison riot - all on real life maps!
Naturally a lot of our players are also working for a variety of police organizations in real life. This is the perfect game for fans of the blue force!
Finally, we want to let you know that we are always interested in ideas for new missions, vehicles and other content. Just give us a note in a review, contact us on Facebook or send us an email. We cannot implement everything but we strive to realize the valuable input from our players. We are working hard and very closely with our community - to expand the game with you!

Your privacy is non-negotiable. KYMS gives you control, speed, and peace of mind — all in one place.

Official Partner | UCI Cycling Esports World Championships 2024-2026
MyWhoosh is a free-to-use virtual cycling platform that provides a great experience at any skill level. You can explore an extraordinary virtual world, improve your cycling goals, and be a part of a vibrant global community from the comfort of your home.
MyWhoosh has been designed with your goals in mind, whatever they may be:
• Elevating your performance as an amateur or professional cyclist.
• Racing in global esports events.
• Having a fun, social, and innovative fitness experience at home.
• Exploring new and immersive worlds.
WHY JOIN MYWHOOSH?
REALISTIC WORLDS 
Explore beautiful worlds – Hudayriyat, California, Belgium, Colombia, Australia, AlUla, and Arabia – based on real-life locations from across the world. From challenging climbs to fast flats, lush jungles, and sparse deserts to dense cities and rolling countryside, MyWhoosh has it all.
WORLD-CLASS WORKOUTS AND TRAINING PLANS 
Train 730+ workouts and world-class plans designed by top coaches to help you crush your cycling goals and take your fitness to the next level. Whether you are a road cyclist, a triathlete, or just looking to improve your health and get fit, there's something for everyone, and you can even create your own workout.
THE HIGHEST LEVEL OF CYCLING ESPORTS IN THE WORLD
Take part in cycling esports events with the biggest cash prize pool in virtual cycling history!
A GLOBAL COMMUNITY OF RIDERS
Never ride alone! Join a vibrant community of cyclists and fitness enthusiasts from around the world. Ride in a range of social rides and daily events targeting different time zones and make new friends while riding.
POPULAR BRAND ACCESSORIES IN THE MYWHOOSH GARAGE
Customize your avatar completely by choosing your preferred bike and cycling accessories from popular brands like Colnago, Ekoi, Ventum, Rose, and Look and many more.
